Iqembu le-Telegram yindawo esheshayo yokubuza umbuzo, ukubona lokho abanye abantu abakwenzile nokuzwa ngokukhishwa kokuqala. Iziphazamisi zisaya ku-GitHub, lapho zingalandelelwa khona ukuze zilungiswe. Thinta ubambe i-akhawunti ukuze ukopishe isixhumanisi sayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lulanda amaphakethe edatha kusuka endaweni yokugcina idatha ye-WM Keyboard uma uwadinga. Iphakethe ngalinye ligcina ilayisensi yomthombo walo, noma ngabe uyifaka noma cha.
Irekhodi lalokho okwenziwe ikhibhodi. Lifunde, noma ulithumele nombiko wephutha

Ama-bigram embewu, imephu yamagama abolekiwe kanye nohlu lwamagama anenhlamba kwenziwe ngesandla kule phrojekthi, futhi asebenzisa ilayisensi yayo. Izinhlu zamagama ozilanda zigcina izilayisensi zemithombo yazo. Isikrini sezilayisensi zomthombo ovulekile sinikeza uhlu oluphelele.

Inkinga iyisinqumo sokuqala esingcono. Omunye umuntu angaba nenkinga efanayo. I-imeyili nayo ilungile uma umbiko wakho uyimfihlo. Kuzo zombili izimo, thumela umbhalo we-Diagnostics ongenhla nombiko wakho. Usho ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo nokuthi iyiphi idivayisi lena, futhi awuqukethe umbhalo owuthayiphile.
I-WM Keyboard iyisoftware yamahhala. Ungayisebenzisa, uyishintshe futhi uyinikeze abanye abantu. Kufanele ugcine isaziso se-copyright nombhalo welayisensi nayo.

Lokhu kushintsha kuphela igama elingaphansi kwesithonjana, kudrowa yakho yezinhlelo zokusebenza nasesikrinini sasekhaya. Kuyo yonke indawo, njengezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android, uhlu lwekhibhodi nezitolo zezinhlelo zokusebenza, uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina igama lalo eligcwele. Uma uvule uhlelo lokusebenza kusuka kusithonjana salo, lesi sikrini sivuleka futhi uma ushintsha igama. Isiqalisi sakho singathatha imizuzwana embalwa ukukhombisa igama elisha. Uma isithonjana siphuma esikrinini sasekhaya, sengeze futhi kusuka kudrowa yezinhlelo zokusebenza.
Bonisa \"WMK\" ngaphansi kwesithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza, hhayi \"WM Keyboard\"

Vala lokhu ukuze ususe isithonjana. Ikhibhodi iyaqhubeka nokusebenza, futhi lezi zilungiselelo zisatholakala ngokuthepha: ukhiye wezilungiselelo kukhibhodi, ukungena kwekhibhodi kuzilungiselelo zekhibhodi ze-Android, noma isixhumanisi sezilungiselelo. Izinqamuleli zokucindezela isikhathi eside esithonjaneni ziyahamba nakho. Ku-Android 10 nangaphezulu, i-Android ingase ibeke isithonjana esivula ikhasi lolwazi lohlelo lokusebenza esikhundleni salokho, ngoba yenza lokho kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe ezingenaso isithonjana sazo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezize nefoni kuphela ezisindayo. Ukuze uyimise kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza, sebenzisa i-adb shell settings put global show_hidden_icon_apps_enabled 0 kusuka kukhompyutha.
Isithonjana sohlelo lokusebenza kudrowa yakho yezinhlelo zokusebenza nasesikrinini sakho sasekhaya
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lo mbhalo welayisensi.

Lesi sikrini sibala izingxenye ezingaphakathi kwale yakhiwo kanye nedatha uhlelo lokusebenza olungayilanda. Cindezela umugqa ukuze ufunde umbhalo wawo ogcwele welayisensi. Umugqa ongenambhalo welayisensi kuhlelo lokusebenza uvula imigomo yomhlinzeki.
Imitapo yolwazi nedatha engaphakathi kwalokhu okwakhiwe
Idivayisi yakho ayinayo uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-imeyili. Bhala ku-%1$s esikhundleni salokho.

Ithuluzi elisebenzisa isevisi eku-inthanethi kuphela elixhumana nayo, futhi lokho kwenzeka kuphela uma uvula lelo thuluzi. Uhlelo lokusebenza aluqukethe ikhodi evela kulezo zinsiza.

Sebenzisa lokhu ukuze uthumele othile kusilungiselelo. Ikhophi inendlela eya kusilungiselelo emgqeni wayo wokuqala, ngakho ingatholakala ngesandla futhi, kanye nesixhumanisi esingaphansi kwayo. Isixhumanisi sivula lolu hlelo lokusebenza kuleso sikrini futhi sikhanyise isilungiselelo. Uma uhlelo lokusebenza lungafakiwe, isixhumanisi sivula ikhasi kuwebhusayithi elitshela ukuthi ungalithola kanjani. Bamba ikhophi yesixhumanisi uma uthinta futhi ubambe isilungiselelo noma isihloko seqembu. Inkinobho ikhombisa inkinobho encane yesixhumanisi eduze kwesilungiselelo ngasinye nesihloko seqembu. Izilungiselelo ezingenalo igama elinqunyiwe, njengolimi olulodwa noma itimu eyodwa, azinasixhumanisi.
Kopisha isixhumanisi sewebhu esivula isilungiselelo esisodwa
Zama i-WM Keyboard, uhlelo lokusebenza lwekhibhodi oluhle kakhulu!
Bona ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina ini kudivayisi yakho, bese ulususa
Abantu abafake isandla ekusekeleni uhlelo lokusebenza
Buza imibuzo, wabelane ngezinhlelo nezindikimba, futhi uzwe ngezinguqulo ezintsha kuqala
Ikhibhodi yenza imigqa yamalebula okhiye ibe mnyama. Sebenzisa lokhu ngokhiye abagqamile esikrinini esincane, noma esikrinini esinokukhanya okuphansi.

Uma ubamba ukhiye, ama-pop-up awo ahlukile avuleka ngokujwayelekile nokuqala okuhlukile ngqo phezu kokhiye, okuhlukile okuhlosile kuyakhula, futhi okuvelele kulandela umunwe wakho futhi kushelele kusuka kokukodwa kuya kokulandelayo. Vula lokhu ukuze uthole i-pop-up njengoba yayinjalo. Ivuleka lapho ukhiye ukhona, okuvelele kusekunoma yini ehlukile engaphansi komunwe wakho, akukho okukhulayo, futhi okuvelele kugxumela ngqo kokulandelayo esikhundleni sokushelela. Ukukhetha kusasebenza ngendlela efanayo: shelela kokuhlukile bese uphakamisa.
Ama-pop-up ahlukile njengoba ayeyiyo, kungekho okuhambayo ngaphansi komunwe wakho

Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha imibala yekhibhodi. Imibala ebukeka ifana kuwe iba ehlukile. Khetha uhlobo oluvumelana nombono wakho. I-Deuteranopia ne-protanopia yizinhlobo ezimbili ezibomvu-eziluhlaza. I-Deuteranopia iyona evame kakhulu. I-Tritanopia yuhlobo oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-ophuzi. Okumpunga kususa yonke imibala. Lesi silungiselelo silungisa imibala. Asiyilingisi. Asikukhombisi lokho umuntu onobumpumputhe bemibala akubonayo. Kwenza ikhibhodi ibe lula ukuthi uyifunde.
Shintsha imibala yekhibhodi ngenxa yokungaboni kahle kwemibala

Lesi silungiselelo esokuthuthumela kwezandla noma ukuqina kwemisipha. Ngemva kokuba ukhiye ubhalisile, ikhibhodi ilahla ukucindezelwa kwesibili kwalowo khiye phakathi nalesi sikhathi. Ukucindezela okukodwa okufunayo akuphenduki izinhlamvu ezimbili. Ikhibhodi ihlunga ukuphindwa kokhiye ofanayo kuphela. Ungahlala uthayipha okhiye ababili abahlukene ngokushesha. Khulisa isikhathi kuze kube yilapho izinhlamvu eziphindwe kabili ziyeka. Uma isikhathi side kakhulu, ikhibhodi iphinde ilahle izinhlamvu eziphindwe kabili ozifunayo, isibonelo \"ll\" kanye \"ee\".
Ikhibhodi ayinaki ukucindezelwa kwesibili kokhiye ofanayo ngalesi sikhathi
Ngenkathi i-TalkBack isebenza, ukuthinta kwayo kuthatha indawo yokuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kanye nokucindezela nokubamba okuhlukile kwekhibhodi.
Qinisekisa ukucindezela kokhiye ngamunye ngokudlidliza noma ngomsindo

Ikhibhodi ithatha indawo yemibala yokhiye nemibala yebhodi yengqikithi ngemibala ephezulu ehlukile (high contrast). Wonke amalebula aba mnyama qwembe noma amhlophe qwembe. Ikhibhodi igcina umbala wokugqamisa wengqikithi yakho. U-Shift namathuluzi asebenzayo ahlala elula ukuwubona. Lesi silungiselelo sithatha indawo yemibala yengqikithi ekhethiwe ngenkathi sivuliwe.
Amalebula anokugqama okuphezulu kakhulu ebhodini elimnyama noma elimhlophe eliyisicaba
Dweba umngcele uzungeze zonke izinkinobho nethuluzi ngalinye lebhara lamathuluzi
Okhiye abade nezikhala ezibanzi kulula ukubacindezela ngokunembile
Bona wonke amafonti, noma ngenisa ifonti yakho
Inkinobho encane kuzo zonke izikrini zezilungiselelo evula ikhibhodi nenkambu yokuthayipha kuyo

Uma ushintsha ulimi, inkinobho ngayinye ebonisa uhlamvu oluhlukile olimini olusha iyaphenduka iye kulo. Izinkinobho ezihlala zinjalo azinyakazi, ukuze ubone ukuthi yini eshintshile. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba ukushintsha okulula kuyashesha kakhulu. Ukushintsha ulimi kuphela okugqwayizayo. Ukushintshela ezimpawini noma ezinombolweni akukwenzi lokho. Ukunciphisa ukunyakaza nakho kuyakucisha lokhu.
Okhiye baphendukela olimini olusha uma ushintsha
Isikhathi osibamba ngaso ukhiye ngaphambi kokuba izikhiye zawo ezinye zivuleke

Uma uvula iphaneli efana nebhodi lokunamathisela, i-emoji noma ithuluzi, likhula lisuka enkinobheni yebha yamathuluzi noma igama lethuluzi olithintile, futhi ligoqeka libuyele kulo uma uvalwa. I-animation imfushane, ngakho ayikubambezeli. Valela lokhu futhi amaphaneli azovela futhi anyamalale ngaso leso sikhathi. Ukunciphisa ukunyakaza nakho kuvala lokhu.
Amaphaneli akhula ephuma enkinobheni noma egameni lethuluzi eliwavulile
Ivuliwe. Izinkinobho zithola ukuthinta kwakho. I-TalkBack igcina okunye kwesikrini

Vala lokhu emigqeni elula ebonisa amagama kuphela, njengasezinguqulweni zangaphambili zohlelo lokusebenza. Abanye abantu bathola ukuthi uhlu lwamagama kulula ukulufunda kunekholomu yezithonjana ezinemibala. Lokhu kushintsha kuphela lezi zikrini zezilungiselelo. Izithonjana zekhibhodi namathuluzi ayo ahlala njengoba enjalo.
Isithonjana esinemibala eceleni kwazo zonke izilungiselelo kanye negama lesikrini

Vala lokhu uma lezi zikrini zezilungiselelo zihamba kancane ukuvuleka ocingweni lwakho. Ukuhambisa isithonjana segama nesilungiselelo esikrinini esivulekayo kwenza isikrini ngasinye sithathe umsebenzi omningi ukuze sidwetshwe, futhi amanye amafoni ahamba kancane abonisa lokho njengokubambezeleka. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, isikrini sivuleka ngesilayidi esilula, futhi sidwetshwa ngokushesha. Lokhu kushintsha kuphela lezi zikrini zezilungiselelo. Akwenzi lutho kukhibhodi. Uma ukunciphisa ukunyakaza kuvuliwe, lezi zinguquko seziyacishwa kakade.
Isithonjana nesigama sesilungiselelo kuhamba kuya esikrinini esisivulayo

Ngenkathi ukhetha umbhalo ngekhibhodi, ukugqamisa kutelelela ekukhetheni okusha futhi izinkinobho zebha yokukhetha zivela ngokulandelana. Valela lokhu futhi ukukhetha nezinkinobho zako kushintsha ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ukunciphisa ukunyakaza nakho kuvala lokhu.
Ukugqanyiswa kokukhethiwe nezinkinobho zako kuhamba ngokushelelayo
Hambisa umunwe wakho ukuze uzwe ukhiye, bese uwuvula ukuze uthayiphe
Izinkomba zekhibhodi ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza ngenkathi i-TalkBack isebenza
Wonke ukhiye unegama elikhulunywayo. Uthayipha ngokuthinta okuqondile

Kuthuluzi lohlelo lolimi, ukulungisa okusebenzisayo kuwela amagama amadala bese kufaka amasha, futhi uhlu lwezinkinga luvaleka kulo. Kuthuluzi lokuhumusha, ingxenye yokuhumusha eshintshile iyavela kancane kancane kuyilapho amagama ahlale ekhona enganyakazi, futhi inkinobho yokushintsha ulimi iyajika. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba lawa mathuluzi awokuthola umbhalo ngokushesha. Ukunciphisa ukunyakaza nakho kuyakucisha lokhu.

Indawo yokugcina ishicilela uhlu lwalokho ekunikezayo. Ikhibhodi ilanda lolo hlu njalo uma uvula lesi sikrini, ngakho itimu noma isakhiwo esingeziwe kusukela ekuvakasheni kwakho kokugcina siyavela ngaphandle kokuthi wenze lutho. Uhlu ngalunye luncane, kodwa ikhibhodi ilanda olulodwa kuyo yonke indawo yokugcina oyengezile. Vala lokhu ukuze ungalandi lutho uze ucindezele Vuselela. Vuselela kuhlale kulanda, noma yini lezi zilungiselelo ezimbili ezishoyo, ngoba ukuyicindezela kuyisicelo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Landa uhlu lwayo yonke indawo yokugcina njalo uma uvakashela
Le-add-on idinga inguqulo entsha ye-WM Keyboard.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuthola lelo add-on. Indawo yokugcina kungenzeka ishintshile.
Lesi sikrini sibonisa idatha uhlelo lokusebenza oluyilondoloze ngesikhathi sokufaka. Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda indawo yokugcina manje, ngakho alukwazi ukuhlola izibuyekezo.

Ama-plugin avaliwe. Vula okuthi “Vumela ama-plugin” ngaphansi kwe-Tools › Plugins. Bese ufaka le-add-on. Ithuluzi lama-Plugin kubha yamathuluzi liyisilungiselelo esihlukile. Lilawula kuphela lapho iphaneli ivuleka khona.
Le ndawo yokugcina ayikho ohlwini lwakho. Ukufaka kuyayengeza.
Le yengezo inohlu oluhlukile kulo lonke ulimi. Faka izilimi obhala ngazo. Ngayinye ingena ezichazamazwini ezingokwezifiso zolimi lwayo, futhi iyazibuyekeza futhi isuswe yona ngokwayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukulanda umbhalo welayisensi.
Ama-plugin asebenza endaweni evaliwe. Leli plugin alikwazi ukubona lokho okuthayiphayo, ukufunda ibhodi lakho lokunamathisela, noma ukusebenzisa i-inthanethi. I-plugin ayikwazi ukucela lezo zinkonzo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukulanda ukubuka kuqala.

resources.string: Yeqa ukuhlola uma uxhumano lwakho lusebenzisa idatha
Namathisela ikheli lereposithri. Sebenzisa isixhumanisi se-GitHub, noma isixhumanisi esiqondile kufayela layo le-%1$s.
Lelo akulona ikheli lendawo yokugcina. Kumele kube isixhumanisi se-https esiya endaweni yokugcina ye-GitHub, noma isixhumanisi esiqondile sefayela le-%1$s.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda indawo yokugcina yezengezo kulelo kheli.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda le ndawo yokugcina. Yivuselele kusuka esikrinini sama-Add-ons.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lelo kheli. Kumele kube ikheli le-https.
Awekho ama-repository okwamanje. Engeza elilodwa nekheli lalo ukuze ubone ukuthi linikezani.

Izindawo zokugcina izengezo (add-ons) ngamakhasi ewebhu ajwayelekile. Afaka izingqikithi, izakhiwo, izichazamazwi, imishwana, amaphakethe ezitikha, amaphakethe ezithonjana, amafonti, amafonti e-emoji nemisindo yezikhiye. Izengezo ziqukethe idatha elula. Uhlelo lokusebenza alusebenzisi ikhodi uma ufaka eyodwa.
Ufuna: %1$s. Vula isilondolozi ukuze ubone ukuthi yini ekunikezayo. Isihlungi sikubekelwe futhi ungasisabalalisa lapho.
Le-add-on yenziwe kanye nama-add-on angezansi. Ungawafaka wonke, noma ufake lolu kuphela. Isebenza yodwa futhi.
Amafonti we-Google, noma ngenisa ifayela lakho lefonti
Shintsha noma yisiphi isithonjana sethuluzi noma isithonjana sokhiye, noma ufake iphakethe lezithonjana
0 inikeza okhiye abayisikwele. 28 inikeza okhiye abanomumo wephilisi ophelele.
Ku-0 dp iseluleko sithinta onqenqemeni olungaphezulu lokhiye. Amanani amakhulu ahambisa iseluleko phansi, siseduze nelebhuli. Okuzenzakalelayo yi-1 dp.
Ibanga leseluleko sekhona kusuka emaphethelweni aphezulu okhiye
Ukuthi iseluleko sihlala kude kangakanani ohlangothini lokhiye. Ngaphansi kuka-0 kuyisusa iye onqenqemeni

Lokhu kushintsha usayizi wokusikisela okuncane okubhalwa ikhibhodi ekhoneni lokhiye. Ikhibhodi ikhombisa ukusikisela uma \"Cindezela ubambe izinkomba\" kuvuliwe. Amanani amakhulu enza izinkomba zifundeke kalula. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-×1.00.
Isikali somlingiswa omncane osesikhaleni sekhi ngalinye
Ihambisa uhlamvu kukhiye ngamunye eceleni, kude necebo elikhulu
Ihambisa incwadi ekhiye ngalinye phansi, noma phezulu ngaphansi kuka-0, kude neseluleko esikhulu
Lokhu kushintsha usayizi wawo wonke amalebula akukhiye. Amabhamuza e-popup anobukhulu bawo befonti ngaphansi kokuthi Ukucindezela ukhiye → I-popup yokhiye.

I-radius yekona eliyisihluthulelo, osayizi belebula necebo, iqembu lonke lethuluzi kanye neqembu lonke lebhokisi lamathuluzi kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Itimu yakho, ifonti yakho kanye nephakethe lakho lezithonjana akuthinteki: kunezikrini zazo.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini ekubeni kwazo okuzenzakalelayo
Amathuluzi kugridi yethuluzi abuyela ekulandelaneni kwawo kwasekuqaleni. Amathuluzi avuliwe, nalawa abhalwe kubha yamathuluzi, awathinteki.
Buyisela amathuluzi kugridi yethuluzi endaweni yawo yasekuqaleni

Umugqa udweba isiphakamiso sawo sokuqala ngokugqamile. Khetha umbala lapha futhi lelo gama lithatha umbala kuphela uma ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kunqume ukukufaka lapho uthayipha isikhala. Igama eligqamile ngaphandle kombala yisiphakamiso esiphezulu, futhi isikhala sigcina lokho okuthayiphile. Ezinye iziphakamiso zigcina umbala wetimu. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.
Umbala wegama okuzolifaka ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo esikhaleni

Yehlisa ukuze ulinganise igama elide ngaphambi kokuba kudingeke ukuthi linciphe, noma ukuze ufake iziphakamiso eziningi esikrinini esincane. Yiphakamise ukuze uvimbele amagama angomakhelwane ukuthi angafundwa njengelilodwa lapho umugqa ushaya umqulu. Lesi silungiselelo singu-6 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Igebe ohlangothini ngalunye lwegama emgqeni weziphakamiso

Amalebula okhiye anokusethwa kwawo kosayizi futhi iziphakamiso ezingenhla kwawo bezingenawo, ngakho okhiye abakhulu bangase beze neziphakamiso ezincane. Lokhu futhi kulinganisa umugqa wamakhandidethi wokufaka kwesiShayina, isiJapane nesiCantonese, njengoba kuwumugqa ofanayo kwimodi ehlukile. Lokhu kusethwa ku-100% ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi amagama akumugqa wokuphakamisa makhulu kangakanani
Kubekwe yindikimba yakho \"%1$s\". Kushintshe lapho, ngaphansi kwe-Layout yale ndikimba.
Izindikimba ezikhanyayo, ezimnyama kanye ne-AMOLED, imibala, izithombe zangemuva, ukungenisa nokuthumela ngaphandle
20 idweba isiyingi esigcwele ngemuva kwesithonjana sethuluzi ngalinye, njenge-Gboard. Amanani amancane anikeza izikwele eziyindilinga. 0 isusa ingemuva futhi ishiye izithonjana kuphela.
Ukuthi umbuthano ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye le-toolbar uyindilinga kangakanani
Kusebenza kubha yamathuluzi kanye negridi yebhokisi lamathuluzi. Izinkinobho zigcina usayizi wazo, ngakho-ke inani elifanayo lamathuluzi liseselingana. 22 uwukuzenzakalelayo.
Usayizi wesithonjana esingaphakathi kwenkinobho ngayinye yamathuluzi
Uhlaka lomumo ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye lethuluzi

38 igcina umbuthano wakudala. Amanani abanzi awelula abe yiphilisi, njenge-Gboard. Ingemuva libonakala kuphela uma iradiyasi yombuthano wethuluzi ingaphezu kuka-0. Ihambisana kahle nebha yamathuluzi engapheqeka.
Ububanzi besimo ngemuva kwethuluzi ngalinye lebhokisi lamathuluzi

Umugqa ophezulu ogcwele uyanyamalala. Ulahlekelwa iziphakamiso zamagama nokufinyelela okusheshayo kuyo yonke ithuluzi eliphiniwe, njenge-emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela, nokhiye besikhombisi. Okhiye basebenzisa ubude obukhululekile. Ungavula ibha yamathuluzi futhi lapha nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukucindezela nokubamba okuhambayo kuthatha ithuluzi ukuze ukwazi ukulibeka kwenye indawo kubha yamathuluzi. Uma kuvaliwe, ukucindezela nokubamba okuhambayo kuhlala kuyikucindezela nokubamba, futhi ibhokisi lamathuluzi yilapho uhlela khona kabusha ibha yamathuluzi. Kucishe uma ukubamba kuqhubeka kuphenduka ukuhudula ngephutha.
Cindezela ubambe ithuluzi kubha yamathuluzi, bese ulihudulela endaweni entsha
Amathuluzi agcina usayizi owodwa, epakishwe ngakwesobunxele

Usayizi omisiwe ugcina amathuluzi ngosayizi owodwa kwesobunxele. Ukusabalalisa kwabelana ngobubanzi obugcwele bebha yamathuluzi phakathi kwawo, njengoba kwenza iziphakamiso zamagama. Ukuskrola kugcina ithuluzi ngalinye ngosayizi okhululekile uma uphina okungaphezu kokulingana, futhi kukuvumela ukuthi uswayiphe phakathi kwawo. Ukhetha amathuluzi kubha yamathuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi: vula ibhokisi lamathuluzi ngenkinobho yegridi, bese ucindezela ubambe ithuluzi bese ulihudula phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi kanye nebhokisi lamathuluzi. Ngokuskrola, shintsha ukuhleleka kusuka ebhokisini lamathuluzi, ngoba ukuhudula ngaphakathi kwebha yamathuluzi eskrolayo kunzima.
Ithuluzi ngalinye ligcina usayizi okhululekile futhi ibha iyaskrola eceleni
Amathuluzi abelana ngobubanzi obugcwele bebha yamathuluzi
Indlela amathuluzi aphiniwe abelana ngayo nebha yamathuluzi

Uma kuboniswa ibha yamathuluzi kuphela, inkinobho yekhibhodi ekugcineni kwebha yamathuluzi iletha okhiye abasesikrinini, futhi inkinobho efanayo iyabafihla. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukuthayipha kukhibhodi yangempela nakho kuyabafihla. Uma kuvaliwe, bahlala kuze kube yilapho ucindezela inkinobho futhi. Noma kunjalo, ikhibhodi iyakhumbula ukuthi okhiye babevuliwe yini ebhokisini lombhalo elilandelayo. Kukhibhodi yangempela, umyalo wesinqamuleli bese u-Space wenza okufanayo nenkinobho. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Okhiye obaletha ngenkinobho yekhibhodi yebha yamathuluzi bayanyamalala ekhiye elilandelayo olithayiphayo
Fihla okhiye uma ngithayipha kukhibhodi ye-hardware

Uma uxhuma ikhibhodi ye-Bluetooth noma ikhibhodi yedokhi, okhiye abasesikrinini bayanyamalala futhi kubonakale ibha yamathuluzi kuphela. I-Emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela namanye amathuluzi ahlala ekude ngokucindezela okukodwa ngenkathi uthayipha kukhibhodi yehadiwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Uma ikhibhodi yezingxenyekazi (hardware) ixhunyiwe, khombisa ibha yamathuluzi kuphela

Lokhu kubeka ukuthi ucindezela isikhathi esingakanani ithuluzi kubha yamathuluzi noma ebhokisini lamathuluzi ngaphambi kokuba ukucindezela kubalwe njengokubamba. Ukubamba kwenza isenzo osikhethile ngaphansi kokuthi Cindezela ubambe kubha yamathuluzi ekhasini lezilungiselelo zethuluzi, kuvula lelo khasi lezilungiselelo, noma kuthatha ithuluzi ukuze ulihambise. Ku-System, ikhibhodi isebenzisa ukubambezeleka kokuthinta nokubamba kusuka kuzilungiselelo zokufinyeleleka zefoni yakho.
Isikhathi osibambayo ithuluzi ngaphambi kokuba ukubamba kubalwe
Usayizi wefonti wamalebula wamathuluzi kubha yamathuluzi
Finyeza igama elide esikhundleni sokwandisa inkinobho yalo
Ikhibhodi idweba igama elincane ngaphansi kwethuluzi ngalinye eliphiniwe. Khulisa ukuphakama kwebha yamathuluzi ukuze unikeze amalebula isikhala.
Bonisa igama lethuluzi ngalinye ngaphansi kwesithonjana salo kubha yamathuluzi

Ifoni elele eceleni inobubanzi obuningi kodwa inokuphakama okuncane. Khetha uhlangothi, futhi uma isesimweni se-landscape, amathuluzi asuka phezulu kwekhibhodi futhi ame kukholamu eceleni kwalolo hlangothi, eduze neziphakamiso nezinkinobho, ahlale efinyeleleka. Uma amathuluzi ayenomugqa wawo, ukuphakama kwawo kubuyela ezinkinobhweni. Ikholamu ilandela ezinye izilungiselelo zebha yamathuluzi: amathuluzi akho aphiniwe ngokulandelana kwawo, imibala yawo namalebula, nokuthi alingana kanjani. I-Portrait ayishintshi.
Ikholomu eseceleni kwezikhiye ngenkathi ifoni ilele

Ikhibhodi ivuleka phezu kwesikrini sakho sokukhiya uma uphendula isaziso noma usebenzisa ibhokisi lokusesha lapho. Lesi silungiselelo bese sifihla umugqa ophezulu ogcwele futhi sivimbe iphaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela. Umugqa ubamba iziphakamiso zamagama nethuluzi ngalinye eliphiniwe, ngakho ithuluzi lebhodi lokunamathisela kanye ne-chip yalo yokunamathisela nayo iyanyamalala. Umbhalo okopishiwe njengamakhodi esikhathi esisodwa namaphasiwedi kuhlala kude nesikrini esingavuswa yinoma ubani. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma idivayisi yakho ivuliwe, ikhibhodi ayishintshi.
Fihla umugqa ongaphezulu futhi uvimbele ibhodi lokunamathisela ngenkathi idivayisi yakho ikhiyiwe
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi kanye nebhodi lokunamathisela esikrinini sokukhiya
Lokhu kwengeza isikhala phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nomugqa wokuqala wezinkinobho. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-0 dp. Ibha yamathuluzi nekhibhodi ziba zinde ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
Lokhu kwengeza isikhala phakathi konqenqema olungaphezulu lwekhibhodi nebha yamathuluzi. Okuzenzakalelayo yi-4 dp. Ibha yamathuluzi nekhibhodi ziba zinde ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
Nikeza amathuluzi kubha yamathuluzi imibala enawo ebhokisini lamathuluzi
Amathuluzi agcina umugqa wawo, evulekile njalo
Amathuluzi athola umugqa wawo, ovulwa futhi uvalwe kusuka kumcibisholo

Ngo-\"Umugqa\", amathuluzi neziphakamiso babelana ngomugqa owodwa. Amathuluzi aphumula lapho, iziphakamiso zithatha umugqa ngenkathi uthayipha, futhi inkinobho yomcibisholo ishintsha phakathi kwawo. Lokhu akubizi ukuphakama. Ngo-\"Inkinobho\", inkinobho yomcibisholo ivula umugqa wamathuluzi ngaphezu kweziphakamiso, futhi inkinobho iwuvale futhi. Ngo-\"Njalo\", lowo mugqa wamathuluzi uhlala uvuliwe. Zombili lezi zokugcina zigcina amathuluzi ekufinyeleleni ngenkathi uthayipha, futhi zombili zisebenzisa ukuphakama komugqa owodwa ngaphezulu.
Amathuluzi neziphakamiso babelana ngomugqa owodwa, futhi umcibisholo uphenduka phakathi kwawo
Yabelana ngomugqa wesiphakamiso, noma sebenzisa umugqa ongenhla kwawo
Ibha yamathuluzi, amalebula ayo, umugqa weziphakamiso kanye nokuma kwethuluzi kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Amathuluzi aphiniwe awathinteki.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini kuzilungiselelo zazo ezizenzakalelayo

Ezinhlelweni zokubhala ezisuka kwesokudla ziye kwesobunxele, njengesi-Arabhu nesi-Hebheru, amathuluzi aphiniwe nawo asuka kwesokudla aya kwesobunxele, ngakho ibha yamathuluzi ilandela umbhalo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Igridi yebhokisi lamathuluzi ayishintshi.
Phindaphinda ukuhleleka kwamathuluzi uma uthayipha umbhalo osuka kwesokudla uye kwesobunxele
Hlehlisa ukulandelana kwezilimi ezibhalwa kusuka kwesokudla kuye kwesobunxele
Okuboniswa umugqa ongaphezu kwezinkinobho, nokuthi kanjani

Ibha yamathuluzi iwumugqa ongaphezu kokhiye. Ibonisa iziphakamiso zamagama ngenkathi uthayipha. Ngezikhathi ezinye ibonisa amathuluzi akho aphiniwe, njenge-emoji, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye nokhiye besikhombisi. Yicime ukuze unikeze ukuphakama kwayo kokhiye. Uhlelo lokusebenza lukucela ukuthi uqinisekise, ngoba lokhu kuphinde kufihle iziphakamiso nawo wonke amathuluzi.

Vala lokhu ukuze ususe umugqa weziphakamiso futhi ugcine umugqa wamathuluzi kuphela. Ikhibhodi iba mfushane ngomugqa owodwa. Kuwusizo uma uvale iziphakamiso futhi umugqa usala ungenalutho. Konke okunye okuvela kulowo mugqa nakho kuyasuswa: isiqeshana sokunamathisela sokukopisha kwakho kokugcina, amakhodi esikhathi esisodwa, okunikezwayo kweziqephu nezinye iziqeshana. Ibha ehlangene yokuthayipha ngezwi isavela lapho ngenkathi udictata.
Gcina umugqa wesiphakamiso ngaphezu komugqa wamathuluzi
Umugqa ongaphezu kwezinkinobho ophethe iziphakamiso namathuluzi

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukuswayiphela phansi noma kuphi kubha yamathuluzi kuvala ikhibhodi. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuze ukunyakaza kungaqali ngenkathi upheqa noma uhlela kabusha ibha yamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi uyalicindezela ubambe, ukuze lokho kunyakaza kungayivali ikhibhodi.
Swayiphela phansi kubha yamathuluzi ukuze uvale ikhibhodi
Ngenhla nangaphansi kwethuluzi ngalinye kugridi yamathuluzi. Okuncane kufaka imigqa eminingi ekhasini

Ibhokisi lamathuluzi yigridi engemuva kwenkinobho yegridi kubha yamathuluzi. Amathuluzi ambalwa emugqeni enza ithuluzi ngalinye libe likhulu futhi kube lula ukulicindezela. Amathuluzi amaningi emugqeni abonisa amathuluzi amaningi ngaphandle kokuskrola.

Ngokuzenzakalelayo lokhu kulandela usayizi welebula yebha yamathuluzi, ukuze zombili zivumelane. Setha usayizi lapha ukuze wenze amagama ebhokisi lamathuluzi abe makhulu noma abe mancane ngokwawo. Lesi silungiselelo silandela ibha yamathuluzi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Igama elingaphansi kwethuluzi ngalinye kuphaneli yamathuluzi egcwele

Izithonjana ziyigridi. Ibonisa isithonjana esiyindilinga sethuluzi ngalinye elinegama elingezansi. Ama-Pills anika ithuluzi ngalinye umugqa obanzi onamaphetho ayindilinga. Isithonjana singakwesobunxele kanti igama liseduze kwaso. Umcibisholo ongakwesokudla umaka amathuluzi avula okuthile, njengezindikimba (Themes) kanye ne-Clipboard. Amanye amathuluzi enza umsebenzi wawo ngokushesha, njenge-Flashlight kanye ne-Undo. Amathuluzi ambalwa alingana esikrinini, kodwa ungafunda wonke amagama.
Indlela ibhokisi lamathuluzi elidweba ngayo amathuluzi alo

Khetha okuphindaphindwayo kosayizi womugqa wakho ukuze ugcwalise umugqa wokugcina wekhasi ngalinye. Uma ukhetha amathuluzi amaningi kunalokho iphaneli elingakubonisa, ikhasi liyapheqa kanye nokuswayipha.
Mangaki amathuluzi ikhasi ngalinye lebhokisi lamathuluzi elikuphathayo

Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ibhokisi lamathuluzi liyigridi eyodwa ephequlula phezulu naphansi. Uma kuvuliwe, ibhokisi lamathuluzi liba amakhasi ophequlula phakathi kwawo. Amachashazi angaphansi kwegridi akhombisa indawo okuyo. Ithuluzi ngalinye ligcina indawo efanayo, ukuze ukwazi ukulithola ngokukhumbula. Ungahudula ithuluzi uye endaweni entsha ngaphakathi kwekhasi olibonayo.
Amakhasi amisiwe oswayipha ngawo eceleni, hhayi igridi eyodwa epheqululayo

Okuzenzakalelayo kubili. Okukodwa kunika ithuluzi ngalinye ububanzi obugcwele, okuhle kumagama amade nombhalo omkhulu. Okuthathu kusebenza kuphela ekubukekeni kwe-landscape noma kuthebhulethi. Esikrinini esincane amagama ayanqunywa.

Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, iphilisi ngalinye ligcina ingemuva lengqikithi futhi isithonjana kuphela esibonisa umbala wethuluzi. Uma kuvuliwe, iphilisi lithola lowo mbala. Isithonjana negama kushintshela kumbala ongawufunda kuwo: omhlophe emibaleni eminingi, cishe omnyama emibaleni ekhanyayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi \"Izithonjana zamathuluzi anemibala\" (Izilungiselelo → Amathuluzi) kuvulwe. Uma leso silungiselelo sivaliwe, awukho umbala wokugcwalisa iphilisi.
Faka umbala ku-pill ephelele hhayi esithonjaneni sayo kuphela
Isakhiwo segridi, amakholomu, ukukhasi nokusayizi welebula kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Ukuhleleka kwamathuluzi, nokuthi yimaphi amathuluzi avuliwe, akuthinteki.
Buyisela zonke izilungiselelo kulesi sikrini ekubeni okuzenzakalelayo

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, inkinobho yokusesha ihlala ekugcineni kwebha yamathuluzi, ngemva kwamathuluzi akho aphiniwe, ukuze ukuthepha okuhloselwe inkinobho yangemuva kungavuli ukusesha. Uma kuvaliwe, inkinobho yokusesha ihlala eduze kwenkinobho yangemuva.
Beka usesho lwebhokisi lamathuluzi ekugcineni kwebha yamathuluzi, kude nenkinobho yokubuyela emuva

Ngenkathi ibhokisi lamathuluzi livuliwe, ibha yamathuluzi ikhombisa inkinobho yokusesha eduze kwenkinobho yayo yokubuyela emuva. Ukuyithinta kuvula ukusesha kuyo yonke ikhibhodi, ngenkinobho yokubuyela emuva ebuyela ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Thayipha igama lethuluzi ukuze ulithole, noma ngabe likuphi, kufaka phakathi amafolda. Vala lokhu ukuze ushiye ibhokisi lamathuluzi ngaphandle kokusesha.
Inkinobho yokusesha eceleni kwenkinobho emuva ngenkathi ibhokisi lamathuluzi livuliwe

Ukusesha kwebhokisi lamathuluzi kubhala wonke amathuluzi uze uthayiphe okuthile. Ukuhlela kwakho kubhala amathuluzi ngendlela owahlele ngayo ibhokisi lamathuluzi. Okusetshenziswa kakhulu kubeka amathuluzi owavula kakhulu kuqala. Okusetshenziswe muva nje kubeka ithuluzi olivule okokugcina kuqala. Uma usuthayiphile, amagama aqala ngalokho okuthayiphile eza kuqala.
Indlela ukusesha kwebhokisi lamathuluzi okuhlela ngayo amathuluzi uze uthayiphe
Igridi yamathuluzi: isakhiwo sayo, amakholomu kanye nokukhasi

Ukuhleleka kwakho ukuhleleka okwenzayo ngokuhudula amathuluzi uzungeze ibhokisi lamathuluzi. Okusetshenziswa kakhulu kubeka amathuluzi owavula kaningi kuqala. Okusetshenziswe muva nje kubeka ithuluzi olivule okokugcina kuqala. Amathuluzi ongakaze uwavule eza ngemuva kwawo, ngokuhleleka kwakho. Ibhokisi lamathuluzi lizihlela njalo uma livuleka, ngakho amathuluzi awanyakazi ngenkathi uwathinta. Ifolda ihlala lapho ithuluzi layo lokuqala liwela khona, futhi igcina ukuhleleka kwayo ngaphakathi. Ukuhudula ithuluzi kusashintsha ukuhleleka kwakho, futhi ukuthola emuva uma ukhetha Ukuhleleka kwakho futhi.
Beka amathuluzi ngokulandelana kwakho, noma lawo owasebenzisa kuqala
Khetha ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingenza ikhibhodi yenze
Misa okwesikhashana noma qala kabusha isipele nokuvumelanisa okuhleliwe
Qala ukwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni endaweni eyabelwe ukwenza ikhophi eyizenzakalelayo

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ocingweni zingathumela imiyalo yekhibhodi, isibonelo ukushintsha ulimi noma itimu. Isikrini sezenzo ezivumelekile (Allowed actions) sibeka ukuthi imiphi imiyalo esebenzayo. Uma lokhu kucishiwe, ikhibhodi ayiwunaki wonke umyalo.
Yamukela imiyalo evela ku-adb, Tasker nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizenzakalelayo
Vumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zilawule ikhibhodi
Vula noma uvale umsindo nokudlidliza kokhiye
Ngayinye yalezi yenza okufanayo nokulawula okukhibhodi, futhi ungakuhlehlisa. Zivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Lokhu kushintsha lokho ikhibhodi ekwaziyo, ukuthayipha ezinhlelweni, noma ukutshela ezinye izinhlelo lokho okwenzayo. Zivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Vula eyodwa kuphela ngokuzenzakalelayo okuzisethele yona.
Yeka ukufunda kuze kube imodi yokuphila ngasese icishiwe futhi
Tshela zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza ezilaleleyo uma ulimi noma ukulungiseka kushintsha
Setha, jikelezisa, futhi ufake ohlwini izakhiwo ozivulile
Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza azikwazi ukulawula ikhibhodi manje. Lokhu kukhetha kusebenza kuphela uma okuthi Vumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zilawule ikhibhodi kuvuliwe.
Okujwayelekile, ngesandla esisodwa, okuhlukanisiwe noma okuntantayo
Izinhlelo zokusebenza zingathumela imiyalo evuliwe kuphela
Bonisa ikhibhodi, futhi uyigcine esikrinini noma uyimise
Thayipha umbhalo noma isiqeshana enkundleni esetshenziswayo. Ungalokothi ukwenze enkundleni yephasiwedi
Engeza amagama esichazamazwini sakho, noma vimba amagama eziphakamisweni
Kopisha amagama akho kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android, ukuze uwasebenzise kwamanye amakhibhodi kanye nesihloli sokupela
Engeza amagama alondolozwe kusichazamazwi somuntu siqu se-Android
Wonke amagama asesichazamazwini sakho somuntu siqu asevele esesichazamazwini se-Android.
Wonke amagama asesichazamazwini se-Android asevele esesichazamazwini sakho somuntu siqu.
I-Android yabelana kuphela ngesichazamazwi sayo somuntu siqu nekhibhodi esetshenziswayo. Yenza i-WM Keyboard ibe ikhibhodi yakho yamanje, bese uzama futhi.

Lokhu yikho okuhlale kwenziwa uhlelo lokusebenza. Kucime uma ungavamile ukushaja idivayisi yakho isikhathi eside ngokwanele, ngoba isipele esingalutholi ishaja asikaze sisebenze, futhi akukho okukutshela ukuthi asisebenzanga. Umsebenzi ngokwawo uthatha imizuzwana embalwa ukukopisha, ngakho udla ibhethri elincane.
Linda kuze kube yilapho idivayisi yakho ixhunyiwe
I-akhawunti yakho ye-Google, endaweni yohlelo lokusebenza eyimfihlo ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingakwazi ukuyifunda
I-akhawunti yakho ye-Dropbox, kufolda yohlelo lokusebenza
Ifolda kudivayisi yakho, noma leyo enikezwe olunye uhlelo lokusebenza lokugcina
Iseva ye-FTP. Idinga umsingathi, igama lomsebenzisi kanye nephasiwedi
Ilayibhrari yangasese ku-GitHub, GitLab, Gitea noma Forgejo. Idinga ithokheni
Ifolda ku-akhawunti yakho ye-imeyili. Idinga iseva ye-IMAP nephasiwedi
Ikhompyutha ene-WM Keyboard, nge-KDE Connect kunethiwekhi efanayo. Yenziwe uma uyibhangqa
I-akhawunti yakho yakwa-Microsoft, kufolda yohlelo lokusebenza
Ibhakede ku-AWS, R2, B2 noma i-MinIO. Lidinga ukhiye kanye nemfihlo
Iseva ye-SSH. Idinga umsingathi, igama lomsebenzisi, nephasiwedi noma ukhiye
Ifolda eyabelwe kwikhompyutha yeWindows noma i-NAS
Iseva yakho, efana ne-Nextcloud. Idinga i-URL, igama lomsebenzisi kanye nephasiwedi
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhale %1$s. Lushiye %2$s, ngoba isipele besikhulu kakhulu.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lungabhala kufolda yalo ku-Drive yakho.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhalela kufolda efihliwe yalo ku-Drive yakho. Ayikwazi ukubona amanye amafayela akho, futhi ifolda ayiveli eceleni kwemibhalo yakho. Ukuze ubuyise le mvume, hamba ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google bese uvula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifinyelela ku-akhawunti. Uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwe-Drive lungaphinda lubonise le folda: khetha ifolda kokuthi Ifolda ngenhla esikhundleni salokho uma ufuna ukubona amafayela.
Uhlelo lokusebenza ludinga imvume yakho kuqala.

Uhlelo lokusebenza luthola ifolda yalo ngaphakathi kwe-Dropbox yakho futhi alikwazi ukubona okunye. Ungathola ifolda ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, futhi ungayisusa. Ukuze ubuyise le mvume, vula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezixhunyiwe ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Dropbox.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubhala isipele ngenkathi idivayisi yakho ishaja.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcina iphasiwedi kule divayisi, ngoba isipele esizenzakalelayo asinawo umuntu ozoyithayipha. Lokhu kuvikela ifayela lesipele lapho liya khona, isibonelo kufolda yefu. Akuyivikeli kumuntu ophethe idivayisi yakho evuliwe. Bhala phansi iphasiwedi: ngaphandle kwayo, isipele asikwazi ukubuyiselwa.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lubethela isipele ngasinye. Udinga iphasiwedi ukuze ubuyisele esisodwa.
Isipele sokugcina asiphelanga. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzama futhi kamuva.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alusakwazi ukubhala kufolda yakho yokulondoloza. Khetha ifolda futhi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lulahlekelwe ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti yakho. Ngena futhi.
Iseva ayizange yamukele imininingwane yokungena. Zihlole.
Asikho isikhala esanele sokwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuthola ifolda yakho yokwenza isipele. Kungenzeka isusiwe, noma ikhadi lingase lingekho.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuthola indawo yokwenza isipele. Hlola imininingwane yale ndawo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza aluzange lubhale lapha, ngoba indawo ayiphephile.

Idizibhodi (repository) isesidlangalaleni. Noma ubani angayifunda ikhophi eyisipele (backup) ekuyo, futhi umlando wayo ugcina zonke izipele zakudala. Yenza idizibhodi ibe yimfihlo, noma vula ukukhetha kokuthi Vumela idizibhodi yasesidlangalaleni.

Ukhiye weseva ushintshile kusukela ekuxhumekeni kokuqala. Lokhu kungaba iseva entsha, noma idivayisi evimbela ukuxhumana kwakho. Uma ushintshe iseva, vula le ndawo bese ukhetha ukukhohlwa ukhiye weseva.
Iseva ayikwazi ukubethela ukuxhumana. Vala ukubethela ukuxhumana kuphela uma uthemba yonke idivayisi kule nethiwekhi.
Ngaphandle kwe-TLS, iphasiwedi yakho kanye nesipele sakho konke kuwela inethiwekhi njengombhalo ocacile noma ubani ophakathi angafunda. Vula iphasiwedi ngezansi uma kufanele ushiye lokhu kuvaliwe.
Kushiye kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise umkhombandlela ofika kuwo ngemva kokungena ngemvume.
Ibethela uxhumano ngaphambi kokuba uhlelo lokusebenza lungene ngemvume. Ishiye ivuliwe ngaphandle uma iseva yakho ingakwazi ukukwenza.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lususa isipele esidala kakhulu uma kukhona okungaphezu kwalokhu. Luhlala lugcina esisha kakhulu.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukwenza isipele ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe. Yivule bese uzama futhi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukakwenzi ukwenza ikhophi yasenqolobaneni ezenzakalelayo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukuqeda ukungena ngemvume. Zama futhi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukuvula isiphequluli ukuze ungene ngemvume.

Uhlelo lokusebenza luthola ifolda yalo ngaphakathi kwe-OneDrive yakho futhi alukwazi ukubona okunye. Ungayithola ifolda ngaphansi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza (Apps). Ukuze uhoxise le mvume, vula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ku-akhawunti yakho yakwa-Microsoft.

Lokhu kusekelayo kuqukethe amagama owathayiphile, noma umbhalo owukopishe, futhi ayikho iphasiwedi evikelayo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lulubhala kufolda yakho ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Vula iphasiwedi, noma uvale isichazamazwi kanye nebhodi lokunamathisela ngenhla.
Iphasiwedi eyodwa ivikela izipele ezizenzakalelayo namafayela okuvumelanisa. Sebenzisa iphasiwedi efanayo kuyo yonke idivayisi evumelanisayo.
Le ndawo yokugcina ayiyona i-https. Uhlelo lokusebenza lusayina isicelo ngasinye ngokhiye wakho oyimfihlo, futhi ekhelini le-http elivamile noma ubani kunethiwekhi angafunda lokho okuthunyelwayo.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ku-Amazon S3. Kwezinye izinsiza, faka ikheli lazo lapha, isibonelo https://your-account.r2.cloudflarestorage.com noma ikheli leseva yakho ye-MinIO.
Vula lokhu nge-MinIO, nanoma yiliphi ikheli eliyikheli le-IP. Likushiye livaliwe nge-Amazon S3 ne-Cloudflare R2.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ubeke izipele phezulu kwebhakede.
Sebenzisa i-us-east-1 uma isevisi yakho ingenazo izifunda.
Akukho okufanele kwenziwe isipele. Khetha okungenani ingxenye eyodwa ngenhla.

Izipele okufanele zigcinwe zibala izipele ezintsha kakhulu. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, uhlelo lokusebenza luphinde lulondoloze ezinye ezindala esikhundleni sokuzisusa: isipele esisha kakhulu sezinsuku eziyisi-7 ezedlule, samasonto ama-5 ezedlule, kanye nezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ezedlule. Lokho kungamafayela angaphezu kwama-24, futhi ambalwa lapho isipele esisodwa simelela amaningi awo. Ukulungiselelwa okushintshile ngephutha ngenyanga edlule kungabuyiselwa emuva, ngaphandle kokugcina izipele zansuku zonke zenyanga yonke ukuze ukwenze. Iminyaka ibalwa kusukela kusipele sakho esisha kakhulu, ngakho ifoni eyeka ukwenza isipele isikhashana igcina amakhophi ayo amadala kuze kube yilapho amasha ewathatha indawo. Lokhu kulungiselelwa kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Futhi gcina eyodwa ngosuku isonto lonke, eyodwa ngeviki amasonto amahlanu neyodwa ngenyanga unyaka wonke
Isipele ngasinye esizenzakalelayo siya kuzo zonke izindawo ozikhethayo lapha. Indawo ongayikhethi igcina izilungiselelo zayo, futhi ayitholi zipele uze uyikhethe futhi.
Faka indawo kusikrini sokwenza isipele nokubuyisela kuqala.

Isipele singaba ama-megabyte ambalwa, futhi siphuma njalo uma isikhathi sifika. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, uhlelo lokusebenza lulinda i-Wi-Fi, noma okunye ukuxhumana i-Android engakubali njengokulinganiselwe. Uma kucishiwe, isipele siphuma ngedatha yeselula ngokushesha nje lapho sesifanele. Lesi silungiselelo asenzi lutho uma wenza isipele kufolda, ngoba ifolda iyisitoreji kudivayisi yakho futhi ayidingi ukuxhumana nhlobo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Leli kheli akusilo i-https. Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela igama lakho lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi yakho ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ulayisha, kanti ekhelini elinjenge-http nje, noma ubani kunethiwekhi angakwazi ukuzifunda, ngakho-ke uhlelo lokusebenza alulusebenzisi.
Uma iseva yakho ikwazi ukwenza amaphasiwedi ohlelo lokusebenza, sebenzisa elilodwa lapha esikhundleni sephasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho.
Ikheli eliphelele lefolda ozobhalela kuyo, isibonelo https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/backups
Shiya kungenalutho kuseva engafuni ukuthi ungene
Wonke amagama asohlwini lwabavinjelwe ayasuswa futhi angaphinde aphakanyiswe. Amagama owafundise ikhibhodi awathinteki.
Awekho amagama kulolu hlu okwamanje. Engeza igama ngenhla.
Ikhibhodi ayiphakamisi la magama futhi ayiwacacisi kuwo. Usengakwazi ukuwathayipha futhi uwathumele. Ahlala ngaphandle komugqa wokusikisela. Ukufana akubheki izinhlamvu ezinkulu.
Leli gama aliphakanyiswa neze, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ufake luphi ulimi.
Igama aliphakanyiswa neze olimini obulubhala. Ezinye izilimi zisaliphakamisa.

Ukucindezela nokubamba isiphakamiso bese ukhetha Ungaphakamisi kuvimba igama. Lokhu kunquma ukuthi liyavinjwa yini kuzo zonke izilimi noma kulimi obulubhala kuphela. Amagama owengeza kulesi sikrini azobuzwa njalo.
Lapho igama olivimbayo elithi Ungaphakamisi lisebenza khona
Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje. Amagama avela njengoba uthayipha, uma \"Funda ekuthayipheni\" kuvuliwe ku-Privacy. Ungaphinda ungeze igama ngenhla.
Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama embhalweni owuthayiphayo. Ungakwazi futhi ukwengeza amagama ngokwakho. Ikhibhodi iphakamisa lawa magama futhi ayiwacishi. Wonke ahlala kudivayisi yakho.

Izipele ziya kule folda, futhi ungazivula kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Drive. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungabona kuphela amafayela eliwenzile, hhayi amanye amafayela akho. Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukubona ifolda yaleli gama oyenzile wena, ngakho lenza eyalo. Ukuze ubuyise le mvume, iya ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Google bese uvula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifinyelela ku-akhawunti.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luthumele isipele ngezihluthulelo zakho ze-API kuso. Gcina lelo fayela liphephile njengephasiwedi.

Isipele esivela ku-HeliBoard, LeanType, FUTO Keyboard, FlorisBoard, CleverKeys noma AnySoftKeyboard
Isipele sesibili, esincane esineshejuli yaso, ezindaweni ezifanayo

Isipele sesibili esizenzakalelayo eceleni kwesikhulu, esinohlelo lwaso, izigaba kanye nenani lamakhophi. Sisebenzisele lokho okushintsha njalo futhi okuncane, njengezilungiselelo zakho nezakhiwo, njalo ngehora, bese ushiya izinto ezinkulu nezomuntu siqu esipeleni esikhulu kanye ngosuku. Iya ezindaweni ezifanayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo, futhi ukumisa isipele kuyayimisa nayo. Amafayela ayo aqanjwe ngokuhlukile, ngakho uhlobo ngalunye lugcina amakhophi alo, futhi uhlu lokubuyisela lubonisa womabili. Ayikaze ifake okhiye be-API.
I-PersonalDictionary.zip evela ku-Export ye-Gboard. Amagama ayo eza lapha, futhi izinqamuleli zayo ziba yiziqeshana
Noma ubani angawufunda umsebenzi oyisipele endaweni yokugcina yomphakathi
Shiya umbhali engenalutho ukuze usebenzise i-akhawunti yethokheni.
Kushiye kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise igatsha elizenzakalelayo.

Isipele ngasinye nesipele esidala esisusiwe ngasinye siwukuzibophezela. Umlando wendawo yokugcina uwugcina wonke. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwenqaba indawo yokugcina yomphakathi. Vula i-Vikela nge-passphrase kusipele esizenzakalelayo.

Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise phezulu kwereposithori.

Noma ubani angayifunda isipele kusilondolozi esesidlangalaleni, futhi umlando waso ugcina yonke isipele endala ngemva kokuba uhlelo lokusebenza isisusile. Vula ukuvikeleka nge-passphrase kusipele Esizenzakalelayo.
Umnikazi negama, isibonelo me/keyboard-backups. Ungakwazi futhi ukunamathisela ikheli lendawo yokugcina.
Kushiye kungenalutho ku-%1$s. Kuseva yakho, thayipha ikheli layo.
Ivimbela isipele ukuthi singaqali i-CI yendawo yokugcina
Ithokheni yokufinyelela enokufunda nokubhala kwizindawo zokugcina.
Ithokheni elinesizotha lale repo kuphela, elinokumiswa kokuthi Okuqukethwe kusethelwe ku-Funda nokubhala.
Ithokheni yokufinyelela yephrojekthi enebanga le-api nendima Yomthuthukisi.
Ngaphandle kwe-TLS, iphasiwedi yakho nesipele sakho kuwela inethiwekhi njengombhalo ocacile ongawufunda yinoma ubani ophakathi.
Iseva ye-IMAP yesevisi yakho yeposi, isibonelo imap.gmail.com
Isipele ngasinye siyiyimeyili eyodwa kule folda. Ezinye izinsiza, njenge-Gmail, zigcina i-imeyili esusiwe kwenye ifolda, ngakho izipele ezindala zingase zisasebenzisa isikhala ku-akhawunti yakho.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lwakha le folda. Gcina izipele kuyo kuphela, ngoba uhlelo lokusebenza lususa izipele ezindala kuyo.
Izinsizakalo eziningi zeposi zidinga iphasiwedi yohlelo lokusebenza lapha. Yenza eyodwa kuzilungiselelo zokuphepha ze-akhawunti yakho.
Ifayela linokhiye be-API. Bathatha indawo yokhiye obasethile lapha.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luhlanganisa izilungiselelo nezilungiselelo zakho zamanje. Isichazamazwi, ibhodi lokunamathisela kanye neziqephu zithatha indawo yalezo ezikudivayisi yakho.

Ayikho kule fayela, ngakho ishiywe njengoba injalo: %1$s. Ifayela liphethe kuphela izingxenye ezikhethiwe ngesikhathi lenziwa, futhi isipele esizenzakalelayo, ukuvumelanisa nokuthumela kufayela ngalinye linohlu lwalo lwezingxenye.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukufunda lelo fayela.

resources.string: Lolu uhlu lwamakheli kuphela. Ama-add-on ngokwawo aya ezigabeni ezingenhla. Ingqikithi efakiwe iyisihloko sangokwezifiso, futhi iphakethe elifakiwe liyiphakethe lezithonjana.
Imithombo yezengezo oyengezile, ukuze ukwazi ukuyifaka futhi kusuka kuyo
Kuvaliwe ngaphandle uma ukuvula. Lawa maqiniso avela ezingxoxweni zakho, ngakho isipele esiwaphethe siyimfihlo njengezingxoxo. Ukuvumelanisa akukaze kuwathwale kuya kwenye ifoni.
Okukhunjulwa i-AI ngawe, kusuka ku-Izilungiselelo › I-AI › Imemori
Izithombe zakho eziphiniwe kanye nemibhalo yakho yakamuva. Ifayela lishiya ngaphandle izithombe namafayela, ngoba ahlala kudivayisi yakho futhi awavuleki kwenye idivayisi.

Izibali-sikhathi ezisebenzayo, isitophuwashi nomlando kuhlala kule foni. Ukuvumelanisa (Sync) kuyayishiya iwashi ngaphandle ngaphandle uma uyivula, ukuze amafoni amabili angakhali ngenxa ye-alamu eyodwa.
Ama-alamu, amasethingi esikhathi, ukubala wehla nezilungiselelo zewashi
Amagama akho siqu kanye namaphethini akho amagama alandelayo. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ekuqaleni, ngoba lena idatha yokubhala yomuntu siqu. Yivule ukuze uthole isipele ozigcinela sona.
I-emoji yakho yakamuva, izinto ozithandayo kanye nethoni yesikhumba yeyodwa ngayinye
Isipele siphethe amafayela e-SVG, ngakho ukubuyisela kwesinye isisetshenziswa kuthola amaphakethe asebenzayo. Lokhu kwenza ifayela libe likhulu.
Umtapo wakho we-kaomoji: ubuso obungezile, amathegi awo, ukulandelana kanye nezintandokazi zakho

Amanothi akhiyiwe ahlala ngaphandle kwefayela ngaphandle uma okuthi Faka okhiye be-API kuvuliwe. Ifayela lokulondoloza kulula ukwabelana ngalo, futhi inothi elikhiyiwe yilelo ocelile ukuba lingabonwa.
Amanothi akho, amathegi awo, nalokho okusemgqonyeni kadoti
Okhiye bokuhumusha, i-GIF, ukusesha kanye ne-AI
Izibalo zakho zokuthayipha zansuku zonke kanye nesivinini sakho sonke isikhathi
Isipele sibamba izithombe, ngakho ukubuyisela kwenye idivayisi kuthola amaphakethe asebenzayo. Lokhu kungangeza ama-megabyte kufayela. Emaphakethe owodwa, ifayela le-.wmstickers lincane.
Indlela oswayipha ngayo: lapho umunwe wakho uhlala khona, okufundwayo okulungisile, kanye nesimo osidweba igama ngalinye. Kubamba amagama owaswayiphile.
Imibala, ama-gradient kanye nesakhiwo sezindikimba zakho ezilondoloziwe. Ifayela aliphethe isithombe sangemuva setimu. Liphethe itimu uqobo lwayo kuphela.
Imisebenzi yakho nezinyathelo zayo, ezenziwe noma cha
Izinhlu zakho zamagama, amaphakethe angenisiwe kanye nenqubekelaphambili yokufunda. Amaphakethe alandiwe ashiyiwe; angalandwa futhi.
Izinhlu zamagama ozingenisile zanoma yiluphi ulimi

Londoloza ikhibhodi yakho efayelini. Ungagcina ifayela, ulithuthele kwenye idivayisi, noma ubuyisele kulo ngemva kokufaka uhlelo lokusebenza futhi. Khetha okungena efayelini ngezansi. Ungafaka noma ushiye ngaphandle izilungiselelo, izingqikithi, isichazamazwi sakho esifundiwe, umlando webhodi lokunamathisela kanye neziqephu.
Ifolda, iseva yakho, noma i-akhawunti yefu
Uhlelo lokusebenza lwakha le folda uma ingekho.
Akuphoqiwe. Ngokwesibonelo, ikhadi le-SD noma amakhophi efoni.
Ongakukhetha. Isibonelo, isitoreji se-NAS noma se-Router.
Akuphoqelekile. Ngokwesibonelo, i-R2 bucket noma i-Work AWS.
Ongakukhetha. Isibonelo, Iseva yasekhaya noma i-VPS.
Ongakukhetha. Isibonelo, i-NAS noma i-PC yasehhovisi.
Okuzikhethela. Isibonelo, i-Nextcloud noma iseva yasekhaya.
Lokhu kwakhiwa akukwazi ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi, ngakho-ke akukwazi ukufinyelela kule ndawo. Ifolda esefonini isasebenza.
Izipele ezivele zikhona zizohlala lapho. Uhlelo lokusebenza luyeka ukubhala kule ndawo futhi luyakhohlwa indlela yokungena kuyo.

Isipele ngasinye esizenzakalelayo siya ezindaweni ozikhethayo kusipele esizenzakalelayo. Ukuvumelanisa kusebenzisa izindawo ozikhethayo kumadivayisi wokuvumelanisa. Akukho okuthunyelwa kuseva ye-WM Keyboard.
Lelo fayela akulona isipele sekhibhodi ye-WM.
Lelo fayela akulona isipele sezilungiselelo ze-WM Keyboard.
Yeqa izipele ezihleliwe okwesikhashana. Izindawo, ishejuli nephasiwedi kuhlala kunjalo
Kuze kube yilapho uqala kabusha. Thepha ukuze uqale kabusha
Kuze kube ngu-%1$s. Thepha ukuze uqhubeke
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukulanda lokho okusekwayo. Zama futhi.
Lolu hlu lubonisa izipele zayo yonke idivayisi esebenzisa le ndawo. Idivayisi ngayinye igcina futhi isuse izipele zayo kuphela.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukusebenzisa leyo chedi (backup). Izilungiselelo zakho azishintshanga.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukusebenzisa izilungiselelo. Izilungiselelo zakho azishintshanga.
Isiphathi sendawo yokuya kuyo (endpoint host) esivela kukhonsoli yesevisi, ngaphandle kwe-https://
Siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi uvule i-Vikela nge-passphrase kuqala

Ayikho iphasiwedi evikela la mafayela. Noma ubani ongavula indawo angafunda izikhiye ze-API kanye namaphasiwedi akho, bese ewasebenzisa. Siphakamisa ngokuqinile ukuthi uvule Vikela ngephasiwedi ekulondolozeni okuzenzakalelayo (Automatic backup) kuqala.
Uyafuna ukufaka okhiye ngaphandle kwegama eliyimfihlo?
Uhlelo lokusebenza lulondoloza ukhiye weseva ekuxhumekeni kokuqala, futhi ngemva kwalokho luxhuma kuphela kuseva enokhiye ofanayo. Khetha Hlola ukuxhumana ukuze ulilondoloze manje.
Ozikhethela wona. Namathisela ukhiye wangasese ophelele we-OpenSSH noma we-PEM: Ed25519, ECDSA, noma i-RSA. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzozama ukusebenzisa ukhiye ngaphambi kwephasiwedi.
Iphinde inikeze i-SHA-1, yamadivayisi amadala e-NAS. Gcina lokhu kucishiwe ngaphandle uma ukuxhumana kwehluleka ngaphandle kwakho.
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho uma usebenzisa ukhiye.
Kushiye kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise ifolda yakho yasekhaya. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwakha ifolda uma ingekho lapho.

Ngaphandle kokubethela, isipele sakho siwela inethiwekhi njengama-byte acacile. Ukungena ngemvume kuhlala kuvikelekile. Uma kufanele ukugcine lokhu kucishiwe, vula i-Vikela nge-passphrase kusipele esizenzakalelayo.
Ngokuvamile akunalutho. Okwekhompyutha esesizindeni se-Windows kuphela.
Idinga i-SMB 3. Cisha lokhu kuphela kuseva endala engakwazi ukubethela.
Ifolda ekwabelanweni. Shiya le ndawo ingenalutho ukuze usebenzise phezulu kwesabelo. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzodala ifolda uma ingekho lapho.
Igama lesabelo kuphela. Ukuze uthole i-\nasbackups, thayipha i-backups.

plurals.name: backup_sync_done_changes
plurals.item: Kuvumelanisiwe. %1$d ushintsho luvele kwamanye amadivayisi akho.
Kuvumelanisiwe. %1$d ushintsho luvele kwamanye amadivayisi akho.

resources.string: Enye idivayisi isebenzisa iphasiwedi ehlukile. Sebenzisa iphasiwedi efanayo kuwo wonke amadivayisi.

Idivayisi ngayinye igcina ifayela elilodwa lokuvumelanisa endaweni ethile. Yonke idivayisi ifunda amafayela kweminye, futhi ushintsho olusha kakhulu kusilungiselelo ngasinye luyawina. Okokuqala lapho idivayisi ivumelanisa, izilungiselelo zamanye amadivayisi akho ziyawina, futhi noma yini enale divayisi kuphela iya kweminye.
Eqenjini elisha, le divaysi i-sync sengathi ingokokuqala ngqa: izilungiselelo zeqembu ziyawina, futhi nanoma yini enale divaysi kuphela iyathunyelwa eqenjini.
Ayikho enye idivayisi evumelanisa kulezi zindawo okwamanje.

Sebenzisa iqembu lapho abantu abambalwa babelana ngendawo eyodwa, njengefolda yomndeni. Nikeza wonke amadivayisi akho igama leqembu elifanayo, bese ukhetha igama elihlukile kwabanye abantu. Amadivayisi avumelanisa kuphela namadivayisi aseqenjini lawo, kanti amadivayisi angenalo iqembu avumelanisa wodwa. Iqembu liphinde livele eduze kwesipele ngasinye uma ubuyisela.
Amanye amadivayisi avumelanisa ku-%1$s, emaqenjini le divayisi engekho kuwo. Khetha iqembu ozojoyina kulo, noma gcina iqembu lale divayisi.
Ayikho. Ivumelanisa namadivayisi lapha angenalo iqembu
Izinhlamvu, izinombolo kanye nemigqa, kufika ku-12. Yishiye ingenalutho uma ungekho iqembu
Izakhiwo ozishintshayo phakathi, izilimi ezengeziwe, nesakhiwo sohlelo ngalunye lokusebenza

Izilungiselelo ozikhethayo lapha zihlala zinjengoba zinjalo kule divayisi. Izinguquko ozenzayo kuzo lapha azithunyelwa, futhi izinguquko ezivela kwamanye amadivayisi akho azithathwa. Ungakhethi eyodwa kamuva bese le divayisi ithatha lokho amanye amadivayisi akho anakho.
Itimu esetshenziswayo, ekhanyayo nemnyama, nokuthi ishintsha nini. Izindikimba zakho zisavumelanisa
Yimaphi amathuluzi, ngaluphi uhlelo, nokuthi abukeka kanjani

Ezinye izilungiselelo zihlala kudivayisi ngayinye, ngoba zifanele leyo divayisi kuphela: usayizi nesikhundla sekhibhodi, imodi yesandla esisodwa, ikhibhodi yehadiwe, amakhompyutha abhangqiwe kanye nokukhiya uhlelo lokusebenza. Ukuze ugcine okwengeziwe kule divayisi, sebenzisa okuthi Gcina kule divayisi ngezansi.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukuvumelanisa ngenkathi idivayisi ikhiyiwe. Yivule bese uzama futhi.
Kuphela uma ucindezela okuthi Vumelanisa manje
Ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Isebenzisa idatha encane kakhulu.
Cishe emuva kweminithi elilodwa uma ushintshe okuthile, futhi njalo ngehora uma kukhona izinguquko ezivela kwamanye amadivaysi
Gcina ikhibhodi yakho ifana kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho

Ikhompyutha ebhangqiwe iba indawo lapha, Idivayisi eseduze, futhi imakwe. Vumelanisa le divayisi ivuliwe nayo. Lezi zimbili zithumelana amafayela azo okuvumelanisa ngenkathi zombili zikunethiwekhi efanayo futhi ikhibhodi ivuliwe.
Ikhompyutha enekhibhodi ye-WM oyibhangqa nge-KDE Connect iyavumelanisa nalo foni
Siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi uvule ukuvikelwa ngephasiwedi ku-Automatic backup kuqala
Akukho okufanele kuvunyelaniswe. Khetha okungenani indawo eyodwa nengxenye eyodwa esikrinini samadivayisi wokuvumelanisa.

Amadivayisi akho kumele abelane okungenani ngendawo eyodwa kulezi. Uma ukhetha ngaphezu kweyodwa, uhlelo lokusebenza lubhala ifayela lokuvumelanisa kwelinye ngalinye lazo, ukuze ukuvumelanisa kuqhubeke kusebenza ngenkathi enye isevisi ingasebenzi. Lokho kusebenzisa idatha eyengeziwe.
Kudatha yeselula, ukuvumelanisa kulinda i-Wi-Fi. Ukuvumelanisa manje kusasebenza

Amagama angu-%1$d lapha asevele ekuhlu lwamagama, ngakho ikhibhodi iyawazi ngaphandle kwaleli khophi. Iyakhohlwa ukuthi uwathayiphe kangaki. Amagama anezinhlamvu ezinkulu eziphiniwe ayagcinwa, kanjalo nezinguquko zokubeka ezenziwe ekhadini lamagama.

resources.string: Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukuqeda ukungena ku-Nextcloud. Hlola igama leseva, noma thayipha igama lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi yohlelo lokusebenza.
Njengoba i-Tailscale ikubonisa: i-tailnet yakho, ikhompyutha, negama lokwabelana, isibonelo example.ts.net/laptop/wmkeyboard
Leli kheli likunethiwekhi yakho ye-Tailscale. I-http elula, kodwa i-Tailscale ibhala yonke into phakathi kwamadivayisi akho. I-Tailscale kufanele ixhumeke kule foni.
Ukuthayipha igama elinonhlamvu ezinkulu akushintshi indlela elipelwe ngayo
Igama olifaka ngaphansi kolimi olulodwa linikezwa kancane ngenkathi uthayipha olunye. Ukulithayipha kwenye indawo akulinyakazisi.
Thayipha lokhu bese igama linikezwa njengesiphakamiso
Faka inombolo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-%1$d.
Isisindo esiphezulu senza ikhibhodi iphakamise leli gama ngokushesha. Igama olengezayo liqala ku-200.
Isiqeshana osinamathisayo emlandweni siqala kuwo, bese sibuyela kubhodi lokunamathisela lesistimu

Ngalolu sethingi luvaliwe, cindezela ubambe isiqeshana ukuze usiphine noma usisuse kokuvelayo. Ikhadi liphinde lilahlekelwe umugqa obubekwe kuwo izinkinobho, ngaphandle uma umugqa usakhombisa inombolo yesiqeshana, isikhathi saso noma ithegi yombhalo ocebile, ukuze iziqeshana eziningi zilingane ephanelini. Lolu sethingi luvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa iphinikhodi nethini kuyo yonke ikhadi lokunamathisela

Uphawu lokuhlela lubonisa ipensela kusiqeshana osihlele, futhi alwenzi lutho uma lucindezelwe. Okuthi \'Akukho\' kuyakufihla. Okuthi \'Hlela\' kubeka inkinobho yokuhlela kuso sonke isiqeshana ongasihlela, ukuze ungadingi ukucindezela ubambe isiqeshana kuqala. Okuthi \'Khetha\' kuqala ukukhetha iziqeshana ngaleyo, ukuze uhlanganise, uhlele noma ususe. Ikhodi ye-QR ibeka inkinobho ye-QR kuso sonke isiqeshana sombhalo, evula ithuluzi lekhodi ye-QR embhalweni wesiqeshana, elungele ukuthunyelwa njengesithombe. Uphawu lokuhlela luyisinqumo esizenzakalelayo.

I-chip ivela emgqeni weziphakamiso ngemva kokuba ukopishe okuthile, ukuze ukwazi ukukunamathisela ngaphandle kokuvula ibhodi lokunamathisela. Ukuthayipha akuyisusi, ngoba kuhloselwe ukuhlala ngesikhathi ubhala umlayezo ozowunamathisela kuwo. Setha isikhathi esifushane uma ungathanda ukuthi lokho okukopishe kungenzeki esikrinini, okubalulekile ngephasiwedi noma ikheli. Ungahlala ususa i-chip ngokwakho.
Isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba i-chip ekopishwe muva nje izifihle
Ukuthi i-paste chip ihlala isikhathi esingakanani

Isixhumanisi ngasinye ekukopisheni silahlekelwa amapharamitha ombuzo alandelela kuphela lapho sabelwe khona, afanayo nalawa asuswa ukususa abalandeleli kubha yokukhetha, namagama akho ngezansi. Amasayithi afana ne-Amazon, YouTube, X, TikTok ne-Google alahlekelwa abalandeleli abangeza bona ngokwabo, futhi isixhumanisi sokuqondisa kabusha (i-/url ye-Google, i-l.php ye-Facebook, isixhumanisi esiphephile se-Outlook) siba isixhumanisi esiya kuso. Okusele kwesixhumanisi, kanye nokunye kombhalo, kuhlala kunjengoba bekunjalo. Isixhumanisi esihlanzekile sibuyiselwa kubhodi yokunamathisela yesistimu, ngakho imenyu yokunamathisela yohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye iyayithola nayo. Cindezela okuthi Hlehlisa ngemva nje kokuyinamathisela ukuze uthole isixhumanisi njengoba usikopishe. Isiqeshana uhlelo lwaso olumakwe njengephasiwedi asishintshiwe neze. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
I-utm_source, fbclid nokunye okufana nakho kuyasuswa kuso sonke isixhumanisi osikopishayo, ngakho konke okunamathiselwayo kuhlanzekile
Umudada ubuza ngaphambi kokususa. Ama-clip aphiniwe ahlala njalo. Uma i-Undo ye-clip esusiwe ivuliwe, ibha ye-Undo ibuyisela zonke iziqeshana. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa umgqomo eceleni kwebha yokusesha osusa zonke iziqeshana ezingaphiniwe

Izikholamu eziningi zibonisa iziqeshana eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, okufanele umbhalo omfushane. Ezimbalwa zinika ikhadi ngalinye indawo eyengeziwe, okufanele umbhalo omude nezithombe. Isakhiwo sohlu sihlala sibonisa isiqeshana esisodwa emgqeni ngamunye. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-2.

Ukukopisha okude kwelula i-chip yokunamathisela kulo lonke umugqa noma nini lapho kungekho magama aboniswayo, okufihla amathuluzi aseduze kwayo. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, i-chip ihlala isesimweni sayo esincane, cishe ingxenye yesithathu yomugqa, ukuze okunye okusemugqeni kuhlale kufinyeleleka. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Gcina i-chip yokunamathisela incane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukukopisha kude kangakanani

Uphina isiqeshana ukuze usigcine, ngakho ukulahlekelwa esisodwa ngokuthepha okungalungile emgqonyeni waso noma ukuslayida okwenziwe ngenkathi uskrola kubiza kakhulu kunokulahlekelwa esinye isiqeshana. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, ukususa isiqeshana esiphiniwe kuphaneli kubonisa umbuzo kuqala, futhi i-Delete kuphela esisusayo. Iziqeshana ezingaphiniwe zisuswa ngokushesha, njengakuqala. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Iphethini ivumela isiqeshana esisodwa ukuthi sithathe ucezu lombhalo oluhlukile njalo. Nikeza isiqeshana iphethini ^hello (.+)$ kanye nombhalo \"Hello, $1! Namathisela isixhumanisi sephakheji ye-Espanso noma ifayela lokufanisa.
Ifayela le-.yml okufanele lifakwe kufolda yomdlalo ye-Espanso kukhompyutha.
Igcina konke, okuhlanganisa amafolda nokuthi yiziphi iziqeshana ezibuza kuqala.
I-.zip ongayifaka kukhompyutha noma wabelane ngayo nabanye.
Bonisa isiqeshana ngasinye kuphaneli ngesihloko saso kuphela, ngaphandle kombhalo waso, ukuze kunge njengezingxenye eziningi
Ikheli le-https lekhasi lephakheji le-Espanso, noma isixhumanisi esiqondile sefayela le-.yml noma le-.zip.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda ifayela lesiqeshana kulelo kheli.
lapho ukhona, kusuka kuthuluzi lendawo. Engeza :link, :address, :coordinates, :dms, :plus_code noma :message ngefomethi eyodwa
indawo oyigcine kuthuluzi lendawo, ngegama. Ifomethi ingalandela, njengoba kunjalo nge-{location}

Lezi yizici abantu abaningi abangazilindeli ukuthi ikhibhodi ibe nazo. Ngayinye icishiwe kuze kube yilapho uyivula lapha, futhi ukucisha kusho ukuthi ayikho: alikho ithuluzi, ayikho inkinobho kukhibhodi, awukho umphumela wokusesha, awukho umsebenzi wangemuva. Yivule futhi ibuyela ngezilungiselelo ebezinazo.
Okungeziwe okungakaze kube nakho amakhibhodi amaningi, kuvuliwe noma kuvaliwe njengento eyodwa
Inkanyezi phezulu kuso sonke isikrini sezilungiselelo esibala izilungiselelo zakho ozithandayo
Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje. Engeza isikrini okuso, noma thinta ubambe isilungiselelo bese ukhetha Engeza ezintandokazini.
Izinguquko zakho kuleli fayela azilondoloziwe. Ukuhamba kuzokwenza ulahlekelwe yizo.
Lokho akuyona i-JSON uhlelo lokusebenza olungayilungisa.

Akukho lutho kulesi sigaba okwamanje. Isigaba esingenalutho asivuli lutho.
Kususa yona nezenzo zayo kumenyu esheshayo

Inkinobho encane eyindilinga entantayo phezu kwayo yonke i-app, ikhibhodi ivuliwe noma ivaliwe. Yithinte, yithinte kabili noma uyicindezele uyibambe, futhi yenza lokho okubekile ngezansi: vula ikhibhodi, ngisho nasesikrinini esingenayo inkambu yombhalo, qala ukuthayipha ngezwi, buza i-AI mayelana nesikrini, noma uvule noma yiliphi ithuluzi. Ukucindezela nokubamba kuvula imenyu esheshayo yezinye izenzo ezizungeze inkinobho; slayida uye kwenye bese uyayiyeka ukuze uyisebenzise. Hudula inkinobho ukuze uyinyakazise, futhi izohlala ohlangothini oluseduze. Yihudulele esiphambanweni esisezansi kwesikrini ukuze uyifihle kuze kube yilapho ikhibhodi ivuleka noma ivaleka ngokulandelayo. Idinga imvume ye-Android yokubonisa phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza.
Inkinobho encane eyindilinga entanta phezu kwayo yonke uhlelo lokusebenza

Ukuthinta ngakunye kwenza isenzo esisodwa. Ithuluzi elihlala kukhibhodi, njengokuthayipha ngezwi noma ibhodi lokunamathisela, liletha ikhibhodi kuqala uma ivaliwe. Ngokuthinta kabili okusethiwe, ukuthinta kanye kulinda isikhashana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho ukuthinta kwesibili okuzayo.
Ukudlidliza lapho uthepha, okunamandla kakhulu lapho imenyu ivuleka noma isenzo sikhethiwe
Ukuthi inkinobho iqinile kangakanani uma isiphelile
Isikhathi esilindwa inkinobho ngaphambi kokuba ifiphale
Imenyu igcwele. Susa isenzo ukuze ungeze esinye.
Ukuthi izenzo zikude kangakanani, kumenyu esheshayo nakuso sonke isigaba

Imenyu esheshayo iyavuleka izungeze inkinobho, ibheke phakathi nendawo yesikrini. Ivulwa ngokucindezela nokubamba, slayida umunwe wakho esenzweni bese udedela ukuze usisebenzise, noma udedele kuqala bese uthepha esisodwa. Thepha noma yikuphi ukuze uyivale. Hudula izibambo ukuze uhlele kabusha; isenzo sokuqala sihlala ekugcineni kwemenyu.

Ivaliwe. Vula inkinobho ukuze uyibone phezu kwezinhlelo zakho zokusebenza.

Inkinobho phezu kwezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zekhibhodi, ukuthayipha ngezwi, i-AI nanoma yiliphi ithuluzi
Inkinobho efiphele islayida kancane eceleni, iphume endleleni yohlelo lokusebenza

Ngekhibhodi evuliwe, ukuthepha kanye nokuthepha kabili kungenza okunye, njengokuphuma endaweni yombhalo. Uma zishiywe njengoba zinjalo, zenza lokho okwenziwa Ukuthepha Nokuthepha kabili. Ukuthepha kabili okubekwe lapha kuphela kugcina ukuthepha kuyilapho ikhibhodi ivaliwe ekubeni kungalindi.
Hlala esikrinini ngaphezu kwekhibhodi evulekile, lapho ukuthepha esenzweni sekhibhodi kuyivala
Le divayisi ayinazo izinsiza ze-Google Play, ezihlinzeka ngamafonti e-Google. Uhlu olungezansi lubonisa ifonti yesistimu, amafonti owangenisayo kanye namafonti owafaka esitolo.
