Ikhibhodi ye-WM kukhompyutha iyinikeza ngaphezu kwekhesa, futhi ideskithophu ye-KDE Connect iyibonisa njengesaziso. Konke kuhlala kunethiwekhi yakho yendawo. Lokhu kudinga Amakhodi avela ezazisweni avuliwe, ngaphansi kokuthayipha, ngoba yilokho okufunda izaziso.
Ikhodi yokuqinisekisa efika lapha inikezwa nakukhompyutha
Vula i-KDE Connect ukuze ufune amakhompyutha

Ikhompyutha ene-WMK Desktop ikhombisa ikhodi yokubhangqa ngaphansi kuka-Backup & restore › Sync devices › Pair a phone. Khomba ikhamera yale foni kuyo bese uvula isixhumanisi: I-WM Keyboard iyavuleka lapha futhi iyakubhangqa, ngaphandle kwekhodi yokuqhathaniswa.
Funa amakhompyutha abhangqiwe futhi uwavumele athole le foni

Ibhanyisa le khibhodi nekhompyutha esebenzisa i-KDE Connect, GSConnect noma i-Valent, ngenethiwekhi yakho yendawo. Ikhibhodi ivela lapho njengedivayisi yayo, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-KDE Connect aludingeki ocingweni.
Ezinkundleni ezivimba ukutholakala. Le foni izimemezela kuleli naleli kheli ngokuqondile, futhi ikhompyutha iyaphendula.
Noma nini lapho le ikhibhodi esebenzayo, ebonisiwe noma cha. Isebenzisa ibhethri eliningi.
Ayikho isevisi engemuva. Isixhumanisi sihlala ngaphakathi kwekhibhodi, ngakho ngisho i-Always iyaphela uma i-Android ivala ikhibhodi, futhi ukonga ibhethri kungayimisa okwesikhashana.
Ngenkathi ikhibhodi isesikrinini, nangomzuzu owodwa ngemva kwalokho.
Ngesikhathi iphaneli ye-KDE Connect ivuliwe kuphela. Ikhompyutha ayikwazi ukuthayipha noma ukuthumela ibhodi lokunamathisela ngezinye izikhathi.
Kunikeziwe. Kudingeka ukuze ubone ukuthi yini edlalwayo
Kudingeka ukuze ubone ukuthi yini edlalayo. Thepha ukuze unikeze imvume
Ikhompyutha ingamisa futhi yeqe okudlalayo lapha
Okungenalutho kusebenzisa imodeli yefoni. Izinhlamvu ezingama-32, akukho zimpawu zokuloba
Isicelo sokubhangqa, ifayela noma i-ping efike ngenkathi ikhibhodi ifihliwe
Ukuhamba kancane kunembile, ukuhamba ngokushesha kuya kude

Isixhumanisi sicela le foni ukuthi ibhangqe nekhompyutha ku-%1$s. Ikhompyutha ebhangqiwe ingathayipha enkundleni oyisebenzisayo, ithole umbhalo owukopishayo, futhi ithumele amafayela. Bhangqa kuphela uma uskena le khodi kusuka kukhompyutha yakho.
U-%1$s ufuna ukubhangqa. Yamukela kuphela uma kukhombisa le khodi
Ilinde u-%1$s. Yamukela kukhompyutha uma ikhombisa le khodi
Ibhodi lokunamathisela limisiwe kuze kube yilapho uliqalisa kabusha
Ibhodi lokunamathisela limisiwe kuze kube ngu-%1$s
Valiwe: lokho ikhompyutha ekuthumelayo kuthayipheka ngqo. Kuvuliwe: ikhibhodi yesiLatini edeskini ibhala isiBengali nge-Avro, futhi iziphakamiso nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuyasebenza.
Sebenzisa okhiye bayo ngesakhiwo sale khibhodi, njengekhibhodi yehadiwe
Ilondolozwe ku-Downloads, ku-WM Keyboard, futhi yengezwe emlandweni webhodi lokunamathisela
Ikhibhodi yayo ithayipha enkundleni, ngenkathi le ikhibhodi ibonakala futhi ifoni ivuliwe
Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zingabelana nekhompyutha. Kuboniswa kuphela uma ikhompyutha isibhangqiwe
Iminwe emibili yokuchofoza kwesokudla, emithathu kwesiphakathi
Thayipha lapha ukuze uzame izinguquko zakho
Gcwalisa i-popup yohlamvu ngalunye ngesethi yalo ephelele yezimpawu zokugcizelela

Okunye kokuqala kuvuleka ngqo phezu kokhiye owubambile. Vuliwe: okunye kuya ezinhlangothini zombili, okukodwa kwesokudla, okukodwa kwesobunxele, njalo njalo ngaphandle, ngakho ukuslayida noma yikuphi kufinyelela okulandelayo. Ukhiye oseduze konqenqema lwesikrini awunawo umkhathi ohlangothini olulodwa, ngakho i-popup yawo ibalekela kude nonqenqema. Valiwe: okunye kulandela okokuqala ngokulandelana kokufunda, konke ohlangothini olulodwa.
Beka ezinye izindlela ezinhlangothini zombili zeyokuqala

Ibeka ngokuzenzakalelayo izindlela eziningi ezishintshanayo emgqeni njengoba zilingana esikrinini, ukuze ukuma kwe-popup kulandele ububanzi bezinhlamvu. Inombolo esuka ku-3 kuye ku-11 inika wonke umugqa lezo zikholamu zobubanzi obufanayo. Ukhiye onezindlela eziningi ezishintshanayo ufundeka njengebhulokhi, futhi indlela ngayinye eshintshanayo isendaweni efanayo njalo uma uyivula.
Mangaki amanye amagama ahamba emgqeni owodwa
Bamba, slayidela kokunye okufunayo, bese uyadedela
Gcwalisa i-popup kusuka kokhiye kuya ngaphandle

I-popup yohlamvu ingabamba izinhlobo ezintathu zezinhlamvu: ezinye izinhlamvu ezibekwa yisakhiwo ngaphansi kokhiye, izimpawu ezengezwe yizo zonke izimpawu nezinhlamvu zomdabu kuqala, kanye nohlamvu olukhulu noma olushintshiwe olungezwe ngokucindezela nokubamba uhlamvu olushintshiwe. Hudula amaqembu uwalethe ngokulandelana okufunayo. Ngaphakathi kweqembu ngalinye ukulandelana kuhlala kunjengoba kwakunjalo. Okufakiwe kokuqala yikho okubhalwa ngokubamba nokukhulula, ngakho iqembu olifinyelela kakhulu lifanele ukuba phezulu. Okuzenzakalelayo okwesakhiwo uqobo, bese kuba izimpawu, bese kuba uhlamvu olukhulu.
Iyiphi iqembu eliza kuqala ku-popup yohlamvu

Lokhu kuphindaphinda usayizi wezinhlamvu ku-popup evulekayo uma ucindezela futhi ubambe ukhiye. Ifinyelela kude kunosayizi wefonti ye-popup ngenhla, ngoba i-popup yezinye izindlela ikhula ukuze ilingane nanoma yini oyibeka kuyo. I-bubble yokubuka kuqala igcina usayizi wayo, ngakho-ke inani elikhulu lapha aliyiphusheli uhlamvu ngaphandle kwe-bubble.

Ukucindezela okubili kwe-shift ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi kuvula i-caps lock. Isikhathi esifushane senza i-caps lock isheshe, kodwa iqala ngephutha kalula. Isikhathi eside samukela ukucindezela kabili okuhamba kancane. Okuzenzakalelayo kungu-350 ms.
Ukuthi ukucindezela okwesibili kwe-shift kuvula kanjani i-caps lock ngokushesha kangakanani

Ukhiye we-Ctrl kusakhiwo sangokwezifiso uvame ukusebenzisa u-A, C, V no-X ngezinto ze-clipboard ze-Android. Lokho kusebenza yonke indawo, kuhlanganise namakhasi ewebhu nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezakhiwe nge-Compose. Itheminali idinga umcimbi wokhiye oluhlaza esikhundleni salokho. Lapho i-Ctrl+C isho ukuphazamisa, hhayi ukukopisha. Ikhibhodi ayikwazi ukuhlukanisa lezi ezimbili, ngakho lokhu kuyisilungiselelo hhayi ukuqagela.
Okweziteshi. Okuthi \'Off\' kusho ukuthi u-Ctrl+A, C, V kanye no-X basebenzisa ibhodi lokunamathisela

Lawa angabalingiswa abaku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba okhiye be-$, ngokulandelana. Beka uhlobo lwakho lwemali kuqala. Hlukanisa abalingiswa ngezikhala. Gcina okuzenzakalelayo (৳ € £ ¥ ₹ ₿), noma usule inkambu ukuze ubuyisele isethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi.

Ikhibhodi idlidliza kanye ngohlamvu ngalunye lapho isikhombisi sihamba khona uma uslayida kubha yesikhala noma usebenzisa okhiye bevolumu. Cisha lokhu ukuze uhambise isikhombisi ngaphandle kokudlidliza. Okhiye bayaqhubeka nokudlidliza uma ubacindezela.
Dlidliza esinyathelweni ngasinye uma uhambisa isikhombisi ngebha yesikhala

Le yisivinini sezikhiye ovule ukuphinda uma ubambe kuso kumhleli wesakhiwo sesikhiye, njengomugqa wezikhiye zomcibisholo. Ukususa nesikhala kugcina isivinini saso esingenhla. Amanani aphansi aphinda ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukhiye owubekele ukuphindaphinda ushesha kangakanani ngenkathi uwubambile
Ngenkathi ubambe ukususa, kuphindaphindeka kulesi sikhathi. Amanani aphansi asusa ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukususa kuphindaphinda ngokushesha kangakanani ngenkathi ukubambile

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ikhibhodi iyaqhubeka nokudlidliza uma i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe. I-Do Not Disturb isebenza kuzaziso, hhayi ekuthinteni. Vula lokhu ukuze wenze ikhibhodi ithule ngokuphelele ngenkathi i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Misa konke ukudlidliza kwekhibhodi ngenkathi i-Do Not Disturb ivuliwe
Thulisa ukudlidliza kumodi ye-Do Not Disturb
Vula iphaneli ye-emoji kusuka ku-popup yokhiye wokufaka
Cindezela ubambe u-enter ukuze uthole ama-emoji
Uhlamvu oluphonswe ngaphandle futhi lwabanjwa lapho luthayipha kaninginingi uze ukhulule, esikhathini sokhiye ophindaphindayo

Beka umunwe wakho kukhiye we-🌐, uwusheleleze kukhiye wesinqamuleli bese uwuphakamisa: ku-A kukhetha konke, C kukopisha, V kunamathisela, X kuyasika, Z kuyahlehlisa futhi Y kuyaphinda. Lezi yizikhiye ezifanayo nezenzo ezifanayo njengezinqamuleli zokubamba, futhi ungashintsha izikhiye ngaphansi kwezikhiye zesinqamuleli. Lokhu kusebenza uma izinqamuleli zokubamba zivaliwe futhi. Phakamisa noma yikuphi okunye futhi akukho okwenzekayo. Shelelezela emuva ku-🌐 ukuze ushintshe ulimi njengoba ukuthepha kwenza. Uma ubamba i-🌐 uze uvule uhlu lwezilimi, ukushelelezisa kungokohlu. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Cindezela u-🌐 bese uslayida ku-C ukuze ukopishe, ku-V ukuze unamathisele
Slayida kusuka ku-🌐 ukuze uthole izinqamuleli

Lokhu kubeka ukuthi ikhibhodi iyishayela kanzima kangakanani imoto yokudlidliza, kusuka ku-1 kuye ku-255. Okwe-Sharp ikala i-primitive yokuchofoza kwehadiwe. Ubude buhlala buqinile futhi amandla kuphela ashintshayo. Okwe-Custom kusebenza kuphela kumadivayisi lapho imoto yokudlidliza isekela ukulawulwa kwe-amplitude. Kwamanye amadivayisi ubude obungenhla kuphela obunomphumela. Ukulungiselelwa kokudlidliza kohlelo \"Touch feedback\" nakho kukala amandla okugcina.
Amandla okudlidliza kukho konke ukucindezela okhiye
Lobu ubude besigqi sokudlidliza ngama-millisecond. Imivimbo emide izwakala inamandla kumadivayisi amaningi.
Ubude bokudlidliza kukho konke ukucindezela ukhiye

I-Tap ne-Key yizitayela ezinconyiwe. Zinikeza ukudlidliza ku-haptic yokhiye wepulatifomu, ucingo olufanayo olusetshenziswa amakhibhodi ajwayelekile. Kumadivayisi alungisiwe uthola ukudlidliza komthengisi, futhi kulandela ukusethwa kokushuba kwe-haptic yesistimu. I-Tap icela umuzwa \"wokuthepha kwekhibhodi\". Abathengisi abaningi balungisa ukudlidliza okuhlukile kwamakhibhodi, futhi lokhu yikho okudlalwa ikhibhodi yabo, ngakho i-Tap iyisinqumo esizenzakalelayo. I-Key icela umuzwa \"wokhiye obonakalayo\", okuwukucindezela inkinobho okujwayelekile kwedivayisi. Sebenzisa i-Key uma i-Tap izwakala ingalungile kudivayisi yakho. I-Click ne-Heavy click zisebenzisa imiphumela ye-haptic yehadiwe yedivayisi yakho (Android 10 nangaphezulu). I-Sharp idlala i-primitive yokuchofoza yehadiwe (Android 11 nangaphezulu). Ukushaya okufushane, okunzima. Amandla ayo alandela isilayidi sokuqina. I-Custom ishayela imoto yokudlidliza ngokuqondile ngesilayidi sobude besikhathi namandla. Ayisebenzisi i-overdrive nokubopha kwehadiwe, ngakho izwakala ithambile. Uma isitayela singatholakali, ikhibhodi isebenzisa i-Click yehadiwe, bese kuba i-Custom.

I-Android ithulisa ukudlidliza okufushane okujwayelekile uma uvala impendulo yokuthinta kuzilungiselelo zayo zomsindo. Izitayela zesistimu bezilokhu zikudlula lokho, kodwa izitayela ze-Custom, Sharp, Click kanye ne-Heavy click zithule ngakho. Ngalokhu kuvuliwe, lezo zitayela ziyadlidliza njengempendulo yehadiwe, okungathuliswa yileso sishintshi. Zisalandela ukulungiselelwa kwamandla okudlidliza kwe-Android. Vala lokhu uma ukudlidliza kuzwakala kungalungile ocingweni lwakho. Kudinga i-Android 13 noma entsha. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Gcina izitayela ze-Custom, Sharp ne-Click zisebenza lapho impendulo yokuthinta ye-Android icishiwe
Dlidliza ngaphezu kweswishi yempendulo yokuthinta yesistimu
Ukudlidliza okufushane kuqinisekisa ukucindezelwa kwenkinobho ngayinye. Lokhu kufaka phakathi isinyathelo ngasinye sokunyakaza kwekhesa kubha yesikhala. Ungashintsha isitayela namandla ngezansi.

Isinqamuleli ngokuvamile sihlala ekugcineni ku-popup, ngemva kwama-accents okhiye waso. Sinyakazise usisondeze kokhiye lapha. Ngemva kohlamvu olu-1: ukucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile kusathayipha i-accent yokuqala, okuyiyona futhi ekhonjiswa yisikhombisi sekhona, kanti isinqamuleli siseduze kancane. Okokuqala: ukucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile kwenza isinqamuleli ngokushesha, kanti ama-accents ayashintsha. Gcina umunwe wakho phansi bese uslayida uye ku-accent oyifunayo. Indawo edlula wonke ama-accents okhiye ibeka isinqamuleli ekugcineni kulowo khiye. Lokhu kudinga Khetha ngaphandle kokuphakamisa, ngaphansi kokhiye abashintshayo.
Lapho isinqamuleli siya khona ekucindezeleni nasekubambeni i-popup

Isenzo ngasinye osikhethayo singena ku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba kokhiye waso, ngemva kwama-accent okhiye asevele enawo. Ukukopisha nokusika kuthatha okukhethiwe, noma wonke umbhalo uma ungakhethi lutho. Ukuhlehlisa nokwenza futhi kuthumela izinqamuleli ezifanayo namathuluzi ebha yamathuluzi. Khetha okhiye ngaphansi kokhiye bezinqamuleli. Ukuze usebenzise isenzo ngokucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile esikhundleni salokho, vula Isenzo kuqala.
Hlela izenzo ku-popup yokucindezela nokubamba yokhiye wezinhlamvu
Izinqamuleli zokubamba zihlala ku-A, C, V, X, Z no-Y ngokuzenzakalelayo, okusebenza kuphela kusakhiwo esinalezinhlamvu. Zibeke okhiye abadwetshwa yisakhiwo sakho.
Yimuphi ukhiye okuhlala kuwo isinqamuleli sokubamba

Thayipha uphawu olungaphansi kohlamvu bese ucindezela ubambe lolo hlamvu ukuze uluveze kuqala, kuzo zonke izakhiwo, esikhundleni sophawu noma idijithi ebekwe yisakhiwo lapho; icebo elisekhoneni liyalikhomba nalo. Shiya ibhokisi lingenalutho ukuze ugcine elisakhiwo. I-SwiftKey igcwalisa lelo elisetshenziswa yi-SwiftKey.
Khetha uphawu olubanjwe uhlamvu ngalunye, kuzo zonke izakhiwo
Ukhiye wokususa obanjwe phansi uthatha amagama aphelele, hhayi izinhlamvu

Lokhu isikhathi osibamba ngaso inkinobho ngaphambi kokuba izinhlamvu zayo ezinye zivele. Ezinye izinhlamvu zingama-accent, izinombolo nezimpawu. Inani eliphansi liyashesha, kodwa i-popup ivuleka ngephutha kalula.
Isikhathi esingakanani obamba ngaso ukhiye ngaphambi kokuba izinhlamvu ezingezinye zivele

Ilebo elincane ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesokudla kukhiye ngamunye libonisa uhlamvu lokuqala lokucindezela nokubamba. Lona idijithi, uphawu noma i-accent ekuqaleni kwe-popup. Okhiye abasebenzisa isinqamuleli sebhodi lokunamathisela ngezansi ababonisi lutho.
Bonisa uhlamvu oluhlukile lwekihi ngayinye ekhoneni layo

Ikhibhodi idlidliza futhi uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho ekupheleni kokucindezela nokubamba. Lokhu kuqedela umjikelezo wokucindezela, ukubamba nokukhulula. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Abanye abasebenzisi bathola ukuthi ukudlidliza kwesithathu kusezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu.
Dlidliza lapho ukhulula ngemva kokucindezela nokubamba
Beka izinhlamvu ezifana no-ü phambi kwenombolo kokuvelayo
Susa izinhlamvu ezinophawu kuzo kuzo zonke izinhlamvu ezivelayo
Azikho izimpawu zokugcizelela lapho ucindezela ubambe

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ibhamuza lithatha umbala walo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi. Khetha umbala lapha futhi ibhamuza lisebenzisa wona esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi. Leli ibhamuza lokubuka kuqala kuphela. Okhiye abashintshanayo, uhlu lwezilimi kanye namamenyu emaphanelini agcina umbala wetimu.
Lokhu kuphindaphinda usayizi wombhalo ngaphakathi kwebhamuza lohlamvu elivela ngenkathi ucindezela ukhiye, naku-popup yezinkinobho ezinye. Usayizi wamalebula okhiye awushintshi.
Usayizi wombhalo kubhamuza lokubuka kuqala kanye nezinkinobho ezinye

Lokhu ukuphakama kwebhamuza lohlamvu. Uma \"I-popup kukhiye\" ivuliwe, ikhibhodi ikukala kusukela phansi kokhiye ocindezelayo. Ibhamuza elide kunokhiye lidlulela ngaphezu kwawo futhi lihlale libonakala ngaphezu komunwe wakho. Izitayela ezimbili zebhamuza ngalinye zigcina ukuphakama kwazo, ngoba ibhamuza elintantayo liqala ngaphezu kokhiye futhi lidinga okuncane kulo. Vula noma uvale \"I-popup kukhiye\", futhi lesi silayidi sibonisa ukuphakama kwaleso sitayela.
Ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye, uhlamvu lwawo luntanta kubhamuza ngaphezu komunwe wakho. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi ubone ukhiye ocindezelwe.

Ekucindezeleni okusheshayo ikhibhodi ikhipha ukhiye cishe ngaso leso sikhathi, ngakho-ke ibhamuza lingaba ukukhanya okungabonakali. Ibhamuza lihlala ngemva kokukhululwa kuze kube yilapho selibonakale ngalesi sikhathi. Inani elingu-0 liyilifihla ngesikhathi uphakamisa umunwe wakho.
Ukuthi ibhamuza lihlala isikhathi esingakanani libonakala ngemva kokucindezela okusheshayo
Futhi bonisa ibhamuza ezinkambini zezinombolo, zocingo, nezinsuku
Hambisa ibhamuza elintantayo kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla sokhiye

Ibubhu elintantayo lihlala ngaphezu kokhiye ocindezelayo. Uma umunwe wakho uwumboza, khulisa leli banga uze ukwazi ukulifunda. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ngenkathi \"I-popup kukhiye\" icishiwe. Ibubhu elikukhiye likhula liphuma kukhiye uqobo, ngakho alinalo ibanga lokusetha. Sebenzisa \"Ukuphakama kwe-popup\" kuleso sitayela.
Ukuthi ibhamuza elintantayo lihlala kude kangakanani ngaphezu kokhiye
Khulisa ibhamuza liye phezulu lisuka okhiyeleni ocindezelwe

Lokhu kuwububanzi bekhona bazo zonke izigelekeqe. Inani elingu-0 linikeza amakhona ayisikwele. Inani eliphezulu lenza amakhona abe yindilinga ngokuphelele. Izimo zezigelekeqe eziyindilinga nezinqunyiwe kuphela ezisebenzisa leli nani. Indikimba ingaphetha ububanzi bayo, futhi inqoba phezu kwalolu hlelo.
Uhlaka lwayo yonke i-popup, kusuka esikweleni kuya kumbuthano
Bonisa ibhamuza lohlamvu ngaphezu kokhiye ocindezelwe
Gcina umugqa ocacile ngaphezu komugqa ongaphezulu wamabhamuza awo

Ukubamba i-backspace noma isikhala kuqala ukuphinda ngemva kwalesi sikhathi eside. Kwakujwayele ukwabelana ngokubambezeleka kokucindezela isikhathi eside, okusho ukuthi ukwehlisa ijubane le-accent popups nakho kwehlisa ijubane le-backspace. Manje sezehlukene. Lesi silungiselelo singu-300 ms ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Isikhathi eside kangakanani obamba ngaso ukhiye wokubuyisela emuva noma isikhala ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuphindaphinda

Lokhu kwengeza uhlamvu ngalunye ukhiye othayipha ngaphansi kwe-shift, okuyinhlamvu enkulu ezinhlelweni zesiLatini, ekupheleni kokucindezela nokubamba kwayo. Ukhiye osevele uwufakile ushiywa unjalo. Kuyasiza kakhulu ngokwayipha kusuka kokhiye be-?123 ne-ABC: leso senzo sithayipha ukhiye owodwa kusuka kolunye ungqimba, futhi ukhiye we-shift usungqimbeni umunwe wakho owushiyile. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Engeza uhlamvu olukhulu luhlamvu ngalunye ku-popup yalo

Uma ubambe i-backspace noma isikhala, ukhiye uyaphindaphinda. Ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphindaphinda ngakunye kudlala umsindo wokhiye, ongazwakala njengesibhamu somshini ngenkathi ususa umugqa. Cisha lokhu ukuze uzwe ukucindezela kokuqala kuphela. Ukudlidliza kwehlukile, ngenhla. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi asenzi lutho ngaphandle uma umsindo wokhiye uvuliwe.
Dlala umsindo wokhiye ekuphindaphindeni ngakunye ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye

Ngenkathi ubambe ibha yesikhala, iphindaphinda kulesi sikhathi. Isikhala sinenani laso ngoba ukulandelana kwezikhala kunzima ukukulungisa kunokulandelana kokususwa. Sebenzisa inani eliphakeme lapha ukuze wenze kube kancane.
Ukuthi isikhala siphindaphindeka ngokushesha kangakanani ngenkathi usibambile

Ngokuvamile ukhiye u-?123 ushintsha kuphela uye kungqimba lwezimpawu. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, lubambe ukuze uvule iphaneli yephedi yezinombolo phezu kwanoma iyiphi inkundla. Uthola iphedi yezinombolo egcwele ngaphandle kokushiya ibhokisi lombhalo lamanje. Ukucindezela okusheshayo kusashintsha ungqimba.
Cindezela ubambe ukhiye wezimpawu ukuze uvule iphedi yezinombolo
Cindezela ubambe u-?123 ukuze uthole iphedi yezinombolo

Ngokuzenzakalelayo ikhibhodi iyaqhubeka nokudlidliza ngisho noma uvala impendulo yokuthinta kuzilungiselelo zomsindo ze-Android, ngoba ikhibhodi inokushintsha kwayo kwayo. Vula lokhu uma ulindele ukuthi ukulungiselelwa kwesistimu kuhlanganise nekhibhodi futhi. Lokhu kulungiselelwa kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Impendulo yokuthinta icishiwe kuzilungiselelo ze-Android. Ikhibhodi isadlidliza ngoba \"Dlidliza ngale kweswishi yempendulo yokuthinta yesistimu\" ivuliwe.

Impendulo yokuthinta icishiwe kuzilungiselelo ze-Android, ngakho-ke lesi sitayela sokudlidliza sithule. Vula \"Vibrate past the system touch feedback switch\" ngezansi, noma khetha ukhiye wesistimu noma ukuthepha kwesistimu.
Impendulo yokuthinta icishiwe kuzilungiselelo ze-Android, ngakho lesi sitayela sokudlidliza sithule kule nguqulo ye-Android. Khetha i-System key noma i-System tap, esadlidlizayo.
Vumela ukudlidliza kokuthinta kwe-Android kuthulise nekhibhodi
Izinombolo ngaphandle komugqa wezinombolo, akukho okukuyo
1 kuya ku-0, ngisho nalapho umugqa wezinombolo uvuliwe
Azikho izinombolo, ngakho okhiye bavuleka ngama-accent abo
Okuthayiphwa uma ubambe u-q kuya ku-p

Uma uswayiphela kwesobunxele kukhiye we-backspace, ikhibhodi isusa igama negama futhi idlidlizele igama ngalinye. Vala lokhu ukuze ususe umusho ngokuhudula okukodwa okushelelayo ngaphandle kokudlidliza. Ukucindezela okujwayelekile ku-backspace akushintshi. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Dlidliza ngezwi ngalinye elisuswa ngokuswayipha ukususa

Uma ubambe i-backspace noma isikhala, ukhiye uyaphinda. Ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphinda ngakunye kuyadlidliza. Vala lokhu ukuze udlidlize ekucindezeleni kokuqala kuphela futhi ugcine ukuphinda kuthule. Umsindo wokhiye wawo usadlalwa uma uvuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Dlidliza ekubuyaphindeni ngakunye ngenkathi ubambe ukhiye

Vala lokhu ukuze umise ukudlidliza kwebha yesikhala kuphela. Zonke ezinye izinkinobho zizoqhubeka nokudlidliza. Lokhu kuyasiza uma ibha yesikhala ende izwakala isinda ngaphansi kwesithupha sakho. Umsindo wokucindezela inkinobho usazwakala uma uvuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ngenkathi ubambe ukususa futhi kusula amagama, kuthatha igama elilodwa kulesi sikhathi. Kuhamba kancane kunesikhathi sezinhlamvu esingenhla ngenhloso, ngoba igama elilodwa liyisinyathelo esikhulu kakhulu. Amanani aphansi asula ngokushesha.
Ukuthi ukhiye wokususa obanjwe phansi ususa amagama ngokushesha kangakanani
Ukususwa kwegama kuyama echashazini, umugqa otyekile noma olunye uphawu
Namathisela i-emoji, uyinikeze igama namagama angukhiye, bese ukhetha ithebhu yayo
Ikhibhodi manje ifaka le emoji. Ungayisusa lapha.
Yonke i-emoji oyengezile iphuma kuphaneli ye-emoji futhi iphuma ekusesheni. I-emoji ikhibhodi ehlanganisa ayithintwa.

resources.string: Leli fayela akulona i-emoji-test.txt evela ku-Unicode, noma alikwazanga ukufundwa.
Akukho okungangezwa. Ikhibhodi isivele inayo yonke i-emoji kuleli fayela.
Engeza yonke i-emoji ikhibhodi engekho nayo okwamanje, ohlwini oluku-unicode.org/Public/emoji/latest/emoji-test.txt

Ukukhishwa ngakunye kwe-Unicode kwengeza ama-emoji amasha. Kuze kube yilapho isibuyekezo se-WM Keyboard sibafaka, ungabengeza lapha. I-emoji engeziwe ibonakala ekupheleni kwethebhu yayo kuphaneli yama-emoji. Ungayisesha ngegama layo namagama angukhiye, uyenze intandokazi, futhi ibonakala kokuthi Okusanda kwenzeka. Uma isibuyekezo sifaka i-emoji, umugqa wayo lapha usho njalo futhi ungayisusa. Ama-emoji angeziwe aya kuzipele zakho futhi avumelanise nezilungiselelo zakho.
Zihlukanise ngokusebenzisa okukhomba (commas). Ukusesha kuthola i-emoji ngegama layo nangala magama.
Engeza ama-emoji amasha kune-keyboard, elilodwa ngesikhathi noma kusuka ku-emoji-test.txt ye-Unicode

Ifonti yakho ye-emoji ayikakwazi ukudweba le emoji okwamanje. Ivela njengebhokisi noma njengezingxenye ezihlukene, kodwa ikhibhodi iyayithayipha ngendlela efanele futhi ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zingayibonisa.
Ifonti yakho ye-emoji ayikakwazi ukudweba le emoji okwamanje

Cindezela bese ubamba i-emoji kuphaneli ye-emoji ukuze ubone inguqulo enyakazayo, kanye nesilawuli esiyithumela njengesithombe. Lezi zithombe ziyizi-Noto Animated Emoji zakwa-Google, ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-CC BY 4.0. Ikhibhodi ilanda ngayinye ku-Google uma uyicela, cishe ngama-800 KB. Cishe ama-emoji angu-880 anayo, kanti isilawuli asiveli kweminye, noma kuhlelo lokusebenza olungamukeli zithombe.
Thumela inguqulo ehambayo ye-emoji kusuka ku-popup yayo yokucindezela nokubamba
Umugqa uhlala phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nokhiye
Inkinobho ekugcineni kwesokudla kwebha yamathuluzi ivula umugqa

Umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ube yizikhala eziningi futhi wenza i-emoji ibe ncane ngokwanele ukuba ilingane nazo. Inombolo ephezulu inikeza ama-emoji amancane aseduze kakhulu. Uma ukuphequla kuvaliwe, umugqa ufihla ama-emoji ngemuva kwesikhala sokugcina. Uma ukuphequla kuvuliwe, ukuswayipha kuyawabonisa.
Mangaki alingana kulo lonke. Inombolo ephezulu iwapakisha kakhulu

\"Umugqa uqobo\" ugcina umugqa we-emoji phakathi kwebha yamathuluzi nezinkinobho ngaso sonke isikhathi. \"Inkinobho\" yengeza inkinobho ekugcineni kwesokudla kwebha yamathuluzi. Inkinobho ishintsha umugqa wokusikisela ibe umugqa we-emoji. \"Valiwe\" ifihla kokubili.
Awukho umugqa we-emoji futhi ayikho inkinobho yawo

Uma lokhu kucishiwe, okuyinto ezenzakalelayo, umugqa awunyakazi. Ubonisa kuphela ama-emoji alinganayo, ngakho ukuswayiphela eceleni akukwazi ukuwuhambisa ngaphansi komunwe wakho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ungaskrola uye kwamanye ama-emoji.
Swayiphela eceleni ukuze uthole ama-emoji ngemva kwalawo abonakalayo
I-emoji yakho esetshenziswa kakhulu phezulu, bese kuba lezo zakho zakamuva, ngayinye ngaphansi kwesihloko sayo

Iphaneli ye-emoji ithumela izigaba zayo ngokulandelana kwe-Unicode, okungelona neze uhlelo ozisebenzisa ngalo. Hudula isigaba ukuze uhambise ithebhu yaso, bese ucindezela iso ukuze ufihle ithebhu ongayivuli neze. Cindezela isigaba ukuze uhlele ama-emoji akuso: cindezela ubambe elilodwa, bese ulihudulela lapho ufuna libe khona. Ithebhu yakamuva, kanye namathebhu e-Kaomoji nama-Emoticon, awabhalwanga lapha — Okwakamuva kuzihlela ngokusebenziseka, kanti amanye amabili avulwa futhi avalwe ngenhla.

Isigaba ngasinye sibuyela ekulandelaneni kwe-Unicode, ithebhu ngayinye efihliwe iyabuya, futhi ama-emoji angaphakathi kwesigaba ngasinye abuyela ekulandelaneni kwawo kwikhathalogi. Okusanda kusetshenziswa, okuthandayo kanye nemibala yesikhumba akuthintwa.
Buyisela amathebhu, afihliwe kanye ne-emoji esigabeni ngasinye ngendlela ababephume ngayo
Hlela kabusha amathebhu, fihla lawo ongawavuli neze, futhi uhlele ama-emoji ngaphakathi kwalinye nalalinye

Ithebhu yomlando iyathululwa, izintandokazi zakho ziyakhishwa, futhi ithoni yesikhumba ekhethelwe i-emoji ngayinye ibuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Ama-emoji ngokwawo awathinteki. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
Khohlwa okusanda kusetshenziswa, izibalo zokusetshenziswa, izintandokazi nokukhethwa kwethoni yesikhumba
Lokhu kwengeza inkinobho ethi \"Sula okusanda kusetshenziswa\" kuthebhu ethi Okusanda kusetshenziswa yephaneli ye-emoji. Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuze ithebhu ihlale ihlanzekile.
Inkinobho kuthebhu yakamuva esusa uhlu lwezinto zakamuva

Ngokuzenzakalelayo, iphaneli yama-emoji nephaneli yebhodi lokunamathisela zihlala zivuliwe, ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha izinto eziningi. Vula lokhu ukuze ubuyele ezinkinobho ngokushesha ngemva kwe-emoji eyodwa noma ukunamathisela okukodwa kwebhodi lokunamathisela.
Vala iphaneli uma ufaka i-emoji eyodwa noma unamathisela isiqeshana esisodwa

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, iphaneli ye-emoji iwuhlu olulodwa oluskrola kusukela phezulu kuye phansi. Isigaba ngasinye siqala ngegama laso, futhi usuka esigabeni esisodwa uye kwesilandelayo ngaphandle kokuma. Amathebhu esigaba agxumela esigabeni futhi akhombise isigaba okuso. Uma lokhu kucishiwe, isigaba ngasinye siyikhasi, futhi uswayiphela kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla ukuze uye kwesilandelayo.
Skrola kuwo wonke ama-emoji, nesihloko phezu kwesigaba ngasinye
Ifayela lefonti ye-emoji elilodwa olingenisa ngezansi

\"Isistimu\" isebenzisa iphakethe le-emoji ledivayisi yakho. Kumadivayisi akwa-Samsung lokho kuyisethi yakwa-Samsung. \"I-Google\" ilanda i-Noto Color Emoji, ukubukeka okujwayelekile kwe-Android, kanye ngomunye umthombo wefonti yesistimu, futhi ikugcina kudivayisi yakho. \"Okufakiwe\" kusebenzisa ifonti ye-emoji evela kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. \"Okungokwezifiso\" kusebenzisa ifayela lefonti ye-emoji elilodwa olilayishayo ngezansi. Umbhalo owuthumelayo uhlale uyi-Unicode elula. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza namanye amadivayisi ayidweba ngefonti yabo ye-emoji.
Ifonti ye-emoji evela kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji
Ilanda i-Noto Color Emoji yamanje, enama-emoji amasha kuyo. Cishe u-%1$s. Inketho ethi \"Google\" ngenhla ingasebenzisa kuphela inguqulo idivayisi yakho eseyinayo.
Awuzange ungenise ifonti ye-emoji. Ikhibhodi isebenzisa ifonti yohlelo kuze kube yilapho ungenisa eyodwa.
I-Noto Color Emoji, ukubukeka okujwayelekile kwe-Android
Ukuthi ama-emoji abukeka kanjani kukhibhodi uqobo
Inguqulo %1$s ye-Noto Color Emoji isiphume, enama-emoji ikhophi yakho engenayo. Mayelana ne-%2$s.
Ayikho imithombo yezinhlamvu ye-emoji efakiwe. Faka eyodwa kusuka kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. Ungaphinda ungenise ifayela elilodwa ngesilungiselelo esithi \"Custom\".

Iphaneli ye-emoji igcwalisa ikhibhodi yonke. Ibha yamathuluzi, umugqa we-emoji kanye nomugqa wezimpawu kuyanyamalala. Amathebhu esigaba athuthela emugqeni abawushiyayo, eduze kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva. Cisha lokhu ukuze ugcine ibha yamathuluzi iseduze ngenkathi ukhetha i-emoji.
Fihla ibha yamathuluzi bese uhambisa amathebhu esigaba phezulu, eduze kwenkinobho yokubuyela emuva

Izilinganisa ngokuzenzakalelayo njengoba inqwaba yezikholamu ivumela, ngakho isikrini esibanzi sikhombisa okwengeziwe. Inombolo emisiwe igcina i-emoji ngayinye ekholamu efanayo kuzo zonke izikrini. Hlela kanjalo kulinganisa lokhu nekhibhodi oyikhethayo.

Okuzenzakalelayo kwenza umugqa ngamunye ube mude ngokwe-emoji. Ukuphakama okumisiwe, nezinsika ezimisiwe, kwenza ukuswayipha okufanayo kuskrolele ku-emoji efanayo njengasekhibhodini ehlelwe njengokukopishiwe.
Ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wama-emoji mude kangakanani

Iphaneli ye-emoji ilingana nezinsika eziningi njengoba ububanzi bayo buvumela, futhi iseli ngalinye libanzi okungenani ngalokhu. Usayizi omncane ufaka ama-emoji amaningi esikrinini esisodwa. Usayizi omkhulu uwahlakaza, futhi ngalinye kulula ukulishaya. Lapho usayizi we-emoji ngezansi udinga indawo engaphezu kwalokhu, amaseli ayakhula ukuze alingane nawo.
Ububanzi beseli ngayinye yegridi ye-emoji, okungenani. Usayizi omncane uvumela amakholomu amaningi

Amadivayisi amadala, nemikhiqizo ethile, anefonti ye-emoji endala kune-emoji entsha. Lezo emoji bese zibonakala njengebhokisi elingenalutho \"tofu\". Lesi silungiselelo sifihla yonke i-emoji ifonti ye-emoji yedivayisi yakho engakwazi ukuyidweba. Ukuze uzibone zonke, setha ifonti ye-emoji ngenhla ibe \"Google\" (Noto Color Emoji). Ungaphinda ufake ifonti ye-emoji ephelele kusuka kuma-Addon, njenge-Twemoji noma i-OpenMoji. I-WM Keyboard ayinayo ifonti yayo ye-emoji. Isebenzisa ifonti oyikhetha lapha.

Ifonti oyikhethile ngenhla ihlanganisa kuphela ama-emoji eyakhelwe kuwo. Ngokuvamile ukukhishwa okusha kuphela okunamathikithi ama-emoji amasha. Ikhibhodi ayiwafihli lawo ma-emoji. Iyadweba ngamunye kufonti ye-emoji yedivayisi yakho, ngakho usawubona, kodwa ngesinye isitayela.
Yeqa ama-emoji abonakala njengebhokisi elingenalutho kuphaneli, ekusesheni naseziphakamisweni
Fihla ama-emoji idivayisi yakho engakwazi ukuwabonisa
Thayipha usuku lokuzalwa, cindezela u-🎂, bese uthola usuku lokuzalwa 🎂

\"Replace word\" ishintsha igama olibhalile libe yi-emoji. Uma ubhala usuku lokuzalwa bese ucindezela u-🎂, u-🎂 kuphela osalayo, njengaku-Gboard. \"Keep word\" yengeza i-emoji ngemva kwegama: usuku lokuzalwa 🎂.
Thayipha usuku lokuzalwa, cindezela 🎂, bese 🎂 kuphela okusalayo

Lokhu kungeza ithebhu ye-Kaomoji kanye nethebhu yezithonjana ekupheleni kwamathebhu wephaneli ye-emoji. Ama-Kaomoji ubuso besitayela saseJapane, njenge (╯°□°）╯︵ ┻━┻. Izithonjana yilezo ze-ASCII zaseNtshonalanga, njenge :-D kanye ne <3. Zombili izithebhu zizihlela ngokwemizwa. Uma ucindezela eyodwa, ikhibhodi iyayithayipha njengombhalo ovamile. Ayiyi emlandweni wakho we-emoji.
Landa noma ngenisa amagama angukhiye ukuze useshe ama-emoji ngolunye ulimi

Cindezela ubambe i-emoji ukuze ubonise igama layo le-Unicode, njenge-\"skull and crossbones\". Igama livela ngenhla kwesilawuli sezintandokazi nezilawuli zokuhlukahluka. Lokhu kukusiza ukubona umehluko phakathi kwama-emoji abukeka ecishe afane.
Bonisa igama le-emoji phezulu kokuvela kwayo uma ucindezela ubambe
Cindezela ubambe i-emoji, bese uyihudulela lapho ufuna ibe khona.
%1$s ithatha indawo yokulandelana kwamathebhu, amathebhu afihliwe, ukulandelana kwama-emoji nosayizi wegridi owubekile. Okusanda kusetshenziswa, izintandokazi kanye nemibala yesikhumba akushintshi.

Khetha ikhibhodi obuyisebenzisa ngaphambili, futhi iphaneli ye-emoji izothola amathebhu ayo, ngokulandelana kwayo, ne-emoji ngayinye lapho ikhibhodi leyo iyibeka khona. Igridi nayo iyashintsha ibe yizinsika zekhibhodi leyo, ukuphakama komugqa nosayizi we-emoji, ukuze ukuswayipha okufanayo kuskrolele ku-emoji efanayo. Ezinye izikhibhodi zigcina izitshalo nezilwane kanye nesimo sezulu nezokuvakasha nezindawo. Lawo ma-emoji bese ethuthela kulelo thebhu, futhi ithebhu engenalutho kuyo ifihlwa. I-emoji ikhibhodi leyo engekho nayo okwamanje iya eceleni kwe-emoji elandelayo. Ngemuva kokuthi ukhethe eyodwa, usengakwazi ukuhudula amathebhu nama-emoji. I-Unicode ibuyisela yonke into ngendlela eyayithunyelwe ngayo.
Beka amathebhu nama-emoji ngokulandelana kwe-Gboard, SwiftKey noma i-HeliBoard
Usayizi wegridi, izigaba, izintandokazi kanye nezisanda kusetshenziswa
Ama-Emoji afanayo avela ekupheleni komugqa wesiphakamiso ngenkathi uthayipha. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi nanoma yiluphi ulimi onamagama angukhiye alo. I-%1$s iphinde iphakamise u-🎂.
Bonisa i-emoji ngenkathi uthayipha. Igama elithi birthday liphakamisa 🎂 🎉 🥳

Ithebhu yomlando ibala izintandokazi zakho kuqala bese kuba ama-emoji owasebenzise muva nje. Amashumi amathathu nambili cishe umugqa owodwa ocingweni oluncane kanye nemine kuthebhulethi, ngakho-ke yikhuphule uma umlando uzwakala umfushane kakhulu. Ukuyehlisa kususa uhlu ngokushesha. Lesi silungiselelo singu-32 ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Usayizi we-emoji kugridi yepaneli ye-emoji, kuthebhu ngayinye naseziphumeni zokusesha. Amaseli ahlala enendawo eyanele ezungeze i-emoji ngayinye, ngakho usayizi omkhulu kakhulu ungasho nezinsika ezimbalwa. I-popup yokucindezela nokubamba igcina usayizi wayo.
Ukuthi iphaneli ye-emoji idweba i-emoji ngayinye ngobukhulu obungakanani

Ikhibhodi ikhombisa ama-emoji anethoni (👍, 🙏, 🧑…) ngale thoni ye-Fitzpatrick kugridi yephaneli ye-emoji, umugqa weziphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yokusesha i-emoji. Iphinde iwafake ngaleyo thoni. I-emoji okhethele yona ithoni igcina ithoni yakho ngenkathi \"Override with last used\" ivuliwe. Inketho yokuqala (✋) igcina isisekelo esiphuzi esingathathi hlangothi.
Okwe-emoji enethoni kuphaneli, iziphakamiso kanye nokusesha

Cindezela ubambe i-emoji kuphaneli ye-emoji ukuze uthole isilawuli esiyithumela njengesithombe, ngefonti ye-emoji oyikhethile. Lokhu kuwusizo uma omunye umuntu enedivayisi edweba i-emoji ngendlela ehlukile, noma engakwazi ukuyidweba nhlobo. Ikhibhodi idweba isithombe kudivayisi yakho futhi ayilandi lutho, ngaphandle kokukodwa kwefonti ye-emoji yakwa-Google. Isithombe siphuma ngendlela efanayo nezitika zethuluzi lezitika. Ukuze ushintshe lokho, vula Amathuluzi, bese Izitika, bese \"Thumela izitika njenge\". Isilawuli asiveli kuhlelo lokusebenza olungamukeli zithombe.
Engeza isilawuli esithumela i-emoji uqobo njengesithombe

I-“Recent” ibala ama-emoji ngokulandelana owasebenzise ngakho okokugcina. I-“Most used” ibeka ama-emoji owasebenzisa kakhulu kuqala. Ikhibhodi ihlale igcina ama-emoji owathandayo ekuqaleni kwazo zombili izinhlu.
Ayikho ithebhu yomlando. Iphaneli ivuleka esigabeni sokuqala
Ukuthi ithebhu yesigaba ingaba ncane kangakanani ngaphambi kokuba amathebhu aphequlule eceleni. Okuncane kufaka ithebhu ngayinye esikrinini
Ithiphu: cindezela ubambe noma iyiphi i-emoji kuphaneli ukuze uyenze ibe intandokazi noma ukukhetha amathoni esikhumba. Nge-emoji enabantu ababili, njenge-🤝, ungasetha ithoni yomuntu ngamunye.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, futhi kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, i-emoji osuvele ukhethe ithoni yayo igcina leyo thoni kuyo yonke indawo: kuphaneli, eziphakamisweni nasekusesheni. Ukhetha leyo thoni kusuka kokuvela uma ucindezela ubambe i-emoji kuphaneli. I-emoji ayisebenzisi okuzenzakalelayo okungenhla. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, ithoni yesikhumba ezenzakalelayo ihlale inqoba.
Sebenzisa ithoni oyikhethe okokugcina nge-emoji, hhayi eyenzakalelayo

Inkinobho ye-emoji ihlala ibonakala kubha engenhla, ngenkathi iziphakamiso zibonisa. Iphaneli ye-emoji inethebhu yesigaba ngasinye. Ungasesha ngesiNgisi nangesi-Bengali, nanoma yiluphi ulimi ongeza iphakethe lamagama angukhiye kulo. Cindezela ubambe i-emoji ukuze uthole izinhlobo zethoni yesikhumba.
Vula ama-emoji ngokucindezela kanye kusuka kubha engaphezulu

Thayipha amagama egama le-Unicode lomlingiswa ekusesheni kwe-emoji futhi lizovela ngemva kwe-emoji: em dash, copyright sign, greek small letter lambda, latin small letter a with ogonek. Wonke umlingiswa we-Basic Multilingual Plane uhlanganisiwe, okuyizinkulungwane zezinhlamvu, izimpawu nemifanekiso. Ukuthepha okukodwa kuyayifaka. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukusesha kwe-emoji kubuye kuthole izimpawu, izinhlamvu namamaki ngamagama egama lazo
Thola noma yiluphi uhlamvu ngegama lalo le-Unicode
Thayipha noma unamathisele i-kaomoji, bese uyinika amathegi
Engeza, shintsha, hlunga futhi ususe ubuso kulabhulali yakho

plurals.item: Futhi inesithombe esingu-%1$d. Ikhibhodi ikubeka ephaketheni elisha lezitikha.
Futhi inezithombe ezingu-%1$d. Ikhibhodi izibeka ephaketheni elisha lezitikha.

resources.string: Ikhibhodi inamaphakethe ezitikha amaningi kakhulu, ngakho izithombe azingeniswanga.
Ukuthunyelwa kwe-Emotic, ifayela elivela kule khibhodi, noma uhlu olunobuso obubodwa emgqeni ngamunye
Leli fayela alinawo ubuso ikhibhodi engabufunda.
Bonisa ubuso obufana nokusho emva kwe-emoji ekusesheni kwepaneli ye-emoji
Njengoba ikholomu icishiwe, izinkinobho zokwengeza, ukuhlela namathegi ziya ekupheleni komugqa wamathegi, ukuze usakwazi ukushintsha ubuso bakho ukusuka kukhibhodi.
Ikholomu yezinkinobho eceleni kobuso: sesha, engeza, hlela namathegi
Lokhu kususa ubuso obungezile, izinguquko zakho, izintandokazi zakho kanye nobuso bakho bamuva.
Bonisa :-) nezinye ubuso be-ASCII kuthebhu yabo
Ithegi elikhonjiswa ithebhu uma uvula iphaneli ye-emoji
Amathegi, izinkinobho zokuhlela, ubuso bakho kanye nokungeniswa okuvela ku-Emotic

Ikhibhodi ikhombisa ubuso bethegi uma igama olithayiphayo liyigama laleyo thegi. Izintandokazi zakho nobuso obusebenzisa kakhulu buza kuqala. Uma ucindezela obunye, bungena ngemva kwegama lakho, noma esikhundleni salo, okufana nesiphakamiso se-emoji.
Thayipha ithegi, njenge-shrug noma i-tableflip, ukuze ubone ubuso bayo eziphakamisweni
Ulayini wamathegi phezulu kwithebhu. Uma uvaliwe ubonisa uhlu olude olulodwa olunesihloko sethegi ngayinye.
Awekho amathegi okwamanje. Nikeza ubuso ithegi, noma wengeze eyodwa lapha.
Hlunga, fihla, qamba kabusha futhi ususe amathegi omugqa wamathegi

Lokhu kubeka igama lohlelo lokusebenza phambi kolimi kulebula yesishintshi. I-Android inquma ukuthi ilibeka kanjani ilebula negama lohlelo lokusebenza, njengokuthi yikuphi okugqamile noma okumpunga. Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha kuphela umbhalo welebula, hhayi lokho kusetha.

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ilanda amafayela amancane ulimi oluwadingayo, uma uluveza futhi uma olusha lushicilelwe: amagama angukhiye we-emoji, ukuze izimpendulo zosesho lwe-emoji zibe ngolimi lwakho, nedatha yokubhangqa amagama, okwenza izibikezelo zibe ngcono. Izinhlu zamagama azilande nhlobo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, akukho lutho olulandwayo kuze kube yilapho ulucela esikrinini solimi.
Thola amagama angukhiye we-emoji nedatha yokubikezela ngezilimi ozisebenzisayo

Ukungeza ulimi olubhalwe ngesi-Roman njenge-Banglish kuluxhumanisa nezinye izilimi ezabelana ngombhalo walo, ngakho iziphakamiso zivela kuzo zombili. Ukuxhumanisa kwenzeka njalo uma ungeza ulimi, okusho ukuthi isixhumanisi osisuse ngesandla sizobuya. Vala lokhu ukuze ugcine izinqumo zakho. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bhangqa ulimi olubhalwe ngezinhlamvu zesi-Roman nezilimi olubhalwa nazo

Izakhiwo zefonetiki ezifana ne-Avro, i-Hindi phonetic ne-Khipro zibhala imibhalo yazo ngezinhlamvu zesi-Roman. Uma uqaphela phakathi negama ukuthi usasebenzisa ikhibhodi yakho yesi-Latin, ukushintsha ulimi manje kuguqula izinhlamvu osuvele uzithayiphile esikhundleni sokuzishiya njengoba zinjalo: thayipha u-tu, shintshela ku-Avro, bese igama lifundeka lithi তু, ngakho-ke u-mi ngemva kokuba liqedile lithi তুমি. Vala lokhu uma uvame ukushintsha ulimi ngemva nje kwegama lesiNgisi nangaphambi kokuthayipha isikhala, ngoba lelo gama liyadluliselwa nalo.
Shintshela ekuhleleni kwefonetiki phakathi negama futhi nezinhlamvu ozithayiphile ziyaguquka nazo

Yonke uhlelo lokusebenza lubuyela ekulandeni ulimi lwakho lokugcina olusetshenzisiwe. Isilungiselelo esibakhumbulayo sihlala sivuliwe, ngakho-ke izinhlelo zokusebenza zizoqala ukukhunjulwa futhi njengoba ushintsha ulimi ngaphakathi kwazo.

resources.string: Yonke imiklamo oyivulayo inemodi yayo yokufaka. Sebenzisa ukhiye we-🌐 noma uswayiphe ibha yesikhala ukuze ushintshe phakathi kwayo.
Zenzela eyakho igridi yezinkinobho, noma uqale ngaleyo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi
Qinisekisa ukulandwa kolimi uma ungekho ku-Wi-Fi
Engeza ulimi ngalunye kusishintshi sendlela yokufaka sohlelo

Uma ushintsha ulimi ngenkathi uthayipha kuhlelo lokusebenza, ikhibhodi iyakhumbula ukukhetha kwakho kwalolo hlelo. Ikhibhodi isebenzisa lolo limi futhi ngesikhathi esilandelayo lapho uthayipha khona. Ungashintsha ulimi ngokusebenzisa ukhiye we-🌐, ukuswayipha ibha yesikhala (spacebar), noma isikhethi. Izinhlelo zokusebenza lapho ungakhethanga ulimi zisebenzisa ulimi lwakho lokugcina. Inkambu edinga izinhlamvu zesiLatini, njengebhokisi lephasiwedi, isaqhubeka nokukwenza lokhu. Inkambu enikeza ulimi lwayo nayo iyakuqeda lokhu.
Vula uhlelo lokusebenza ngalunye ngesakhiwo osisebenzise lapho okokugcina
I-Android 13 nezindala: khetha ulimi ngalunye lapha, kungenjalo isishintshi sibonisa olulodwa kuphela
Uhlu lwe-Android. Lusebenzise kuphela uma isishintshi sibukeka singalungile

Bamba ibha yesikhala (spacebar) bese ukubuka kuqala okungaphezulu kwayo kubhala izilimi zakho. Ngalokhu kusethwe, kunesinye isitobhi esilandela esokugcina kuzo: igiya elivula lesi sikrini, noma ikhibhodi evula uhlu lwezinhlelo zekhibhodi ze-Android. Hudulela kuso bese uphakamisa ukuze uye lapho. Ukubamba kuphela okufinyelela kuso. Ukuswayipha okusheshayo kubha yesikhala kusazodlula ezilimini zakho kuphela, ngakho akusoze kwangena kuzilungiselelo ngephutha. Uhlu nezikhethi zekharuseli zibonisa igiya njengomugqa wazo, eduze kwezinye izinhlelo zekhibhodi.
Ngemva kwezilimi zakho, ukubamba ibha yesikhala kungafinyelela kuzilungiselelo zolimi noma amanye amakhibhodi akho

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukhiye we-emoji nethuluzi le-emoji kuvula iphaneli kwemithathu oyisebenzise okokugcina. Uma iphaneli eyodwa kuleyo mithathu ivuliwe, bayayivala. Uma lokhu kucishiwe, ukhiye we-emoji njalo uvula iphaneli le-emoji. Ikhibhodi iyakhohlwa iphaneli lokugcina lapho iphinda iqalwa.
Ukhiye we-emoji uvula ama-emoji, ama-GIF noma izitikha, njengoba nje uwashiyile

Isishintshi sinenkinobho eyodwa ngayinye yephaneli ye-emoji, iphaneli ye-GIF kanye nephaneli yesitikha, ukuze ukwazi ukuya kwenye ngqo. Isendaweni efanayo kuwo wonke amaphaneli amathathu. \"Phansi\" ikubeka emgqeni ongezansi, phakathi kwe-ABC nebha yesikhala. \"Phezulu\" ikubeka ekugcineni komugqa wokusesha. Inkinobho ye-GIF nenkinobho yesitikha zibonakala kuphela ngenkathi lawo mathuluzi evuliwe. Uma ushintshe isakhiwo sephaneli ye-emoji, isishintshi sisezindaweni lapho isakhiwo sakho sisibeka khona. Ukuze usengeze, sebenzisa ingxenye ethi \"Emoji, GIF and sticker switch\" kumhleli wesakhiwo sephaneli.
Lapho amaphaneli e-emoji, i-GIF kanye nezitika ebonisa izinkinobho eziphakathi kwawo

Iphaneli ende ibonisa ama-emoji amaningi, ama-GIF nezitikha ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izinhlamvu zigcina ukuphakama kwazo, futhi amaphaneli amathathu anokuphakama okufanayo, ngakho ikhibhodi ayinyakazi uma usuka kwelinye uya kwelinye. Iphaneli ayisoze yamboza ngaphezu kwesikrini esiningi, ngakho esikrinini esifushane, noma uma ifoni iseceleni, ingahlala imfushane kunalokhu.
Ukuthi amaphaneli e-emoji, i-GIF kanye nezitika avuleka kangakanani kunekhibhodi
Beka lezi zinkinobho ngemva kweziphakamiso, ekugcineni komugqa
Ukuthi isithonjana esikunkinobho ngayinye eceleni kweziphakamiso sikhulu kangakanani
Linganisela izinkinobho eziseceleni kweziphakamiso ngaphandle kwamathuluzi e-toolbar
Ithuluzi elihlala kubha ephezulu ngenkathi iziphakamiso zibonisa
Ukuthi inkinobho ngayinye eceleni kweziphakamiso ibanzi kangakanani
Beka ibhokisi lamathuluzi kuqala phakathi kwalezi zinkinobho, ukuze kube ukuthepha okukodwa ngenkathi iziphakamiso ziboniswa
Inkinobho ye-ANSI ngezakhiwo zesi-Bengali ibhala umbhalo wesitayela se-Bijoy, ngakho u-আ uvele njengo-Av

Amafonti e-ANSI awawafaki wonke amagama ezindaweni ezifanayo, ngakho-ke kunezinhlobo ezintathu. Uhlobo 2 luyilona olujwayelekile, olusetshenziswa ngamafonti i-SutonnyMJ namafonti amaningi e-Bijoy. Uma umbhalo uvela ngezinhlamvu ezingalungile kufonti yakho, zama elinye uhlobo.
Khetha leyo ifonti yakho ye-ANSI eyenzelwe yona
I-%1$s ne-%2$s manje ziphakamisana amagama. Ungakushintsha lokhu ekhasini lolimi ngalunye.

Vala lokhu ukuze ugcine igama ngalinye olithayiphayo ku-%1$s njengoba uli thayiphile, ngenkathi ezinye izilimi zisacushwa. Umugqa weziphakamiso usakhombisa iziphakamiso zawo, futhi ungathepha eyodwa. Inkinobho yokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ekuthayipheni icisha ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuzo zonke izilimi.
Lungisa amaphutha okuthayipha uma ucindezela isikhala
Amagama kuphela i-Avro yedeskithophu eyaziyo, %1$s ukuze ulande. Thinta ukuze ulande.

Ngemuva kukaveli, okhiye be-আ-কার ne-এ-কার babhala u-য়া no-য়ে, njengaku-কায়া no-দিয়ে, ngoba u-া noma u-ে oqondile awukwazi ukulandela ukaveli. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukucindezela ukhiye futhi ngokushesha kuphendula u-য়া ube u-আ no-য়ে ube u-এ. Ukubamba noma yimuphi ukhiye kunikeza u-আ noma u-এ kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lokhu kuvuliwe noma cha. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba ukucindezela kabili ngokushesha bese uthayipha i-glide kabili.
Ku-Probhat, Jatiya naku-BSTI, ngemva kukavoweli: ukuthepha kanye kunikeza য়া noma য়ে, ukuthepha okwesibili kunikeza আ noma এ
Thepha kabili ukuze uthole u-আ noma u-এ
Isakhiwo sithola isichazamazwi, ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kanye nemithetho yesipelingi ye-%1$s. Sengezwa ezakhiweni zakho futhi sivulwe.
Alikho elinye ulimi olusebenzisa izinhlamvu ezifanayo ne-%1$s elinesakhiwo esingasinikeza.
Thayipha %1$s ku-QWERTZ, AZERTY noma esinye isakhiwo
Zibekele ezakho izinkinobho. Kopisha, namathisela, ngenisa noma uthumele uhlelo, ngefomethi efanayo ne-fcitx
I-Double Pinyin: thayipha isilabhili ngasinye ngezinkinobho ezimbili ncamashi. Idinga isichazamazwi se-Pinyin esingenhla.
Landa isichazamazwi sokuguqula esikhulu. Siphethe izinhlamvu nemisho eminingi kunesethi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Isebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi ngemuva kokulanda.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde %1$s lwengeza izinhlamvu ezingu-%2$d.
Lelo fayela liyingqikithi ye-FlorisBoard noma isandiso sekhibhodi, hhayi iphakethe lolimi. Ukuze ungenise ingqikithi, iya ku-Themes.
Funda iphakethe lolimi lwe-FlorisBoard (.flex). Lingagcwalisa amatafula e-Cangjie nawemivimbo ngenhla.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lelo fayela njengephakethe lolimi lwe-FlorisBoard.
Leli phakethe liqukethe %1$s. Le khibhodi ithayipha i-Cangjie ne-stroke, ngakho-ke akukho lutho kulo olungasetshenziswa.

Umbhalo wesiJapane nesiShayina uhlukaniswa ngesikhala se-ideographic (U+3000), esibanzi njengohlamvu olulodwa. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ibha yesikhala iyayithayipha esikhundleni sesikhala esincane esisetshenziswa phakathi kwamagama kwezinye izilimi. Isikhala esicindezelwe ngenkathi usathayipha ukufunda sikhetha umuntu ozongenela ukhetho njengakuqala, futhi ukucindezela kuphela lapho kungekho lutho olulindele ukuguqulwa okuthayipha isikhala.

Khetha imisindo ofuna ifaniswe. Yonke ivuliwe ekuqaleni. Ukucisha okubhangqiwe kwenza isipelingi sakho sibe yiqiniso futhi, okukunika ukunemba okuthile: okubhangqiwe kokugcina kuwukugcizelela kwesifunda futhi akukubizi kakhulu, kuyilapho u-n↔l ethinta wonke ama-syllable aqala nganoma yikuphi.
Qhathanisa imisindo edidayo: zh↔z, ch↔c, sh↔s, n↔l, an↔ang, in↔ing…

Uhlamvu olungelona isilabhili ephelele lumelela zonke izilabhili eziqala ngalo, ngakho-ke i-wm ithola i-我们 kanti i-haod ithola i-好的. Uhlamvu ngalunye luyisilabhili eyodwa: i-hd isho i-h… kanye ne-d…. Isilabhili oyithayipha ngokugcwele ifaniswa ngokunembile futhi iza kuqala. Izinhlamvu u-z, c kanye no-s nazo zihlanganisa u-zh, ch kanye no-sh. Uhlelo lwe-Double Pinyin alusebenzisi lokhu, ngoba zonke izilabhili lapho ziyizinkinobho ezimbili ncamashi.
Thayipha incwadi yokuqala kuphela yesilabhili: wm ithola 我们, zg ithola 中国
Qondanisa imisindo ehlanganisiwe: n↔l, ng↔∅, gw→g ngaphambi kuka -o, -ng↔-n, -k↔-t…

Ezinhlelweni ze-Flick ne-Kana JIS, i-kana encane, i-゛ noma i-゜ iyisihluthulelo esengeziwe. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, i-kana elula nayo ihambisana nalezo zinhlobo: か ithola が, つ ithola っ ne-づ, は ithola ば ne-ぱ, や ithola ゃ. Lapho amagama amabili evame kakhulu ngokulinganayo, lelo olithayiphe ngqo liza kuqala. I-kana oyithayiphe ngophawu ayishintshi, futhi ukuthayipha kwe-Romaji akushintshi.
I-かつこう iphinde ithole i-学校 (がっこう)
%1$s ithayipha ukufunda futhi ikuguqule kube izinhlamvu ezivela kulesi sichazamazwi. Ngaphandle kwayo, azikho izinhlamvu ezinikezwayo. I-%2$s futhi isebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi uma isilandiwe.

Uma ukuguqulwa sekuqediwe futhi kungekho okubhalwayo, umugqa ubonisa amagama avame ukulandela umbhalo ngaphambi kwesikhombisi. Thepha elilodwa ukuze ulibhale, bese umugqa ubonisa okulandelayo. Amagama owabhalayo ngemva kwabanye eza kuqala, kulandele amabhangqa amagama ajwayelekile, bese kuba okusele kwegama eliqala ngohlamvu lokugcina (无 inikeza 聊). Lokhu kudinga iphakethe lamabhangqa amagama.
Ngemva kokukhetha umbhalo wesiShayina, bonisa amagama avame ukulandela

Uma kuvuliwe, i-pinyin, i-zhuyin noma i-Jyutping oyithayiphayo ibonakala idwetshelwe enkundleni yombhalo uze ukhethe okukhethwayo. Uma kuvaliwe, inkundla yombhalo ihlala injalo, futhi ikhibhodi ibonisa lokho okuthayiphile ekuqaleni komugqa wokukhethwayo. Okukhethwayo okukhethayo kuphela okungena enkundleni yombhalo, ngendlela i-fcitx5 esebenza ngayo.
Uma icishiwe, i-pinyin oyithayiphayo ibonakala kuphela kukhibhodi, ngaphambi kwabakhethiweyo
Izinketho ezingcono kakhulu zakho konke okuthayiphile ziya enkundleni yombhalo
I-pinyin noma i-zhuyin ingena enkundleni yombhalo njengezinhlamvu, ngendlela i-fcitx5 eyenza ngayo
Amagama esifunda. I-Taiwan ne-Hong Kong ngokuvamile zisebenzisa amagama ahlukene entweni efanayo, hhayi izinhlamvu ezihlukene kuphela.
出租車 → 計程車, 光盤 → 光碟
Ishintsha amagama abe ngamagama ase-Taiwan: 出租車 ibe yi-計程車, 光盤 ibe yi-光碟

Thayipha i-rq yosuku, i-sj yesikhathi kanye ne-xq sosuku lweviki. Lokhu kubonakala ngemva komuntu ozongenela okhethweni ongcono kakhulu wezinhlamvu ezifanayo. Thayipha u-v bese ufaka inombolo, isibonelo v1234.5, ukuze uyithole njenge-一千二百三十四点五, njenge-壹仟贰佰叁拾肆点伍 yamanani, noma idijithi ngedijithi. Ayikho i-pinyin syllable eqala ngo-v, ngakho lokhu akushintshi i-pinyin.
i-rq ithayipha usuku, i-sj isikhathi, i-xq usuku lweviki, i-v nenombolo kunikeza izinombolo zesiShayina

Uma kucishiwe, ibha yesikhala ithayipha umuntu okhethiwe wokuqala ngokushesha. Uma kuvuliwe, ukucindezela kokuqala kuyayigqamisa futhi ukucindezela ngakunye ngemva kwalokho kuthuthela kokulandelayo, ngendlela izindlela zokufaka zaseJapane ezisebenza ngayo. U-Enter uthayipha okhethiwe ogqanyisiwe, ukuthayipha kuqhubeke kukugcina bese kuqala ukufunda okusha, futhi i-backspace ibuyela emuva ekufundeni. Ngekhibhodi ebonakalayo, okhiye bomcibisholo bahambisa ukugqamisa nganoma iyiphi indlela, u-Enter noma isikhala kuyayithayipha, futhi uma okuthile kugqanyisiwe okhiye 1 kuya ku-9 bakhetha okhethiwe futhi u-Escape ubuyela emuva ekufundeni.
Isikhala sigqamisa umuntu olandelayo, kanti u-Enter uyayithayipha
Inkinobho eseceleni kwabakhethiweyo ishintsha phakathi kwesiShayina esenziwe lula nesiDala

Ikhibhodi iguqula umuntu ngamunye kusuka kokulula (简体) kuya kokudala (繁體) ngaphambi kokuba ikubonise. Ukuguqulwa kufunda uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Izinhlamvu ezimbalwa ezilula zinohlobo olungaphezu kolulodwa lwendabuko, futhi ikhibhodi ihlale ibhala leyo evame kakhulu. 发 iba ngu-發, okuyiqiniso ku-發展 kodwa okungalungile ku-頭髮. Lungisa lawo magama ngesandla.
Ikhibhodi iguqula izinhlamvu zibe isiShayina sendabuko (繁體). Iguqula uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho ezinye izinhlobo ezincike kumongo azilungile (发 → 發 / 髮).

I-Backspace ngokuvamile isusa ikhodi eyodwa ngesikhathi. Lokhu kwesinye isikhathi kushiya amaqoqo angaphelele esikrinini. Ngalolu hlelo oluvuliwe, ukucindezela okukodwa kususa iqoqo lonke ngenkathi uthayipha %1$s. Ezinye izilimi zigcina izilungiselelo zazo.
Susa iqoqo lonke elinjenge-%1$s njengeyunithi eyodwa
I-%1$s inohlu lwamagama olulandiwe noma amagama angukhiye we-emoji. Uyafuna ukuzisusa futhi uthole cishe i-%2$s yesikhala sokugcina?

Uhlu oludivayisini yakho luhlala endaweni yalo kuze kube yilapho olusha luqeda ukulanda, bese luthathwa indawo yilo.

I-Zawgyi wuhlelo lokubhala olwalusetshenziswa ngombhalo wesi-Burmese ngaphambi kwe-Unicode, futhi amafoni amaningi, izinhlelo zokusebenza nabangane basayisebenzisa. Isebenzisa izinhlamvu ezifanayo ne-Unicode kodwa izibeka ngendlela ehlukile, ngakho umbhalo obhalelwe eyodwa ufundeka njengezinhlamvu eziphukile kwenye. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, zonke izakhiwo zesi-Burmese ziba nenkinobho ye-Zawgyi eduze neziphakamiso. Thayipha kuyo bese lokho okuthayiphayo kuya ebhokisini lombhalo njenge-Zawgyi. Thayipha futhi nge-Unicode. Iziphakamiso, ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo nohlu lwamagama ziyaqhubeka zisebenza nge-Unicode ngenkathi uthayipha. Igama olithayiphayo livela njenge-Unicode kuze kube yilapho uliqeda. Lapho ibhokisi lombhalo selivele line-Zawgyi, ikhibhodi inikela ngokubhala i-Zawgyi lapho noma ngabe inkinobho icishiwe.
Inkinobho ye-Zawgyi ezakhiweni zesi-Burmese ibhala umbhalo wamafonti e-Zawgyi

Ifoni esethwele i-Zawgyi inefonti ye-Zawgyi esikhundleni sefonti yayo yase-Myanmar, futhi leyo fonti ikhombisa izinhlamvu ze-Unicode ngokulandelana okungalungile. Okhiye bekhibhodi neziphakamiso yi-Unicode, ngakho-ke ocingweni olunjalo zingabukeka ziphukile. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi idweba isi-Burmese kukhophi yayo ye-Noto Sans Myanmar, ifonti ye-Unicode, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iyiphi ifonti efoni eyisebenzisayo. Ifonti ilandwa kanye kusuka endaweni yokugcina idatha ye-WM Keyboard (195 KB) okokuqala lapho okhiye beyidinga. Ifonti yase-Myanmar oyikhethile ngaphansi kokuthi Ukubukeka isaqala kuqala.
Dweba okhiye besi-Burmese ku-Noto Sans Myanmar, ocingweni olufonti yalo kungu-Zawgyi
Thepha umbhangqwana ukuze uwenze igama. Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuqala luvuleka phezulu, noma kwesobunxele, kanti olwesibili eceleni kwalo.

Azikho izibhangqwana okwamanje. Kusivuli sohlelo lokusebenza sekhibhodi, cindezela uphinde ubambe uhlelo lokusebenza, khetha i-Bhangqa esikrinini esihlukanisiwe ne..., bese uthinta uhlelo lokusebenza lwesibili.
Isikrini esihlukanisiwe kusuka kukhibhodi sidinga i-Android 12L noma kamuva. Izithombe kule foni zivula uhlelo lwazo lokuqala kuphela.

Ikhibhodi yengeza umugqa wezinkinobho zemicibisholo emine ngaphansi kwebha yesikhala, ukuze ukwazi ukuhambisa isikhombisi ngaphandle kwebha yamathuluzi noma ukuhudula kubha yesikhala. Bamba umcibisholo ukuze uqhubeke nokuhamba. Umugqa mude njengomugqa wezinombolo, futhi ikhibhodi ikhula ngalelo nani.
Okhiye bavela emgqeni kusuka kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla ngokulandelana kwalolu hlu.
Hudula izibambo ukuze ubeke imicibisholo ngokulandelana okufunayo
Bonisa okhiye besobunxele, phezulu, phansi nangakwesokudla ngaphansi kwekhibhodi

Amakhona asikwa kuyo yonke ikhibhodi, futhi uhlelo lokusebenza lubonakala kuwo. Setha phezulu naphansi ngokwehlukana, bese ukhetha amakhona ngaphansi kokuthi Yimaphi amakhona. Amakhona aphansi ayindilinga afanele ukuzulazula ngokuthinta kanye nefoni enamakhona esikrini ayindilinga. Lokhu akushintshi ikhibhodi entantayo, enamakhona ayindilinga ayo. Zombili ziyisikwele ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ikhibhodi yonke inyuka, isuke onqenqemeni olungezansi kanye nebha yokuzulazula. Yandisa lokhu uma umugqa ongezansi usondele kakhulu onqenqemeni lwesikrini, noma uma uqala ukuzulazula kwesistimu ngephutha.
Isikhala esengeziwe ngaphansi kokhiye, ngaphezu kwebha yokuzulazula

Ulayini ongezansi uphethe ibha yesikhala nokhiye wokungena. Uwupe ukuphakama okude noma okufushane kunokhiye bezinhlamvu, ukuze uthole ibha yesikhala enkulu ngaphandle kwekhibhodi ende. \"Landela okhiye\" kuyisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo futhi kugcina ulayini ongezansi unokuphakama okufanayo neminye imigqa. Izakhiwo zangokwezifiso ezibeka ukuphakama kwazo kolayini ziyakuziba lokhu kulungiselelwa.
Ukuphakama kwesikhala kanye nomugqa wokufaka uwedwa

Ukhiye kakoma emgqeni ongezansi uba ukhiye we-emoji, futhi ukoma kuthuthela kokunye okukhethwa kukho lapho ucindezela ubambe. Lokhu kususa nethuluzi le-emoji kubha yamathuluzi, ngoba ukhiye uyalithatha indawo yalo. Hudula ithuluzi uphume ebhokisini lamathuluzi futhi uma ufuna womabili.
Faka ukhiye we-emoji esikhundleni sokhiye kakoma
Izakhiwo abanye abantu abazenzile futhi bazabelana ngazo
Yengeza unhlangothi kuhlamvu lwesi-Korean lokugcina oluthayiphile: ㄱ kuya ku-ㅋ, ㄴ kuya ku-ㄷ kuya ku-ㅌ, ㅏ kuya ku-ㅑ, nokubuyela emuva
Okufakiwe okwengeziwe kule pop-up efanayo okwenza okuthile esikhundleni sokuthayipha: Ithebhu, ukuthayipha ngezwi, iphedi yokuhlela. Thepha okukodwa ukuze ukushintshe.
Ichashazi elilodwa le-braille chord yezinkinobho eziyisithupha. Setha inombolo yechashazi ngezansi
Ithumela ukusakazwa kwe-Android ngezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizenzakalelayo ezifana ne-Tasker. Setha isenzo ngezansi
Ivula futhi ivale i-caps lock ngokucindezela kanye. Ezakhiweni ezibanzi ezine-shift key
Ishintsha ungwaqa wesi-Korean wokugcina owuthayiphile ube ifomu lawo eliphindwe kabili nokubuyela emuva: ㄱ kuya ku-ㄲ, ㅂ kuya ku-ㅃ
Imicibisholo, ukunyakaza kwamagama, ikhasi phezulu naphansi, ukuqala nokuphela komugqa kanye nombhalo, Khetha, Khetha konke, Sika, Kopisha, Namathisela futhi Susa. Khetha umsebenzi ngezansi
Yenza isenzo sohlelo lokusebenza: thumela, sesha noma kwenziwe
Ingxenye ebukhoma yephaneli: igridi ye-emoji, umlando webhodi lokunamathisela, ibhokisi lokusesha
Izinguquko kugridi ye-Fn yalesi sakhiwo sokhiye owodwa
⌦ isusa umbhalo ngemva kwesikhombisi. Iyaphindaphinda ngenkathi uyibambile
Ishintsha abangenele ukhetho besiShayina phakathi kwezinhlamvu eziLula (简体) neziNdabuko (繁體). Isilungiselelo esifanayo nezinhlamvu zendabuko esikrinini sesiShayina
Ivula uhlu lwesistimu lwekhibhodi kudivayisi yakho, ukuze ukwazi ukushintshela kwenye
Ishintsha i-kana yokugcina oyithayiphile ibe ifomu layo elincane, i-゛ noma ゜: か ibe が, は ibe ば ibe ぱ, つ ibe っ
Ibonisa esinye sezakhiwo zakho zesibili phezu kwezinhlamvu. Cindezela ukhiye futhi, noma ukhiye we-ABC, ukuze ubuyele emuva. Khetha isakhiwo ngezansi
Ivula enye yezindlela zekhibhodi yakho, ngendlela efanayo nokuyikhetha ethuluzini le-Modes. Cindezela futhi ukuze ubuyele kokuzenzakalelayo. Khetha imodi ngezansi
Kusebenza kukhiye olandelayo. Cindezela kabili ukuze uyikhiye
Yengeza isignali ende. Uhlamvu luyathunyelwa ngemva kwekhefu
Yengeza isignali emfushane. Uhlamvu luyathunyelwa ngemva kwekhefu
Njalo uthayipha ikhefu lomugqa, ngisho nalapho u-enter ethumela
Isikhala ngenhloso. Uhlelo lokusebenza ludweba isikhala esingenalutho futhi lungayinaki imiyalo yokucindezela

Izenzo ngokuvamile ziza ngemva kwazo zonke ezinye izinketho. Zibeke ngemva kohlamvu futhi zizoba ukuslayida okufushane ukusuka ekhiye, kuyilapho ukucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile kusathayipha inketho yokuqala. Zibeke kuqala futhi ukucindezela nokubamba okujwayelekile kuzosebenzisa isenzo sokuqala. Izenzo zihlala ndawonye, ngokulandelana kwazo. Lokhu kudinga Khetha ngaphandle kokuphakamisa, ngaphansi kokucindezela okhiye, Okhiye abanye.
Indawo yazo phakathi kwezinye izinketho ku-popup

Uhlu oluskrolayo esikhundleni sokhiye. Ngenkathi uthayipha ku-pad ye-T9 pinyin, ibala ama-syllable okhiye bakho abangawapela, ukuze ukhethe owodwa; ngaphandle kwalokho ibala izinhlamvu zokhiye ezicindezelwe isikhathi eside
Cindezela kanye ukuze uthole uhlamvu olukhulu. Cindezela kabili ukuze uvule okhiye abakhulu
Ukuhlephula kulo khiye kuhambisa isikhombisi noma kushintsha isakhiwo
Iya ngqo kolunye uhlelo lokusebenza lwekhibhodi kudivayisi yakho, ngaphandle kohlu. Khetha ikhibhodi ngezansi
Ilebhuli, noma okukhiphayo uma usethe okukodwa
Ivula elinye lamathuluzi ekhibhodi, njengokuthayipha ngezwi noma iphedi yokuhlela. Khetha ithuluzi ngezansi
Ivula igridi yawo wonke amathuluzi, njengenkinobho ekuqaleni kwebha yamathuluzi

Ukubuka kuqala kuvame ukugcina okhiye phakathi kwebanga elinethezekile ukuze igridi yonke ilingane kulesi sikrini. Vula lokhu ukuze ubone izilinganiso zakho zangempela, okubalulekile uma uthayipha ngokuphakama okukhulu kokhiye. Igridi ingase iphume esikrinini futhi idinge ukuskrola.
Dweba igridi ngokuphakama okuthayipha ngakho ngempela
Iqala ku-Esc, F1 kuya ku-F12, Tab, imicibisholo kanye ne-Home/End
Ingeza umugqa ongenalutho ekupheleni kwalo mkhakha

Lokhu ukubalwa kwekholomu kwalesi sikhiye sodwa. Izikhiye ziyahluka: isikhiye esinezikhiye ezishintshanayo eziyishumi nambili sifundeka kangcono njengegridi, kanti esinezintathu noma ezine sifundeka kangcono njengomugqa owodwa. Kusuka kuzilungiselelo kushiya isikhiye kusilungiselelo esithi \"Izikholomu zesikhiye esishintshanayo\" ngaphansi kokuthi Ukucindezela isikhiye, okuyinto ezenzakalelayo ngaphandle uma uyishintshile. Inombolo esuka ku-3 iye ku-11 inika lesi sikhiye lezo zikholomu eziningi noma ngabe izilungiselelo zithini.
Mangaki amanye amagama lesi sikhi esiwabeka emgqeni
Hlukanisa okufakiwe ngezikhala, ukuze okunye kungabi yisikhala. Okufakiwe okunezinhlamvu ezingaphezu kweyodwa, njenge-.com, kulungile. Uhlelo lokusebenza luphinde ludwebe eyokuqala ekhoneni lokhiye.

Ikhibhodi ibonisa lo mugqa ngaphansi kwale ngqimba uma umugqa wezinkinobho zomcibisholo uvuliwe kokuthi Isakhiwo nosayizi. Ungangeza noma yimuphi ukhiye kuwo, njengegama elingakwesobunxele noma u-Shift wesibili.
Ikhibhodi ikhombisa umugqa ongezansi walolu lwembo ngendlela ehlukile, ngenxa yalezi zilungiselelo zezinkinobho zomugqa ongezansi. Igridi engenhla ikhombisa umugqa njengoba ikhibhodi yenza:

Izilungiselelo zokhiye bomugqa ongezansi zishintsha umugqa ongezansi wayo yonke isakhiwo. Zikwazi ukufihla ukhiye u-🌐, ukuwuhambisa, ukuwushintshanisa nesikhafula, noma ukuwenza ube ukhiye we-emoji. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, lo lera ugcina umugqa wawo ongezansi njengoba uwenze lapha, futhi lezo zilungiselelo azikuwushintshi. Uma uvula lokhu, noma uhambisa noma ushintsha ukhiye owashintshwa izilungiselelo, ilera igcina umugqa njengoba ikhibhodi iwuvezile, ngakho awukho ukhiye ohambayo. Cisha lokhu ukuze uvumele izilungiselelo ukuthi zishintshe umugqa futhi.
Ukuhambisa noma ukushintsha inkinobho eshintshwe yizilungiselelo kuvula lokhu
Izilungiselelo zokhiye bomugqa ongezansi azishintshi lo lera
Gcina lo mugqa ongezansi njengoba unjalo lapha
Shintsha ukuthi ikhibhodi ikwenzani emgqeni ophansi wayo yonke imidwebo
Isenzo senhloso esilalelwa wuhlelo lokusebenza lokuzenzakalela, isibonelo com.example.MACRO. Uma usishiya singagcwalisiwe, ukhiye ngeke wenze lutho.
Zengezwa ezakhiweni zakho. Isakhiwo osivele unaso sihlala sinjalo, kanti ikhophi ingena eceleni kwaso.
Yonke imisakazo evuliwe, kanye neyakho, efayelini elilodwa. Ngenisa isakhiwo ukuze usifunde futhi
Lungisa lezi zinkinga kumhleli wesakhiwo kuqala:
Yenza onkamisa baseKorea kusuka emivimbo ㅣ ㆍ ㅡ, bese uthinta isinkinobho sonkamisa futhi ukuze uthole incwadi yayo elandelayo
Cindezela ukhiye wokugcizelela, bese kuba incwadi, bese zombili zihlangana
I-Jamo ijoyina ibhulokhi yesilabhayi ngenkathi uthayipha
Umsindo kanye nophawu lomsindo kuhlangana kube yiqembu elilodwa

Izakhiwo eziningi kufanele zikushiye lokhu: ulimi olukhethile ngenhla seluvele luyazi indlela efanele. Kusetha lokhu uma lesi sakhiwo sithayipha ulimi olufanayo ngendlela ehlukile, njengegridi yefonetiki kanye negridi eqondile yombhalo owodwa.
I-Khipro, kodwa izinhlamvu zihlangana kuphela uma ucindezela / ngemva kwazo
Thayipha isi-Bangla ngezinhlamvu ezincane, nge-f kanye ne-/ njengezilungisi
IsiKorea, ngezinhlamvu ㅐ kanye ㅔ ezithayiphwe njengo-ㅏ noma ㅓ bese kuba ㅣ
Ukhiye uthayipha uhlamvu lwawo. Akukho okuhlanganayo
Thayipha umsindo ngezinhlamvu zesi-Roman, bese ukhetha uhlamvu
Indlela ukucindezela okhiye kuphenduka ngayo izinhlamvu
I-Pinyin ezikhiyeni eziyisishiyagalolunye, nezinhlamvu ezimbalwa kukhiye ngamunye
Thayipha aa ukuze uthole â, kanye ne-as ukuze uthole á
Thayipha izinhlamvu zesi-Roman bese ikhibhodi ibhala umbhalo
Thayipha u-a6 ukuze uthole u-â, no-a1 ukuze uthole u-á
Thayipha izimpawu ze-bopomofo, bese ukhetha uhlamvu

plurals.name: layout_editor_copy_keys_done
plurals.item: Kukopishwe ukhiye ongu-%d, kanye nokuflick kwawo, isithonjana, ukusikisela kwekhona nezinye izinketho. Khetha ukhiye kunoma yiluphi ungqimba noma isakhiwo bese ucindezela okuthi Namathisela ngemva kwalokho.

Kukopishwe okhiye abangu-%d, kanye nokuflick kwabo, izithonjana, izinkomba zamakhona nezinye izinketho. Khetha ukhiye kunoma yiluphi ungqimba noma isakhiwo bese ucindezela okuthi Namathisela ngemva kwalokho.

resources.string: Igridi %1$s isebhodini lokunamathisela. Yinamathisele kwesinye isendlalelo, kwesinye isakhiwo, noma emlayezweni ukuze wabelane ngayo.
Idivayisi yakho ayivumelanga uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthi lubhale kubhodi lokunamathisela.
Uhlelo lokusebenza luyasusa lesi sakhiwo. Uma isakhiwo sivuliwe ngaphansi kwezilimi, uhlelo lokusebenza luyasivala bese ikhibhodi ibuyela ku-QWERTY.
1 kuya ku-6: amachashazi 1-2-3 phansi kukholamu yesobunxele, 4-5-6 phansi kwesokudla
Cindezela ukhiye ukuze uwushintshe. Cindezela ubambe ukhiye, bese uhudula, ukuze uwuhambise kwenye indawo kugridi, kuhlanganise nokungena komunye umugqa.
Kopisha isakhiwo ngezansi ukuze uqale kugridi esebenza kakade
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazanga ukubhala lelo fayela.
Iyiphi ingxenye yephaneli leli selula eliyibonisayo
Umugqa wezinombolo usuvele ukhombisa amadijithi, ngakho ikhibhodi ikhombisa lo mugqa esikhundleni somugqa wokuqala wale ngqimba.
Ayikho i-flick ngale ndlela. Thepha ukuze ukhethe isenzo.
Kwiphedi ye-kana enokhiye abayi-12: ukuhwaya okufushane kwesobunxele, phezulu, kwesokudla noma phansi kubhala okunye
Ukuswayipha okufushane kusuka kukhiye kunoma yiziphi izinkomba eziyisishiyagalombili kwenza isenzo, njengokuhambisa isikhombisi
Ukushushuluza (flick) ohlangothini olulodwa kuthayipha lokho okubeke kulelo reyi. Ukuthepha (tap) kusathayipha okukhiphayiswayo. Shiya reyi lingenalutho uma ungakhethi kushushuluza kulolo hlangothi.
Thepha iseli le-pad ukuze ukhethe ukuthi ukuswayipha ngaleyo ndlela kwenzani. Ukuthepha okhiye kusenza lokho okwenziwa ukhiye.

Okhiye be-flick badweba izinhlamvu abazithayiphayo ohlangothini ngalunye ebusweni bokhiye. Cisha lokhu ku-pad lapho usuvele wazi khona ama-flick, futhi uwagcine kwelinye, njenge-pad yezinombolo. Ngenkathi ifana nesilungiselelo sekhibhodi yonke, le ngqimba ilandela leso silungiselelo.
Kule ngqimba kuphela, phezu kwesilungiselelo sekhibhodi yonke esithi Bonisa izingalo zokuflick okhiye
Okungenalutho: i-shift ibhala uhlamvu olukhulu lwe-flick
Ayikho incwadi ephakathi nendawo. Ukuthinta kule kinobho akuthayiphi lutho; ukuswayipha kwayo kuphela okwenzayo.

Ngengalo lapha, ukuswayipha kule khiyi yingalo, hhayi ukuhudula okubheka olunye ungqimba. Ukuyibamba imile, nge-chord noma iphedi yezinombolo, kusebenza ngezindlela zombili. Sula izingalo ukuze ubuye nokubheka.
Ngengalo lapha, ukuswayipha kule khiye kuyingalo, hhayi ukuhudula encwadini ukuze kuhlanganiswe. Sula izingalo ukuze ubuyise ukuhudula.
Lesi sakhiwo asikabi nengqimba ye-Fn. Engeza eyodwa, bese ubeka ukhiye we-Fn kwenye ingqimba ukuze ufinyelele kuyo.
Yenza wonke amalebula kulesi sakhiwo abe makhulu noma abe mancane kunosayizi osezilungiselelweni. Akushintshi usayizi kwezinye izakhiwo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo sekhibhodi ye-FUTO. Enye ikhibhodi idweba umugqa wezinombolo, izimpawu namakhasi ahlukile ngokwayo, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenzisa olwalo.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo se-FlorisBoard noma se-HeliBoard. Enye ikhibhodi idweba owayo umugqa ongezansi, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza okhiye bokususa, isikhala kanye nokufaka.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo se-Mac (.keylayout). Izinkinobho zezinhlamvu zigcina izindawo zazo. Izinhlamvu ezithayishwa yi-Option nezinkinobho ezifile zitholakala ngokucindezela nokubamba izinhlamvu, kanti izinkinobho zezimpawu zihlala njengoba unazo.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo sekhibhodi ye-Samsung esenziwe ku-Keys Cafe. Lonke uhlelo luza njengoba lwalubekwe, kufaka phakathi umugqa ongezansi. Umugqa walo wezinombolo uba umugqa wezinombolo walesi sakhiwo.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo se-Windows esenziwe ku-MSKLC. Izinkinobho zezinhlamvu zigcina izindawo zazo. Izinhlamvu ezithayishwa yi-AltGr nezinkinobho ezifile zikucindezela nokubamba izinhlamvu, futhi izinkinobho zezimpawu zihlala lezo onazo.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde lokhu njengesakhiwo sekhibhodi ye-Multiling O. Amakhasi ayo ezimpawu kanye nekhasi layo le-AltGr liza nayo, futhi ukhiye othayipha into eyodwa ngokuthepha nezinye ngokuswayipha ugcina ukuswayipha kwawo.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde le fayela njengesakhiwo sombhalo se-HeliBoard. Leyo fomethi iphethe izinhlamvu kuphela, ngakho uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza okhiye bokususa, isikhala kanye nokufaka.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde lokhu njengesakhiwo sekhibhodi esingalindelekile noma i-CleverKeys. Ukuswayipha emakhoneni okhiye ngamunye kuza njengokuswayipha, futhi ungaphinda ubambe ukhiye ukuze uwathole. Uhlelo lokusebenza lungeza umugqa walo ongezansi ngaphandle uma isakhiwo sinaso.

Uhlelo lokusebenza lufunde leli fayela njengesakhiwo se-Linux XKB. Izinkinobho zezinhlamvu zigcina izindawo zazo. Izinhlamvu ezithayishwa yi-AltGr nezinkinobho ezifile zitholakala ngokucindezela nokubamba izinhlamvu, kanti izinkinobho zezimpawu zihlala njengoba unazo.
Funda ifayela lesakhiwo kusuka ku-FlorisBoard noma i-HeliBoard
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufunda lelo fayela njengesakhiwo. Izakhiwo ze-FlorisBoard ne-HeliBoard amafayela we-.json noma .txt. Ukuze ungenise itimu ye-FlorisBoard (.flex), hamba ku-Themes.
Isakhiwo iyigridi yokhiye. Ithayipha ulimi lwesakhiwo esisekelwe kuso. Igridi yesi-Bengali oyihlelayo isasebenzisa uhlu lwamagama esi-Bengali.
Lo khiye uhlale udweba iseluleko sawo sekhona
Le sikhiye silandela ukushintsha okukodwa kuzilungiselelo

Ufinyelela lezo zimpawu ngoshift owodwa, futhi awushintsheli kusendlalelo sezimpawu. Kusendlalelo sesibili sezimpawu, umugqa wezinombolo usuvele ubonisa izimpawu eziningi zomcibisholo neziqhathaniso.
Cindezela ubambe u-shift ukuze ushintshe umugqa wezinombolo ube yizimpawu
Okhiye bakhombisa ama-glyph, kodwa bahlala bethayipha u-0-9

Ukhetha ama-glyph edijithi yolimi ngalunye ngaphansi kwezilimi → ulimi → Izinombolo. Lesi silungiselelo silawula lapho ikhibhodi ithayipha khona lawo ma-glyph. \"Izinkambu zombhalo\" yisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo. Ithayipha u-0-9 ezinkambini zezinombolo, zocingo, zedethi nesikhathi, okuzigcina zifundeka ngomshini. Kuzo zonke ezinye izinkambu ithayipha amadijithi omdabu. \"Yonke indawo\" ithayipha amadijithi omdabu kulezo zinkambu futhi. \"Bonisa kuphela\" kubonisa ama-glyph okhiye kodwa kuhlale kuthayipha u-0-9.
Lapho ikhibhodi ithayipha khona izinombolo zomdabu
Izinombolo, ifoni, usuku nezinkambu zesikhathi zigcina u-0-9, ukuze zihlale zifundeka ngomshini
Usetha amadijithi olimi ngalunye ngaphansi kwezilimi. Amadijithi angama-Latin 0-9, Arabic ٠-٩, Persian ۰-۹, Bengali ০-৯ kanye ne-Devanagari ०-९.
Ungasetha imodi yesandla esisodwa ekujwayeleni ngakunye. Ekhibhodi, umcibisholo osemzileni ushintsha uhlangothi futhi uwulondoloze lapha kulokho kujwayela.
Lokhu kushintsha ukuphakama kokhiye ngenkathi imodi yesandla esisodwa ivuliwe, futhi kwehlisa imigqa engaphezulu ukuze ifinyeleleke ngesithupha. Amaphesenti ayi-100 agcina ukuphakama okujwayelekile.
Yenza izikhiye zibe mfushane ukuze ufinyelele kalula

Imodi yesandla esisodwa iyisilungiselelo esisodwa sayo yomibili imikhombandlela, ngakho ikhibhodi eyenziwe yancane ukuze isetshenziswe ngomunwe owodwa ngendlela emile ihlala incane ngemva kokuphendula ifoni, lapho ungase ufune ikhibhodi ehlukanisiwe esikhundleni salokho. Vula lokhu ukuze ugcine imodi yesandla esisodwa ngendlela emile bese uyivala ngendlela evundlile. Phendula ifoni emuva futhi izobuya. Lolu hlelo luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Sebenzisa ububanzi obugcwele lapho ifoni iseceleni
Onqenqemeni lapho ikhibhodi imisa khona ku-%1$s
Yenza ikhibhodi ibe ncane ohlangothini olulodwa lwesikrini
Lena yingxenye yobubanzi besikrini ikhibhodi eyisebenzisayo ngenkathi imodi yesandla esisodwa ivuliwe. Ujantshi nesikhala esingenalutho kugcwalisa okunye, kueleke phakathi.

Osayizi abangenhla yibona osayizi besikrini esime mpo (esigoqiwe). Isikrini esivundlile noma esingagoqiwe singangena esikhundleni sanoma yisiphi sazo, noma sikale ikhibhodi yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa. Lokhu kusiza kudivayisi egoqekayo, lapho isikrini esikhulu sangaphakathi sivame ukudinga ikhibhodi encane kunesikrini esingaphandle. Inani ngalinye ongalishintshi lilandela isikrini esime mpo.

Ngemva kokuba ikhibhodi ivulekile, ihlala esikrinini lapho inkambu yombhalo ivaleka, nangaphezulu kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingenayo inkambu yombhalo. Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi uthumele okhiye nezinqamuleli zekhibhodi kuhlelo lokusebenza, isibonelo ukusetha ukhiye oshisayo kuhlelo lokusebenza lwamanothi. Ukuze uvale ikhibhodi, cindezela ukhiye wokufihla, swayiphela phansi kubha yamathuluzi, noma cindezela emuva. Ivuleka futhi ngokuzayo uma uthinta inkambu yombhalo. Ikhibhodi ayihlali esikrinini sokukhiya. Isebenza idokhiwe noma intanta.
Hlala uvulekile uma kungekho nsimu yombhalo egxilile

Ukuphakama kokhiye, ukuphakama komugqa wezinombolo, ukuphakama komugqa ongezansi, ukugcwalisa, ububanzi, indawo, isikhala kanye ne-radius yekona konke kubuyela kokuzenzakalelayo. Izilungiselelo zokuma kwesikrini azithinteki.
Buyisela zonke izilayidi kuleli qembu esimweni sazo esizenzakalelayo
Ivula ikhibhodi enezibambo emaphethelweni ayo: hudula ukuphakama, indawo kanye nemingcele eseceleni endaweni yayo

Uma lokhu kucishiwe, ukhiye we-🌐 awukho emgqeni ongezansi wanoma yiluphi uhlelo. Uma \"Inkinobho ye-Emoji esikhundleni se-🌐\" ivuliwe, inkinobho ye-emoji kuleso sikhundla nayo iyasuswa. Ibha yesikhala ithola isikhala. Usengashintsha ulimi kusuka kubha yesikhala. Setha ukuswayipha kokuthi \"Ulimi\" ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuthayipha → Izimpawu. Ukuswayipha okufushane kwenza lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ikhibhodi igcina leli nani lobubanzi besikrini lingenalutho ngakwesobunxele. Okhiye bathuthela phakathi ukuze bafinyeleleke ngesithupha, futhi ikhibhodi ayinamatheli ohlangothini olulodwa njengoba kwenza imodi yesandla esisodwa. Okuzenzakalelayo kungamaphesenti angu-0. Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza phezu kobubanzi bekhibhodi obungaphezulu.
Hambisa umphetho wesobunxele wekhibhodi ubheke phakathi

Ikhibhodi igcina lokhu okungakanani kobubanzi besikrini kucacile ngakwesokudla. Ikubeke enanini elifanayo ne-padding yesobunxele ukuze uthole umkhawulo olinganayo, noma kwelinye elihlukile ukuze ushukumisele izinkinobho ngesandla osithayipha ngaso. Okuzenzakalelayo kungamaphesenti angu-0.
Hambisa umphetho ongakwesokudla wekhibhodi ubheke phakathi
Ukuphakama, ububanzi, ukugcwalisa, kanye nokuma kwesikrini ngasinye
Leli yigebe eliphakathi nendawo, njengephesenti lobubanzi bekhibhodi. Igebe elikhulu lihambisa izingxenye ezimbili kancane emaphethelweni, kodwa ukhiye ngamunye uba mncane.

Ikhibhodi ihlukanisa umugqa ngamunye phakathi nendawo futhi ibeka igebe phakathi kwezingxenye, ukuze izithupha zakho zihambe kancane ezikrinini ezibanzi. Lokhu kusiza kakhulu kumathebulethi, amadivayisi asongekayo namafoni asesimweni se-landscape. Ikhibhodi ihlukanisa ibha yesikhala phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili.

Ukuhlukanisa kuyisilungiselelo esisodwa sawo wonke umumo wesikrini, ngakho-ke ukusivula kumodi ye-landscape kushiya ikhibhodi ihlukene ngemva kokuba ujikeleze emuva, lapho ukuhlelwa okuhlukanisiwe kunzima ukukusebenzisa. Vula lokhu ukuze uhlukanise kuphela kumodi ye-landscape noma esikrinini esivuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Hlala unjalo ocingweni olumi mpo, hlukanisa uma kunesikhala

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ibha yesikhala ihlukaniswe phakathi kwezigamu ezimbili njengalo lonke olunye ulayini, futhi maphakathi nomugqa ongezansi akunalo lutho. Uma lokhu kucishiwe, ibha yesikhala ihlala njengokhiye owodwa futhi igcwalise igebe, ukuze zombili izithupha zikwazi ukuyicindezela lapho zihlangana khona. Amamodeli angcono kakhulu asemaphethelweni, hhayi amancane. Imodeli esemaphethelweni ibhala kangcono, kodwa ukulanda kwayo kukhulu, impendulo ihamba kancane, futhi idinga inkumbulo eyengeziwe. Imodeli evaliwe idinga i-akhawunti ye-Hugging Face. Engeza ithokheni yakho ngenhla, bese wamukela ilayisensi ekhasini lemodeli kanye.

Inketho ye-GPU iyisilingo. Uhlelo lokusebenza lushintshela ku-CPU ngokuzenzakalelayo uma i-GPU ingaqali, noma uma imodeli imisa phakathi nempendulo. Inkumbulo ye-GPU incane kakhulu kunenkumbulo yesistimu, ngakho imodeli enkulu idinga i-CPU njalo. Khetha i-CPU lapha uma i-GPU iqhubeka nokwehluleka.

I-NPU isebenzisa imodeli kusithuthukisi se-AI sefoni yakho. Idinga uhlobo lwemodeli lwe-chip yefoni yakho, futhi amamodeli ambalwa kuphela anayo: %1$s. Uma i-Compute ingeye-NPU, i-Download ithola lolo hlobo. Amanye amamodeli, kanye nemodeli ehlulekayo ku-NPU, asebenza njengoba enza nge-GPU. Uhlobo lwe-NPU lusebenza kuphela ku-NPU.
Ayikho imodeli kudivayisi yakho okwamanje. Landa eyodwa ngezansi ukuze usebenzise i-AI ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

Amamodeli asebenzisa u-%1$s wesitoreji kudivayisi yakho. Uhlelo lokusebenza luwagcina kusitoreji sohlelo lokusebenza esiyimfihlo. Ukulanda kuyaqhubeka lapho kume khona uma ukukhansela noma ulahlekelwa uxhumano.
