%1$d amathuluzi avuliwe. Ikhibhodi ithumela incazelo yethuluzi ngalinye ngaso sonke isicelo, ngakho isicelo ngasinye siba side futhi sibize kakhulu. Setha amathuluzi ongawadingi ukuthi abe ku-Off.

resources.string: Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise igama lomphathi
ikheli layo aliqali nge-http noma i-https
iqala uhlelo kukhompyutha, okuyinto ifoni engakwazi ukuyisebenzisa
Ikheli lishintshile. Xhuma futhi ukuze uthole amathuluzi ekhelini elisha.
Vumela imodeli isebenzise amathuluzi avela kumaseva owengezayo

Run: ithuluzi liyasebenza futhi ikhibhodi ayikubuza. Ask: imodeli ilinda uze uvumele ukushaya ucingo. Off: imodeli ayiliboni ithuluzi. Ekuqaleni, ithuluzi iseva eliphawula njengelifundwayo kuphela liyasebenza, futhi wonke amanye amathuluzi ayabuza.
I-Auto isebenza cishe kuyo yonke iseva. Izama i-Streamable HTTP kuqala, bese kuba uhlobo lwe-SSE oludala. Khetha i-SSE kuseva endala uma i-Auto ingaxhumi. Ikheli layo livame ukuphela ngo-/sse.
Sebenzisa ikheli eliqala nge-https:// noma i-http://
I-http evamile ithumela ithokheni yakho kanye nokufakwayo kwemodeli ngaphandle kokubethela. Sebenzisa i-https kuseva engaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho.
Shintsha phakathi kwabahlinzeki obasethile namamodeli owalandayo, kukhibhodi
Amamodeli akudivayisi asebenza kudivayisi yakho. Umbhalo owenza isenzo kuwo uhlala kudivayisi yakho. Iwindi lomongo wemodeli linciphisa ubude bempendulo.

Ikhibhodi ithumela lezi zihloko ngaso sonke isicelo kulo mhlinzeki, ngemva kwayo, ngakho-ke isihloko lapha sithatha indawo yesinye esinegama elifanayo. Ezinye izinsizakalo ziyazidinga, isibonelo isihloko seseshini kanye ne-User-Agent. Thayipha {session} enanini ukuze uthumele i-id ehlala ifana esenzweni esisodwa noma engxoxweni eyodwa. Isipele esingenazo izimfihlo asifaki izihloko.

Izinsizakalo namamodeli amathuluzi e-AI, impendulo ye-AI, ingxoxo kanye nomsizi wezilungiselelo abangawasebenzisa. Engeza isevisi nekhi yayo, iseva oyisebenzisayo, noma imodeli kudivayisi yakho. Ungangeza isevisi efanayo ngaphezu kwesisodwa, ukuze uthole ikhi yesibili noma iseva yesibili. Eyodwa yazo iyaphendula ngesikhathi: yikhethe ngaphansi kokuthi Kusetshenziswa, noma ngesikhethi semodeli kuphaneli ye-AI.
I-Ask AI ivela kumenyu yezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zombhalo okhethiwe. Ukucisha ithuluzi le-AI kuyayisusa nayo.
Iphaneli ikhombisa umbhalo we-<think> wamamodeli okucabanga esikhundleni sebha yokuqhubeka

Leli yithuluzi elilodwa elizovula ikheli elitholwe embhalweni wakho, ngakho-ke licishiwe kuze kube yilapho ulicela. Ikhasi lifundwa njengombhalo ojwayelekile futhi linqunywe; azikho izikripthi ezisebenzayo, futhi akukho okuthunyelwa ekhasini.
Ivula ikheli elilodwa futhi ifunde umbhalo okulo. Ayidingi sevisi yokusesha.
Vumela imodeli ukuthi ifunde ikhasi lewebhu

Umzuliswano ngamunye uyisicelo esisha kwimodeli, uphatha konke okutholile kuze kube manje. Okuphezulu kungena ngokujulile embuzweni futhi kubiza kakhulu; okuphansi kugcina impendulo eyodwa ishibhile futhi ishesha.
Mangaki amathuba imodeli engabheka ngawo okuthile ngaphambi kokuba kumele iphendule
Setha isevisi yokusesha kuqala — imodeli ayinayo into yokusesha ngayo
Ibhala usesho lwayo futhi ifunde imiphumela. Usesho luya kunoma iyiphi isevisi esetshenziswa ithuluzi lokusesha, futhi lubalwa ngokumelene nesabelo saleyo sevisi.

Imodeli ingacela ikhibhodi ukuthi ibheke okuthile ngaphambi kokuthi iphendule. Ikhipha lokho kuphela uma kudingeka, futhi ubona isicelo ngasinye kulogi yomsebenzi wenethiwekhi ngaphansi kokusetshenziswa kwethuluzi le-AI.

Lo mhlinzeki akanakho ukusekelwa okwakhelwe ngaphakathi kwamathuluzi, ngakho ikhibhodi iwachazela imodeli ngamagama esikhundleni salokho. Kuyasebenza, kodwa imodeli encane ivame ukuwaziba noma ithole ifomethi ingalungile. Umhlinzeki onokusekelwa kwethuluzi langempela uthembeke kakhulu.

Imodeli ephendulayo iqamba ingxoxo ngayinye kusuka kumlayezo wakho wokuqala kanye nempendulo yawo, ngolimi lwakho, futhi ingayiqamba kabusha kamuva uma ucela futhi uvuma. Uma icishiwe, ingxoxo iqanjwa ngomugqa wokuqala womlayezo wakho wokuqala.
Engxoxweni ekhibhodi, ukhiye u-Enter uyathumela. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, u-Enter uqala umugqa omusha futhi inkinobho ethi Thumela iyathumela.
Impendulo yengxoxo evela kumodeli yefu noma yeseva iphela ngemibuzo emithathu ongase uyibuze ngokulandelayo, njengama-chip okuthepha kuwo ebhokisini lomlayezo. Amamodeli akudivayisi awabuzwa neze.

Izenzo eziqhubeka kulokho okubhalile zithumela umbhalo ngaphambi kwesikhombisi sakho. Izinhlamvu eziningi zinika imodeli okuningi kokubhala kwakho okufanele ikulandele, okusiza esiqeshini eside. Kubiza futhi amathokheni akho amaningi futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside njalo uma kusebenza. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela uma ungakakhethi lutho: ukukhetha kuthunyelwa njengoba kunjalo.
Izinhlamvu ngaphambi kwekhesa ezithunyelwe ngesenzo sokuqhubeka
Yonke ingxoxo elondoloziwe isuswa kule divayisi. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
Susa yonke ingxoxo elondoloziwe kule divayisi
Bonisa inkinobho evula ingxoxo ye-AI kuzo zonke izikrini zezilungiselelo, hhayi kulezi kuphela
Ukuvala kuyifihla ekusesheni nasezikrinini ze-AI, futhi ayithumeli lutho
Isikrini samathuluzi okubhala e-AI sibeka umhlinzeki, ikhi kanye nemodeli. Impendulo ye-AI, ingxoxo kanye nomsizi wezilungiselelo basebenzisa ezifanayo.

Ingxoxo iwukubuyisana, ngakho-ke iphethe okuningi kwalokho okubhalile kunesenzo esisodwa se-AI. Cisha lokhu futhi izingxoxo zakho zizohlala kuze kube yilapho uvala uhlelo lokusebenza, futhi lokho osekuvele kulondoloziwe kuyasuswa. Akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi ngendlela ongayithumelanga ngokuxoxa.
Gcina izingxoxo kule divayisi ukuze ukwazi ukubuyela kuzo

Uma icishiwe, igama eliyisihluthulelo lifana nendlela olithayipha ngayo, ngakho i-wiki, i-Wiki ne-WIKI konke kunikeza ithuluzi. Uma ivuliwe, kuphela isipelingi esingenhla esifanayo. Sebenzisa lokhu egameni elifushane eliphinde libe umbhalo ovamile, njenge-AI, ukuze i-chip ivelele izinhlamvu ezinkulu hhayi izinhlamvu ezingaphakathi komusho.
Igama kufanele lithayiphwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu ezifanayo
Leli thuluzi alinawo amagama okucushwa. Aliziphakamisi neze.
Thayipha elinye lala magama uwedwa. Umugqa wesiphakamiso bese unikeza ukuvula %1$s futhi ususe igama. Sebenzisa okukhomba ukuze uhlukanise igama elingaphezu kwelilodwa.
Amagama angukhiye wethuluzi avaliwe. Ukuze uwavule, hamba kokuthi Ukuthayipha, bese uthi Ama-Smart chips.
Valiwe, imodeli kuphela kule foni efunda noma elondoloza inkumbulo. Ivuliwe, amaqiniso akhethelwe isicelo ahamba nawo kusevisi oyisebenzisayo, futhi imigomo yobumfihlo yaleyo sevisi iyasebenza kuwo.
Thumela amaqiniso agciniwe nezicelo kusevisi ye-AI esetshenziswayo, futhi vumela izingxoxo zayo zigcine ezintsha
Susa yonke inkumbulo elondoloziwe? Lokhu ngeke kwenzeke ukubuyisela emuva.
Isusa wonke amaqiniso alondoloziwe kule foni
Akukho okugciniwe okwamanje. Tshela i-AI okuthile ngawe engxoxweni, noma wengeze iqiniso lapha.

I-AI ilondoloza iqiniso uma uyitshela okuthile okuzobe kusasebenza kamuva, noma uma uyicela ukuba ikhumbule okuthile. Ukulondoloza ngakunye kubonakala ngaphansi kwempendulo nge-Hlehlisa. Amaqiniso ahlala kule foni. Izinkambu ze-Incognito nezingxoxo eziyimfihlo azifundi noma zilondoloze inkumbulo, futhi amaqiniso abukeka njengamaphasiwedi, amakhodi, izinombolo zamakhadi noma okhiye ayenqatshwa. Ukucisha lokhu kumisa ukufunda nokulondoloza. Amaqiniso alondoloziwe ahlala uze uwasuse.
Izingxoxo zilondoloza amaqiniso amafushane ngawe, futhi izingxoxo ezilandelayo nezenzo ze-AI ziyawasebenzisa
Inkumbulo igcwele. Susa amaqiniso athile kuqala.
Lokhu kubukeka njengephasiwedi, ikhodi, inombolo yekhadi noma ukhiye. Inkumbulo ye-AI ayigcini lezo zinto.
Inkumbulo iyiqiniso elilodwa elifushane, okungenani izinhlamvu ezi-%1$d.
Imemori ayikwazi ukufundwa kuze kube yilapho ifoni ivuliwe.
Lokho i-AI ekukhumbulayo ngawe, kugcinwe kule foni
Okuthathiwe ngenkathi iphaneli ivuliwe, kanye nokusha kakhulu emizuzwini emibili edlule lapho ivuleka. Idinga imvume yokufunda izithombe zakho
Ukuthi izimpendulo ezibhalwe phansi zisebenzisa i-emoji yini
Valiwe: irekhodi lempendulo liphethe umlayezo womunye umuntu, hhayi okwakho ukubhala
Ithunyelwe ku-AI njengesithombe, noma ifundwe kule divayisi kuqala
Indlela obhala ngayo, indlela ozwakala ngayo, nanoma yini okufanele izimpendulo ziyazi
Izimpendulo zisebenzisa umhlinzeki, ukhiye nemodeli esethwe ngethuluzi le-AI
Susa imiyalezo ekopishiwe nezithombe-skrini uma impendulo isisetshenzisiwe. Ungakwazi ukuyicisha lokhu kwimpendulo eyodwa kupaneli
Amathoni kuphaneli yempendulo ye-AI. Hlela kabusha, uwacime, hlela elilodwa, noma uzibhalele elakho. Okwezifiso... kucela imiyalelo njalo.
Hlela, hlela kabusha noma cisha amathoni, noma uzibhalele awakho

Ukuthi umbiko wocwaningo olujulile ufinyelela kude kangakanani. Izinhlelo ezisheshayo zenza imibuzo emincane emi-3 futhi zifunda amakhasi ama-4; Izinhlelo ezijwayelekile zenza ezi-4, zibheke futhi kanye ukuthi yini engekho, futhi zifunda ezi-8; Izinhlelo ezijulile zenza ezi-6, zibheke futhi kabili, futhi zifunda ezi-14. Ukujula kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kuthumela umbhalo omningi kumodeli.
Ukucwaninga okujulile kubonisa imibuzo engaphansi kwaso bese kulinda \'Qala\' ngaphambi kokuba kuseshe noma yini. Uma icishiwe, uhlelo luboniswa njengoba lusebenza, kanti \'Misa\' kuyaluvala.
Bangaki abalingiswa ngaphambi kokuba isikhombisi ngasinye sithumele isicelo

Uhlelo lokusebenza alulokothi lubuze enkundleni yephasiwedi, enkundleni evala iziphakamiso, noma ku-incognito. Ikhefu ngalinye ngemva kwegama liyisicelo esisodwa, futhi ukucindezela ukhiye omusha kukukhansela. Thinta isiphakamiso ukuze usifake. Sibanze ukuze ufihle iziphakamiso ze-AI uze uye enkundleni ehlukile.

Iphakamisa indlela yokuqhubeka nombhalo wakho, eceleni kweziphakamiso zamagama. Uma ume ngemva kwegama, uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela izinhlamvu ezi-%1$s zokugcina ngaphambi kwekhesa kumhlinzeki okhethiwe.
Iphakamisa indlela yokuqhubeka nombhalo wakho, eceleni kweziphakamiso zamagama. Imodeli esedivayisini yenza isiphakamiso, ngakho umbhalo wakho uhlala kudivayisi yakho.
Isiphakamisa ukuthi uluqhubeke kanjani umbhalo wakho, eceleni kweziphakamiso zamagama. Uma ume ngemuva kwegama, uhlelo lokusebenza luthumela lelo gama kuphela kumhlinzeki okhethiwe.
Ithumela ingxenye encane yombhalo wakho. Iziphakamiso azinembile kangako.
Ikhibhodi ithola ulimi lomthombo. Ungakwazi futhi ukushintsha lokhu kuphaneli.
Qedela isicaphuna esisebenzisa zonke izinhlamvu zamagama
Azikho izinhlamvu ezingalungile, ezengeziwe noma eziphuthelwe ekusebenzeni okugcwele
Qedela ukugijima ngamagama ayi-100 ngomzuzu noma ngokushesha
Isusa wonke amaphuzu aphambili, umlando wokugijima kanye namabheji
Swayipha amagama phakathi novivinyo, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuthinta kwenza usheshe kangakanani

Ukuhlolwa kuqhutshwa kukhibhodi. Kukala isakhiwo, osayizi bezinkinobho kanye nokunyakaza okuthayiphayo. Umbhalo owuthayiphayo ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa awuyi enkundleni yombhalo. Izikolo zihlala kudivayisi yakho.

Ukuhlolwa kuqhutshwa nganoma yiluphi ulimi ikhibhodi ekulo. Shintsha izilimi kusuka kuphaneli noma kubha yesikhala. IsiNgisi nesiBangla zinohlu lwazo lwamagama; noma yiluphi olunye ulimi lusebenzisa isichazamazwi salo esilandiwe noma esingenisiwe.
Izinhlamvu ezinkulu, okomashumi, nezikhathi ezigcwele embhalweni wokuhlola
Izivivinyo zokucaphuna ziqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni kwesicaphuno.
Bonisa umugqa weziphakamiso phakathi novivinyo, emgqeni wawo ojwayelekile ongaphezu kwezinkinobho. Ukuthepha igama kuliphetha
Izinhlamvu zokuqala zosuku lweviki ezifakwa umbala kugridi yenyanga
Khetha ukuthi ikhibhodi idweba i-emoji ngasiphi isethi
Faka futhi ukhethe izithonjana okhiye namathuluzi
Ithuluzi lisebenzisa lesi sishintshi esifanayo. Ungasithola futhi ngaphansi kokuthi Ukuthayipha
Imisebenzi ye-Trigonometry isebenzisa amadigri. Okucishiwe kusebenzisa ama-radians
1 2 3 emugqeni ongaphezulu, njengedayala kanye nephedi yezinombolo. Okucishiwe kubeka u-7 8 9 phezulu, njengesibali-manani sedeski
Inani eliphezulu lezindawo zamadesimali. Isiguquli samayunithi sisisebenzisa naso
Vumela ukufinyelela kwekhalenda ukuze ukhethe elilodwa
Ikhalenda lapho umcimbi omusha uqala khona
Ukuthi umcimbi omusha uthatha isikhathi esingakanani

Cindezela usuku ukuze ubone imicimbi yalo ekhalendeni ledivayisi yakho. Ikhibhodi icela ukufinyelela ekhalendeni okokuqala ngqa lapho uvula ithuluzi. Ifunda imicimbi kuphela futhi ayikaze iyishintshe.
Inombolo yosuku lwayo ibuye ikhombise ngaphakathi kweseli losuku ngalunye

Ithuluzi lisebenzisa ikhalenda le-Hijri lezibalo (tabular). Izinyanga zamaSulumane zangempela ziqala ngokubonwa kwenyanga entsha. Lokho kungahluka kumathebula ngezinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu. Setha i-offset efana negunya lakho lendawo.
Hambisa idethi ye-Hijri ebaliwe ukuze ifane nokubonwa kwenyanga kwasendaweni

Khetha noma yimaphi amakhalenda amabili ozowabona eduze nekhalenda likaGregorian. Ikhibhodi ibala izinsuku zesiShayina kusuka ekufundweni kwezinkanyezi. Amakhalenda amaHebheru, amaPheresiya, amaHindu (Saka), amaBuddha kanye nawaseJapane ayizibalo eziqondile. I-Hijri ikhalenda lethebula, ngakho-ke inesinxephezelo sosuku ngenhla. Zonke ezintathu ziqala esifundeni sedivayisi yakho: ikhalenda lesiBengali e-Bangladesh, iminyaka yezinkathi e-Japan, impelasonto yangoLwesihlanu nangoMgqibelo ezingxenyeni eziningi zaseMpumalanga Ephakathi. Lokho kuwukuqagela nje kwalokho okufunayo. Ungashintsha konke lokho lapha.

Ekhibhodi ibhala umcimbi ngqo ekhalendeni lakho, futhi icela ukufinyelela ekhalendeni okokuqala. Kuhlelo lokusebenza lwekhalenda kuvula umhleli wohlelo lwakho lwekhalenda nomcimbi ugcwalisiwe, bese uwulondoloza lapho. Ukushintsha nokususa imicimbi kwenzeka njalo ekhibhodi.
Lapho i-Save ibeka khona umcimbi omusha
Ikhibhodi ikubonisa esihlokweni nangaphansi kosuku olukhethiwe
Vula ithuluzi kukhamera yangaphambili esikhundleni seyangemuva

Isibukeli sibanzi njengekhibhodi, ngakho phezulu nangaphansi kwesithombe kuphuma esikrinini. Ikhibhodi ivamise ukusika lezo zingxenye, futhi uthumela lokho okubonile. Vuliwe: uthumela isithombe esigcwele se-4:3, esibamba okungaphezu kwalokho okuboniswe isibukeli. Ukubuka kuqala akushintshi.
Gcina isithombe esigcwele se-4:3 esikhundleni sengxenye esesibukweni

Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba izithombe ozithatha lapha ngokuvamile zithunyelwa kanye kuphela hhayi izithombe okufanele zigcinwe. Vuliwe: ikhibhodi ikopisha zonke izithombe kugalari futhi iyazithumela.

Ikhibhodi inquma izithombe zibe yilokho okuboniswa isitholi-mibono, izigcine kusitoreji esiyimfihlo sohlelo lokusebenza bese izithumela engxoxweni. Akukho okungena kugalari yakho, futhi ikhamera isebenza kuphela ngenkathi ithuluzi livuliwe. Vula okuthi \"Thumela isithombe sonke\" uma ufuna isithombe esigcwele esingu-4:3 hhayi ingxenye esesitholi-mibono kuphela.

Izinzwa zekhamera zirekhoda ama-selfie ngaphandle kwesibuko. Umbhalo ube usufundeka kahle, kodwa isithombe sibukeka siphendukile eduze kokubuka kuqala. Kuvuliwe: isithombe esilondoloziwe sifana nalokho okubonile ngenkathi usilungisa. Kucishiwe: ikhibhodi igcina ukuma kwangempela kwenzwa.
Londoloza izithombe zekhamera yangaphambili ngendlela ezibukeka ngayo ekubukezweni

Izithombe ezinkulu zibamba imininingwane eminingi, okubalulekile esithombeni sedokhumenti okufanele umuntu ayifunde. Futhi zithatha isikhathi eside ukuthathwa nokuthunyelwa, futhi zisebenzisa idatha eningi. Ikhamera ikhetha usayizi oseduze kakhulu onikezwa inzwa yayo.
Ifayela elincane kakhulu, nelishesha kakhulu ukuthunyelwa
Engeza Sesha eduze kwe-Phinda uthathe kanye nethi Thumela
Ikhibhodi ithumela isithombe lapha njengedatha yefomu. Iseva iphendula ngokuqondisa kabusha emiphumeleni, noma ngekheli lemiphumela.

Ayikho kulezi zingosi enendlela yomphakathi yokuthumela izithombe. Ikhibhodi yenza lokho inkinobho yokulayisha yale ngosi ekwenzayo, ngakho-ke isiza ingayeka ukusebenza lapho ishintsha. Uma lokho kwenzeka, khetha enye isiza ehlukile. Inketho yangokwezifiso ithumela isithombe kuseva yakho.

Ukusesha kuthola amakhasi mayelana nokusekuthombeni: isitshalo, isinambuzane, uphawu, umkhiqizo. Ithuluzi lokusesha isithombe linenkinobho yekhamera enikeza i-Search njalo. Iswishi engezansi yengeza i-Search kuthuluzi lekhamera nayo.

I-Google Lens neshidi lokwabelana zinikeza isithombe kolunye uhlelo lokusebenza, futhi ikhibhodi ayithumeli lutho uqobo lwayo. I-Web ithumela isithombe kusayithi lokusesha olikhethayo futhi ivule imiphumela kusiphequluli sakho.
Ivula i-Lens kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Google. Uma uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Google lungafakiwe, kuvuleka ishidi lokwabelana.
Ikuvumela ukuthi ukhethe uhlelo lokusebenza olusesha ngesithombe, njalo.
Ithumela isithombe kusayithi lokusesha bese ivula imiphumela yalo esipheqululini sakho. Akudingeki ukuthi ube nohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Google.
Dlala umsindo wekhamera uma uthatha isithombe

Iphaneli yekhamera inenkinobho yesibali-sikhathi eshintsha phakathi kokuvala, imizuzwana emi-3 nemizuzwana eyi-10. Yilapho iqala khona njalo uma uvula iphaneli, ngakho uma njalo usebenzisa efanayo awudingi ukuyisetha futhi.

Engeza iseva ye-Rens lapha ukuze uthole inkinobho yokuhumusha ngemva kokuthatha isithombe. Isithombe sibuya nombhalo waso uhunyushwe ngolimi oluhunyushwa ithuluzi lokuhumusha. Ungakwazi ke ukusithumela, noma usithathe kabusha. Isithombe siya kuseva oyengezayo, bese sisuka lapho siya ku-Google Lens.
Nikeza impendulo yaleli thuluzi kumugqa wesiphakamiso. Setha ngaphansi kokuthayipha
Umlando, iphaneli, i-paste chip, kanye nokwenzeka kuphasiwedi ekopishiwe
Bonisa isiqondiso ngezinombolo ngaphansi kwewashi lekhampasi
Ayikho indawo elondoloziwe okwamanje. Setha eyodwa ngaphansi kwe-Amathuluzi → Isimo sezulu.

Ikhibhodi ibala ukuqondiswa kwe-qibla kusuka endaweni oyilondolozayo kuthuluzi lesimo sezulu. Lawa mathuluzi amabili abelana ngaleyo ndawo. Ikhibhodi ibala konke kudivayisi yakho, futhi ikhampasi ayilokothi isebenzise inethiwekhi.
Noma yimuphi umkhondo (ticker) umthombo wakho wemali owucaphunayo uyasebenza. Umkhondo umthombo ongawuthwali awuguquki neze.
%1$d ivuliwe. Khetha izinhlamvu zemali ikhibhodi ezifundayo futhi eziziphakamisayo
Okuzenzakalelayo kugcina izidijithi ezinhlanu ezinengqondo, ezilingana nohlamvu lwemali lonke kanye nengxenye yalo

\"1 btc\", \"0.5 ETH\", \"2 bitcoin\" kanye \"100000 sats\" zibeka inani emalini yakho kumugqa weziphakamiso. Ama-ticker angamagama ajwayelekile, njenge-DOT, LINK ne-NEAR, abalwa kuphela uma uwathayipha ngosonhlamvukazi. Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zitholakala kuphela uma uthayipha inani lemali noma ukhetha uhlamvu lwemali kuphaneli.
Funda izamba ezifana no-\"1 btc\" futhi ubonise izinhlamvu zemali kusiguquli

Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zivela ku-Coinbase, ne-jsDelivr currency-api njengendlela yokusekela; i-CoinGecko yinketho yesibili. Zontathu zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye we-API. Izintengo ziyinkomba futhi akusona iseluleko sokuthenga noma ukuthengisa noma yini.
Izintengo zezinhlamvu zemali zishintsha ngokushesha okukhulu kunezintengo zemali zansuku zonke
Vuselela amanani ezinhlamvu zemali njalo nge
Lapho amanani ezinhlamvu zemali ethathwa khona

Lesi silungiselelo silawula kuphela i-chip esesiphakamisweni. Iphaneli ilanda amanani uma uyivula, futhi amanani ikhibhodi esenawo aguquka ngaphandle kokulanda. Uhlelo lwe-F-Droid luqala ngalesi silungiselelo sivaliwe.
Cishiwe, ithokheni yemali ilinda ukuthepha kwakho ngaphambi kokuba iye ku-inthanethi
Ukuzungeza kwenani eliguquliwe. Izinhlamvu zemali zinezilungiselelo zazo

Amanani avela ku-open.er-api.com, enezimali ezingaba ngu-160 futhi abuyekezwa nsuku zonke. I-frankfurter.app (European Central Bank) iyindlela yokusekela. Zombili zimahhala futhi azidingi ukhiye we-API. Ikhibhodi ikhumbula ipheya esuka kuyo neya kuyo oyikhethayo kuphaneli.

Igama libhala \"96.04 Rupee\", Uphawu lubhala \"₹96.04\" kanti Ikhodi ibhala \"96.04 INR\". Imali engenalo uphawu lwayo ibuyela kukhodi yayo. Izinhlamvu zemali zigcina ithikha yazo, njenge-BTC, ngakho konke okukhethayo.
Indlela i-chip yemali ebizwa ngayo imali eguqulelwe kuyo
Amanani angaphezulu abuyekezwa cishe kanye ngosuku. Inani elingaphansi kwamahora angama-24 lishintsha kakhulu ukuthi ikhibhodi izama nini ukulanda okwehlulekile futhi.
Isikhathi esithathwa yizinga lokushintshanisa imali ukuze lihlale lisha
Lapho amanani okushintshanisa imali ethembekile ethathwa khona
Bamba ithuluzi ebhokisini lamathuluzi ukuze uvule leli khasi nganoma iyiphi indlela, bese ulihudula usuka kubha yamathuluzi ukuze ulihambise njengokujwayelekile.
Phumula phakathi kokunyakaza ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi. Inani eliphansi liyashesha. Kwabelwana ngalo nethuluzi lokuhlela umbhalo
Ukubamba leli thuluzi kubha yamathuluzi kuqhubeka nokuhambisa isikhombisi. Uma kucishiwe, ukulibamba kuvula leli khasi esikhundleni salokho

Ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi yindlela ovula ngayo ikhasi lethuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi, ngakho leli thuluzi liyayiyeka leyo misebenzi ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe. Ikhasi lalo lihlala ngaphansi kwamathuluzi. Kulivule kuphela ngenkathi wenza ukunyakaza okubambayo.
Yenza okufanayo kugridi yethuluzi. Leli thuluzi kuphela, futhi licishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo
Isakhiwo sesibili iyigridi yakho, njengekhasi lezimpawu noma iphedi ye-macro. Akulona ulimi. Igcina isichazamazwi sesakhiwo osibhala ngaso.
Ithuluzi libonisa lesi sakhiwo phezu kwezinhlamvu, futhi lisikhiphe futhi ekucindezeleni okulandelayo. Ukhiye kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo ungavula ezinye izakhiwo zesibili.
Indlela i-DeepL Write ebhala kabusha ngayo umbhalo wakho. Izilimi ezingenazo izitayela ziyayiziba.

I-DeepL Write ibhala kabusha umbhalo kuphaneli yohlelo lolimi nakubha yokukhetha. Isebenzisa ukhiye we-DeepL ohlwini lomhlinzeki olungenhla, ngakho-ke engeza i-DeepL lapho kuqala. I-Write idinga ukhiye we-API Pro.
I-DeepL Write ilungisa futhi ibhale kabusha umbhalo ngolimi olufanayo. Isebenza ngokhiye we-DeepL API Pro kuphela. Ukhiye wamahhala uzokhipha iphutha.
Yengeza inkinobho ye-DeepL Write kuphaneli yohlelo lolimi kanye nesenzo se-DeepL Write ezenzweni zokukhetha
Ithuluzi lisesha igama elikhethiwe noma igama lamanje uma livuleka
Ifayela le-zip lesichazamazwi se-Yomichan noma i-Yomitan. Elikhulu lithatha imizuzu embalwa.

Izichazamazwi ze-Yomichan ne-Yomitan, nganoma uluphi ulimi: IsiJapane esinokufundwa kanye ne-pitch accent (JMdict, Jitendex), isiShayina, isiKorea, kanye nezichazamazwi ze-Wiktionary zezinye izilimi eziningi. Ngenisa ifayela le-zip lesichazamazwi. Amagama esiJapane aguquliwe athola ifomu lawo lesichazamazwi. Uhlu lomthombo ngenhla luwabuza njengomthombo owodwa, Izichazamazwi ezingenisiwe; ngaphakathi kwalo aphendula ngale ndlela.
Izincazelo zivela ku-Free Dictionary API (dictionaryapi.dev). Ikhibhodi ithumela igama oliseshayo kuleyo nsizakalo, kuphela uma usebenzisa ithuluzi.
Iseva yenqabile ukulanda (HTTP %1$s). Zama futhi kamuva.
Ifayela elilandiwe akusilo leli sichazamazwi. Zama futhi kamuva.
Ifayela le-.wmdict.gz elitholwe kwenye idivayisi noma kusiphequluli

Izichazamazwi zesiNgisi eziphelele zigcinwe ocingweni, ukuze ithuluzi lesichazamazwi likwazi ukuchaza amagama ajwayelekile ngaphandle kokuxhumeka, nasekwakhiweni ngaphandle kokufinyelela ku-inthanethi. Amaphakethe esilulumagama azi amagama awo kuphela. Uma elilodwa selikhona, uhlu lomthombo olungenhla liyabuza noma ngabe ulibeka kuphi; ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kwemithombo ye-inthanethi, ngakho liyaphendula uma ingakwazi ukufinyelelwa. I-Wiktionary, engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi, ingamagama ajwayelekile e-Wiktionary anokuphimisela (CC BY-SA 4.0). I-Open English WordNet inalo lonke igama lesiNgisi ku-WordNet, nezincazelo ezimfushane (CC BY 4.0).
Amaphakethe afundwa umthombo wamaphakethe esilulumagama, ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi. Azi amagama kuphela ohlwini lwawo, ngakho amagama amaningi adinga umthombo oku-inthanethi

Ithuluzi libuza umthombo wokuqala ovuliwe. Uma lowo mthombo ungazi igama, noma ungakwazi ukufinyeleleka, ithuluzi libuza olandelayo. Hudula umthombo ukuze ushintshe ukulandelana, futhi ucime umthombo ukuze ungalokothi uwubuze. Imithombo eku-inthanethi ithola kuphela igama olibhekayo.
Ithuluzi libonisa izinguqulo i-Wiktionary enazo zalezi zilimi, ngalolu hlelo. Khetha okungekho ukuze ulandele izilimi zekhibhodi yakho.
Izilimi zekhibhodi yakho. Engeza ulimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi, noma khetha ezinye lapha

Izinguqulo zivela ku-Wiktionary. Lapho igama litholakala ku-Wiktionary, izinguqulo zalo ziza ekhasini elifanayo, ngakho akukho okunye okuthunyelwayo. Lapho omunye umthombo uthola igama, ithuluzi libuye licele izinguqulo ku-Wiktionary, kodwa kuphela uma i-Wiktionary ivuliwe emithonjeni yesichazamazwi.
Bonisa igama ngezilimi ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezincazelo zalo. Thepha ukuhumusha ukuze ukuthayiphe

Lokhu kuvula isithwebuli semibhalo sekhibhodi uqobo. Sithola ikhasi esithombeni sekhamera noma isithombe, sikuvumela ukuba uhambise amakhona aso, usicaba, futhi ungakwazi ukusihlanza sibe yiphepha elimhlophe ngombala, grey noma okumnyama nokumhlophe. Amakhasi asethwebuliwe abuya njengezithombe. Ikhibhodi iwafaka engxoxweni njengesithombe sekhamera uma ivuleka futhi. Konke kusebenza kudivayisi yakho, ngaphandle kwezinsizakalo ze-Google Play.
Skena usebenzisa iskena sekhibhodi esikhundleni se-Google
Futhi gcina amakhasi askeniwe ku-Pictures/WM Keyboard

Lokhu kuvula isithwebuli sedokhumenti se-Google, esiyingxenye yezinsizakalo ze-Google Play, ngokutholwa kwemiphetho, ukunqampuna nokuhlanza izithunzi. Amakhasi askeniwe abuya njengezithombe. Isithwebuli esakhelwe ngaphakathi yingxenye eyengeziwe yekhibhodi, cishe engu-2.5 MB. Ilanda okokuqala uma uskena, noma manje.
Iziphakamiso, ithebhu yomlando, umugqa we-emoji, amathoni esikhumba nezintandokazi
Idinga isikhungo se-SearXNG. Engeza ikheli layo ngaphansi kwezilungiselelo zokusesha.

Ukuthayipha ngezwi kuvaliwe. Kuvule ngaphansi kwazo zonke izilungiselelo zokuthayipha ngezwi ngezansi.

Umbhalo omuhle uvame ukuba yigama elilodwa noma umyalezo owodwa. Lesi silungiselelo sibuyisela ikhibhodi olimini obukulo ngokushesha nje lapho ushiya inkambu. Sisebenza kuphela uma ithuluzi livule umbhalo omuhle.
Ngesikhathi esilandelayo uma uthayipha, ikhibhodi ibuyela olimini lwakho

Ithuluzi lithayipha ngezinhlamvu ze-Unicode, hhayi ngefonti. Izinhlamvu zihlala zinhle kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza, kodwa isifundi sesikrini asikwazi ukuzifunda futhi ukusesha akukwazi ukuzithola.
Ithuluzi lengeza umbhalo omuhle ezilimini zakho uma uliqalisa. Ngalolu hlelo luvaliwe, ithuluzi liyawususa futhi uma uli-vala, ukuze ukhiye we-🌐 ujikelezise kuphela izilimi ozifundayo.
Umbhalo omuhle uhlala kumjikelezo wolimi wokhiye we-🌐
Khetha isitayela futhi ithuluzi lihlala liqala lapho. Umugqa ongaphezu kokhiye ushintsha isitayela kuso sonke isikhathi seseshini, futhi ukukhetha kwakho lapha kuhlala kunjalo.
Isitayela ithuluzi elivula ngaso. Umugqa ongaphezu kokhiye usayishintsha
Nikeza usesho lwakho oluyishumi lokugcina lapho inkambu ethi Thola ingenalutho. Ayigcinwa neze ku-incognito noma enkambini yephasiwedi

Vuliwe: isibani siyacima uma ikhibhodi ivaleka noma uma ushintsha izinhlelo zokusebenza, ngakho asisoze sashiywa sivuliwe ephaketheni lakho. Cishiwe: isibani sihlala sivuliwe uze usicime futhi, kusuka kuthuluzi noma kusuka kuthayela lezilungiselelo ezisheshayo zesistimu.
Cindezela isikhathi eside i-GIF bese ukhetha Engeza kokuthandwayo. I-chip yezintandokazi bese iholela ama-chip esigaba. Cindezela isikhathi eside futhi ukuze uyisuse.
Amakhophi ayalanda uma wengeza okuthandayo noma uvula Okuthandayo, futhi kuphela ekuxhumekeni okuvumela ukulondoloza idatha. Vala lokhu ukuze ususe amakhophi. Okuthandayo kuzohlala.
Gcina ikhophi yento ngayinye oyithandayo, ukuze ibonakale futhi ithunyelwe ngaphandle kokuxhumeka
Uhlu lugcina ama-GIF angama-48 okugcina futhi luhlala ocingweni. I-Incognito ayengezi kulolu hlu. Valela lokhu ukuze ususe uhlu.

Bonisa noma fihla lolu hlobo lwenkinga kuphaneli yohlelo lolimi
Ukubhala okulungile kodwa okunzima ukufundeka kunalokho okudingekayo: imisho emide, igama eliphindwayo, umusho osho into efanayo kabili.

Amaphutha alula: ukubhala kabi, isenzo esingahambisani nento esenziwayo, ukukhohlwa kukakoma, igama elishintshwe nelinye elizwakala lifana nalo. Shiya lokhu kuvuliwe ngaphandle uma kukhona okukuhluphayo endleleni obhala ngayo.
Misa kancane ngemva kokuyeka ukuthayipha ngaphambi kokuba izinkinga zivuseleleke. Inani eliphansi lizwakala lishesha, inani eliphezulu lenza umsebenzi omncane
Indlela ukubhala okufundeka ngayo kubalaleli bayo: ukuhlukanisa nokufometha, ifomu elijwayelekile esifundeni esisodwa kodwa hhayi kwesinye, indlela engakahleleki yokukhuluma.

I-ML Kit ifunda umbhalo wombhalo wesi-Latin kuphela, isibonelo isiNgisi noma isiFulentshi. I-Tesseract ifunda izilimi ezingaphezu kwe-100 ezimibhalweni eminingi, isibonelo isiBengali, isi-Arabhu, isiRashiya nesiShayina, kodwa ulimi ngalunye ludinga ukulandwa kanye. I-Automatic ifunda umbhalo wesi-Latin nge-ML Kit futhi zonke ezinye izimbalo nge-Tesseract.

Ukubona kwenzeka kudivayisi yakho nge-ML Kit. Ayikho isithombe noma umbhalo oshiya idivayisi yakho, futhi kusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Kufunda umbhalo wombhalo wesiLatini, isibonelo isiNgisi. Isibonisi sombhalo se-ML Kit asikayisekeli isiBengali. Ngemuva kokuthwebula, cindezela amagama ukuze ukhethe ngqo lokho ikhibhodi ekuthayiphayo noma ekukopishayo.

Isithombe siya kumodeli engakwazi ukufunda izithombe, ekhelini olikhethayo, futhi imodeli ibhala umbhalo ewubonayo. Ifunda noma yimuphi umbhalo futhi ayidingi idatha yolimi. Noma iyiphi isevisi ene-API ehambisana ne-OpenAI iyasebenza: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, Mistral, noma imodeli kukhompyutha yakho nge-Ollama noma i-LM Studio. Ukuskena ngakunye kuthumela isithombe kuleyo sevisi, futhi isevisi ingase ikukhokhise ngakho.

I-Tesseract ifunda ulimi kuphela emva kokuba idatha yalolo limi ikudivayisi yakho. Kunokulandwayo okukodwa kwalo lonke ulimi olubhala ngalo, kusukela ku-0.4 MB kuya ku-12 MB. Idatha ivela kusethi ye-tessdata_fast yephrojekthi ye-Tesseract ku-GitHub. Ungakwazi futhi ukulanda ulimi kusukela kushesheni ngokwalo.
Azikho izilimi ovule ukuvuma ukuthola idatha ye-Tesseract. Faka ulimi esikrinini sezilimi. Idatha yalo izovele ibonakale lapha.
Susa ukukhetha amagama ukuze unciphise ukuthwebula. Okucishiwe kuqala kungenalutho, futhi ukhetha amagama ngalinye ngalinye

Uhlu luvela kusibonelo sakho, ngakho-ke lubonisa kuphela izigaba isibonelo esinazo. Izithombe zihlala ziyithebhu yazo. Ama-chips abonakala kuphela ngenkathi isibonelo se-SearXNG senza usesho.
Bonisa lezi eceleni kwe-Konke nezithombe kuphaneli yokusesha

Lokhu kusebenzisa ukucindezela nokubamba kubha yamathuluzi, ngakho leli khasi yilapho ushintsha khona ithuluzi, noma ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi, licindezele ubambe bese ulihudula, njengakuqala.
Imodi yokukhetha ihlala ivuliwe ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi. Iyama uma udedela, futhi umbhalo okhethiwe uhlala ukhethiwe

Ngenkathi imodi yokukhetha ivuliwe, konke ukunyakaza kwekhesari kukhetha umbhalo: amathuluzi ekhesari, iphaneli yokuhlela umbhalo, ukuswayipha kwekhesari ngebha yesikhala kanye nezinkinobho zevolumu. Kuyicime ukuze ugcine lokho okukhethile futhi uyeke ukukhetha okwengeziwe.

Ukucindezela kokuqala kwababili kusavula noma kuvala imodi yokukhetha, ngendlela efanayo ukhiye wokushintsha ukunika ukukhiya okukhulu. Vala lokhu uma ucindezela ithuluzi kabili ngokulandelana okusheshayo futhi ungafuni ukuthi elinye igama likhethwe.
Ukucindezela okusheshayo okubili kukhetha igama elisesikhombisini. Okuthathu kukhetha umugqa wonke
Lapho ibha ivela khona, iziphi izenzo ezinikezayo, nokuhleleka kwazo
Ithuluzi lisebenzisa le switch efanayo. Ungayithola futhi ngaphansi kwe-Advanced
Uma icishiwe, ayiveli ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Isasebenza kusukela kubha yamathuluzi, ngokuthayipha igama layo nangokukhetha izenzo.
Iziqeshana zakho, iziqalisi, amaphethini kanye neziguquguquki zethemplethi
Isithombe esithunyelwa njengomphumela. Izinketho ezifanayo zikupaneli njengama-chips, futhi noma iyiphi indawo ishintsha zombili.
Izicelo ezindizayo ndawonye. Ukuxhumana okukodwa akuvamile ukugcwalisa umugqa osheshayo; ezine yizo ezisetshenziswa izivivinyo zesiphequluli.
Ukuthi ukulanda nokulayisha kusebenza isikhathi esingakanani. Isikhathi eside sishesha kakhulu futhi sidla idatha eningi.
Amaseva amavolontiya acishe abe yikhulu, afakwe ohlwini ku-librespeed.org. Ukukhetha elilodwa kugcwalisa ikheli lalo mugqa.
Iseva eseduze nawe ikunikeza izinombolo eziyiqiniso kakhulu. Uhlu luthathwa ku-librespeed.org uma lokhu kuvuleka.
Uhlu alukwazanga ukutholakala. Thayipha ikheli leseva ngaphansi kokuthi Setha esikhundleni salokho.

Ukusebenza kuthumela isignali kuseva izikhathi eziyishumi, bese kulanda ngesikhathi esibekwe lapha, bese kulayisha ngesikhathi esifanayo. Izinombolo ezisemqoka azifaki ingxenye yesihlanu yokuqala yokudluliswa ngakunye, lapho ukuxhumana kusavuleka khona.
Ikhophi yawo wonke amakhadi owathumelayo iya ku-Pictures/WM Keyboard. Inkinobho yokulondoloza yephaneli ilondoloza eyodwa kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lokhu kuvuliwe noma cha.
Usayizi wesitikha kuphela ongahamba njengesitikha, futhi kuphela ezinhlelweni zokusebenza ezithatha esisodwa. Obunye ubukhulu buhlale buyizithombe.

Ukugijima kuya kuseva ekhethwe kuphaneli. I-Cloudflare ayidingi lutho olusethwayo. Iseva ye-LibreSpeed yileyo oyisebenzisayo wena, noma ekhethwe ohlwini lomphakathi lwamaseva amavolontiya emgqeni wayo.
Faka ikheli lomphakathi lokuxhumana ezansi kwekhadi. Uma kucishiwe, ikhadi libala kuphela inethiwekhi neseva.
Valiwe, ukugijima kungama-pings nokulanda kuphela, futhi kuthatha ingxenye yesikhathi nedatha.
Dala, hlela, ngenisa futhi uthumele amaphakethe akho

Izitikha zakho kuphela, ezivela kumaphakethe akho ezitikha. Isitikha sikhombisa lapho umbhalo ngaphambi kwekhesari uphela ngesihloko saso esigcwele, ngelinye lamagama asemqoka, noma ngelinye le-emoji yaso. Setha isihloko namagama asemqoka uma uhlela isitikha ephaketheni laso. Ikhibhodi yenza lokhu kuphela kumasimu angamukela izithombe, ngakho ayisoze yanikeza isitikha uhlelo lokusebenza olungakwazi ukusithatha. Iphinde isebenze kuphaneli ye-emoji: khetha i-emoji esinayo esinye sezitika zakho bese isitikha sivela ngaphezulu kwephaneli. Akukho okuphuma ocingweni ukuze uzithole.
Bamba isitikha kuthreyi ukuze usibone sikhulu, bese uslayida ukuze ubone ezinye
I-chip encane emgqeni esho ukuthi mangaki izitika ezikhona. Thepha kuyo ukuze uzibone
Izitikha ezintathu ezincane ebhanini lesiphakamiso, eduze namagama. Inkinobho ikhombisa okusele
Umgqa wezitika ezinkulu phezulu kwekhibhodi. Iziphakamiso zamagama zihlala lapho zikhona. Hambisa umugqa ku-Rows and bars
Engxoxweni, thayipha isihloko sesitika, elinye lamagama ayisihluthulelo alo noma elinye lama-emoji alo ukuze ulibone
Isitika sithatha indawo yesihloko, igama elibalulekile noma i-emoji oyithayiphile
Isitika sithunyelwa futhi umbhalo wakho uhlala enkundleni
Amaqhezu, izimpawu zezibalo, izinhlamvu zesiGreki, imicibisholo, izimpawu zemali, ama-superscript, ama-subscript nezimpawu zokubhala. Konke kuthayipha kudivayisi yakho, njengenkinobho evamile.

I-Tavily inokujula kokusesha okubili. Okuyisisekelo kuyinto ezenzakalelayo futhi kubiza ikhredithi engu-1. Okuthuthukile kubheka ngokujulile ekhasini ngalinye izingxenye ezihambisana nombuzo wakho, futhi kubiza amakhredithi angu-2. Uhlelo lwamahhala lunikeza amakhredithi angu-1,000 njalo ngenyanga.
Imiphumela engcono, ngamakhredithi ama-2 osesho ngalunye esikhundleni se-1
Imiphumela ehamba phambili, enensa kancane. Amakhredithi ama-2.
Ibhalansi phakathi kwesivinini nemiphumela emihle. Ikhredithi engu-1.
Ishesha kune-Basic, ngemiphumela emihle cishe ngokufanayo. I-1 credit. Ayikho i-SafeSearch.
Impendulo esheshayo, nesifinyezo esifushane salelileli khasi. Ikhredithi eli-1. Ayikho i-SafeSearch.

Enye isevisi yokusesha, eyenzelwe amathuluzi e-AI. Uhlelo lwamahhala lunikeza amakhredithi ayi-1,000 ngenyanga, futhi usesho ngalunye lusebenzisa elilodwa. Ngokhiye lapha, ukusesha kuwebhu nokusesha izithombe kusebenzisa i-Tavily esikhundleni se-Brave. Ukusesha izithombe kubonisa izithombe i-Tavily eziyitholile emakhasini emiphumela yayo, ngakho ithola izithombe ezimbalwa kune-Brave.
Phumula phakathi kokuphindaphinda ngenkathi ubambe umcibisholo noma isikhala sokususa. Inani eliphansi liyashesha
Dala, hlela, ngenisa futhi uthumele izingqikithi zekhibhodi
Susa yonke imisebenzi? Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa. Isipele esiphethe isigaba sohlu lwezinto okufanele zenziwe singazibuyisa.
Yonke imisebenzi nezinyathelo kule foni. Ngokuvumelanisa kuvuliwe, uhlelo lokusebenza lomsebenzi lugcina imisebenzi yalo, futhi ukuvumelanisa okulandelayo kubabuyisela.
Uhlu lwekhibhodi luvuleka nemisebenzi ehloliwe eshiyiwe. I-chip yayo ethi Fihla okwenziwe iyibonisa futhi kulokho kuvakasha.
Kopisha imisebenzi ye-plugin, amamaki nezinsuku ezimisiwe kulolu hlu. I-plugin igcina ikhophi yayo nezikhumbuzo zayo.
Ngenisa kusuka ku-plugin yohlu lwezinto okufanele zenziwe
Lolu hlelo lokusebenza alukabi nazo izinhlu zemisebenzi. Engeza i-akhawunti ye-CalDAV ku-DAVx5 bese umaka izinhlu zayo zemisebenzi.
Imvume yohlelo lokusebenza lwemisebenzi ivaliwe. Khetha uhlu futhi ukuze ulunike imvume.
Faka i-OpenTasks noma i-Tasks.org, bese wengeza i-akhawunti yakho ye-CalDAV ku-DAVx5, ukuze uvumelanise. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi uhlu luhlala kule foni.
Gcina uhlu lufana nohlu lwemisebenzi ku-OpenTasks noma ku-Tasks.org. I-DAVx5 ivumelanisa lolo hlu neseva yakho ye-CalDAV.
Ukumaka okufushane kulo lonke uhlamvu noma umugqa isikhombisi esihamba kuwo

Lokhu kusebenzisa ukucindezela nokubamba kubha yamathuluzi, ngakho leli khasi yilapho ushintsha khona ithuluzi, noma ukubamba ebhokisini lamathuluzi. Ukuze uhambise ithuluzi, licindezele ulibambe bese ulihudula, njengakuqala.
I-trackpad ihlala ivulekile ngenkathi ubambe ithuluzi futhi ivaleka uma ulikhulula. Ukuthepha kuyivula kuze kube sekuthepheni okulandelayo
Umunwe owodwa uhambisa isikhombisi. Bamba, bese uhudula ukuze ukhethe. Imunwe emibili ihambisa igama elilodwa ngesikhathi, futhi ukuthepha ngeminwe emibili kuthayipha isikhala.

Ingilazi yokukhulisa ibonisa umugqa wombhalo ozungeze ikhesa. Iya ngaphezu kwekhesa lapho uhlelo lokusebenza lutshela ikhibhodi lapho ikhesa likhona. Uma uhlelo lokusebenza lungenzi njalo, luya ngaphezu kwekhibhodi.
Bonisa umbhalo okwisikhombi, ube mkhulu, ngaphezu kwesikhombi ngenkathi uhudula
Ukuthi umunwe wakho uhamba ibanga elingakanani kuhlamvu ngalunye. Inani eliphansi lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha
Ukuthi umunwe wakho uhamba ibanga elingakanani kulayini ngamunye. Inani eliphansi lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha
Ukuthepha okubili okusheshayo kutrackpad kukhetha igama elikusalisi. Okuthathu kukhetha umugqa ogcwele
Dweba indlela yomunwe wakho kanye nesiphambano ku-trackpad ngenkathi uhudula

Amamodeli e-Mozilla enjini ye-Bergamot, afanayo nalawa i-Firefox ehumusha ngawo. Isiqondiso ngasinye singukulanda kwaso: isiFulentshi → isiNgisi sifunda isiFulentshi, isiNgisi → isiFulentshi siyibhala. Ukuhumusha phakathi kwezilimi ezimbili ezingesizo isiNgisi kudlula ngesiNgisi futhi kudinga iziqondiso zombili. Injini ngokwayo iwukulanda okuhlukile kwama-megabyte ambalwa ekwakhiweni okungayiphathi. Idinga ifoni engu-64-bit ene-Android 9 noma kamuva.
Izinhlu zolimi ezikwiphaneli ziqala ngezilimi ezisethivayisini. Nge-On device kanye ne-Automatic.

Okuxhumeke kwi-inthanethi kuthumela umbhalo kusevisi yokuhumusha futhi kwazi izilimi eziningi. Okwedivayisi kusebenzisa amamodeli we-Google ML Kit owalandayo, acishe abe ngu-30 MB ulimi ngalunye: umbhalo uhlala ocingweni futhi usebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka. Okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa idivayisi uma izilimi zilandiwe kanye nesevisi ekuxhumekeni kwi-inthanethi kukho konke okunye. Ukuhumusha okudivayisini kuhle emilayezweni nasembhalweni omfushane, futhi kunembayo kancane kunesevisi ekuxhumekeni kwi-inthanethi embhalweni omude noma wobuchwepheshe.
Lapho ukuhumusha kuvela khona. Ungakwazi futhi ukushintsha lokhu kudeshibhodi.
Imodeli yokuhumusha engu-%1$s icishe ibe ngu-%2$s.

Ulimi ngalunye lulanda kanye. Ukuhumusha kudinga amamodeli ezilimi ezimbili, futhi kudlula ngesiNgisi uma kungekho noyedwa wabo ongesiNgisi. Uhlu luqala ngolimi ohumusha ngalo nezilimi othayipha ngazo.
I-Google Play ayizange ilethe ukulanda. Hlola uxhumano nokuthi i-Play Store iyasebenza yini, bese uzama futhi.
I-Google Play ilanda ingxenye yokuhumusha esocingweni…
I-Google Play ilanda ingxenye yokuhumusha esedivayisini: %1$s kwangu-%2$s
Ingxenye yokuhumusha esecingweni ivela ku-Google Play.
Ukuhumusha okusekudivayisi kuyingxenye eyengeziwe yekhibhodi evela ku-Google Play. Yilande, bese ukhetha izilimi.

I-NLLB-200 yakwa-Meta, imodeli eyodwa yezilimi ezingama-200 ehumusha phakathi kwanoma yiziphi ezimbili zazo. Yinjini esesidivayisini yamapheya i-Firefox Translations ne-ML Kit engenayo imodeli. Ukulanda okukodwa okungu-630 MB, kanye nenjini yayo ye-CTranslate2 yamamegabhayithi ambalwa ekwakhiweni okungayiphathi. Ngenkathi i-Translate ivuliwe idla cishe i-1 GB yememori, futhi umusho uthatha imizuzwana embalwa. Idinga ifoni engu-64-bit enememori engu-6 GB noma ngaphezulu.

Imodeli ye-NLLB-200 (%1$s) ilanda kusuka ku-Hugging Face ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-Meta yayo, i-Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0. Ungayisebenzisela izinjongo ezingezona ezohwebo kuphela, futhi izinguqulo zayo azinasiqinisekiso. Yamukela ukuyilanda.
Nge-On device, izinhlu zezilimi ezikupaneli zibonisa izilimi ezilandiwe, izilimi ozithayiphayo kanye nokukhethiwe okwamanje. Zonke izilimi, ekugcineni kohlu, zibonisa okusele.

Izinsiza ezihumushelayo, ngokulandelana. Eyokuqala ephendulayo iyona esetshenziswayo, kanti uma yehluleka, kuyabuzwa okulandelayo. Umhlinzeki ocishiwe akusoze abuzwa, ngakho umbhalo wakho uya kuphela kulabo abavuliwe. Injini engenhla inquma ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye yohlu esetshenziswayo: Idivayisi ibuza ifoni kuphela, I-inthanethi isebenzisa izinsiza kuphela, Okuzenzakalelayo kusetshenzisa lonke uhlu.
Iziphakamiso, ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, izinhlamvu ezinkulu nokunye

Imitha elingu-1 lifundeka njengo-\"3 ft 3.37 in\" esikhundleni sika-\"3.2808399 ft\". I-chip ibhala amayunithi ngendlela owenze ngayo: \"1m\" iphendula ngo-\"3 ft 3.37 in\" kanti \"1 meter\" iphendula ngo-\"3 feet 3.37 inches\". Lapho kungekho sikhala sanoma yikuphi, ibuyela ku-\"3\'3\"\". Vala lokhu ukuze uthole idesimali elula.
Bonisa ubude ngezinyawo njengezinyawo namayintshi, hhayi njengedesimali

Kunezigaba eziyi-14: ubude, isisindo, izinga lokushisa, indawo, ivolumu, isivinini, isikhathi, idatha, amandla, amandla kagesi, ingcindezi, i-angle, imvamisa kanye nokonga uphethiloli. Konke ukuguqulwa kusebenza kudivayisi yakho. Ukunemba komphumela kulandela ukulungiselelwa kwesibali. Iphaneli ivuleka futhi esigabeni nasemayunithi owasebenzise okokugcina.
Okuqoshiwe kwe-Wiktionary kulandwa ngenethiwekhi; kudatha yeselula kulandela ukulondoloza idatha. Ukuhlanganiswa kwenkulumo kusebenza ungaxhumekile ku-inthanethi futhi kuyindlela yokusekela.
Lapho ingxenye ngayinye yekhadi lamagama iboniswa khona: kuphaneli yekhibhodi nakuhlelo lokusebenza, kuhlelo lokusebenza kuphela, noma ndawo.
Buyekeza kuphaneli yekhibhodi noma esikrinini sokubuyekeza. Zombili zisebenzisa uhlelo olufanayo.
Kungezwe eseshini yokubuyekeza ngaphezu kwalokho okufanele
Ukuthi igama elithayiphwe kufanele libe lula kangakanani
Ukuthayipha igama lephakethe kunikeza ikhadi lalo
Uma uthayipha igama elijwayelekile elinokunye okungcono ephaketheni, ithiphu emugqeni weziphakamiso iyalinikeza: “hate → abhor”. Ithinte ukuze ubone ikhadi legama, uyibambe ukuze ushintshe igama.
I-chip lapho igama elilula lingaba elivela emaphaketheni akho

Uma ungeza igama elingaziwa yiphakethe lesilulumagama, ithuluzi liyabheka ku-inthanethi ukuze ligcwalise incazelo, izibonelo kanye nendlela yokubiza amagama. Libuza lezi zinsizakalo ngokulandelana, futhi elilandelayo kuphela uma elokuqala lingenalutho.
Amakhadi okufunda alokho okufanele kwenziwe namuhla
Amabhokisi amahlanu anezikhala zezinsuku ezi-1, 3, 7, 14 kanye nezingama-30. Impendulo efanele ihambisa ikhadi ebhokisini elilandelayo, kanti engalungile ilibuyisela kwelokuqala.
Umthetho we-SuperMemo owusetshenziswa yi-Anki: ikhadi ngalinye linokulula okukhuliswa yizimpendulo ezinhle, kanye nezikhala ezikhula nakho.
Izinguqulo zivela ku-Wiktionary futhi zilandwa ngephakethe nangolimi esikrinini samaphakethe.
Igama elilodwa ngosuku, elithathwe emaphaketheni akho
Kanye ngosuku, okokuqala lapho ikhibhodi ivuleka
Mangaki amasimu ombhalo angase anikeze igama elifanayo ngaphambi kokuba lime; ukulilahla kulimisa ngaso leso sikhathi
Igama elifanayo kuwo wonke umuntu onamaphakethe akho, ngaleso sikhathi
Injini yokuqaphela, ukubuka kwemakrofoni, izimpawu zokuloba ezikhulunywayo kanye namamodeli angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
Lesi silungiselelo silawula kuphela i-chip emugqeni weziphakamiso. Iphaneli ilanda isibikezelo sezulu uma uyivula. Uhlelo lwe-F-Droid luqala ngalesi silungiselelo sivaliwe.
Ivaliwe, i-chip yesimo sezulu ilinda ukuthi uyithinte ngaphambi kokuba iye ku-inthanethi
Bonisa amazinga okushisa ngo-°F esikhundleni sika-°C
Isimo sezulu kanye nokuseshwa kwendawo kokubili kusebenzisa i-Open-Meteo, kuphela uma uzisebenzisa. Ikhibhodi ayenzi ezinye izicelo zenethiwekhi.

Ithuluzi lisebenzisa kabusha ukufundwa kokugcina isikhathi eside esikhundleni sokubuza isevisi futhi, okonga idatha nebhethri. Kusetha kube kufushane uma ubuka isimo sezulu esishintshayo, kube kude uma usibuka nje. Ukuvula ithuluzi ngemva kokuba lesi sikhathi sidlulile kulanda izinombolo ezintsha.
Isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba ithuluzi libuyise isimo sezulu futhi
Ukusesha nombhalo we-athikili kuvela kuma-API wamahhala we-wikipedia.org, kuphela ngenkathi usebenzisa ithuluzi.
Ikhodi yesizinda esincane: en, bn, de, fr, es …
Isihloko eside singaba nezixhumanisi ezingamakhulu. Ithuluzi licela leli nani futhi uhlu olude luyanqunywa. 500 inani eliphezulu i-Wikipedia ezolibuyisa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Mangaki amakhasi aphumayo uhlu lwezixhumanisi oluwabonisayo
Faka izixhumanisi njenge-[Isihloko](url) esikhundleni sekheli elivamile
Uhlelo lokusebenza luhambisa isikhombisi njengoba lwenzela i-Ctrl nokhiye womcibisholo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zithatha i-\"wmkeyboard.pages.dev\" njengezwi elilodwa.
Isikhombisi siphinde sime echashazini, umugqa otyekile noma olunye uphawu, ukuze sikwazi ukuma ku-\"wmkeyboard.|\".
Isikhombisi sima ezikhaleni kuphela. Ikheli liwulimi olulodwa.
Lapho igama elingakwesobunxele negama elingakwesokudla liyeka khona, nokuthi ukukhetha igama kuthathani
Ithuluzi ngalinye lithola umbala walo wokugcizelela lapha nasebhokisini lamathuluzi. Vula ithuluzi ukuze ushintshe umbala waleyo nkinobho eyodwa.

Uma icishiwe, ithuluzi lingumbala owodwa oyisicaba. Uma ivuliwe, ithuluzi ngalinye liba umbala oshintshayo osuka kumbala walo phezulu kwesobunxele uye kumbala wesibili ngezansi kwesokudla. Umbala wesibili ubalwa kusukela kowokuqala, ngakho awudingi ukukhetha owodwa. Ukuze ukhethe womabili, vula ithuluzi bese usetha umbala wokuqala nombala wokugcina.
Penda ithuluzi ngalinye ngemibala emibili, kusukela phezulu kwesobunxele kuya phansi kwesokudla

Amathuluzi akubha yamathuluzi yekhibhodi nasebhokisini lamathuluzi. Inkinobho yegridi kubha yamathuluzi ivula ibhokisi lamathuluzi. Isishintshi sivula ithuluzi. Cindezela umugqa ukuze uvule izilungiselelo zalelo thuluzi. I-⚙ imaka amathuluzi anezinketho zawo.
Idinga ukhiye we-API. Cindezela lo mugqa ukuze ungeze owodwa.
Idinga isakhiwo sesibili. Cindezela lo mgqa, bese Izakhiwo zezikhi, ukuze wenze esisodwa.
Engeza umthombo ngaphansi kwe-Emoji › Izingxube ze-Emoji kuqala.
Idinga isihlonzi sezingoma esine-key yakho. Cindezela kulomugqa ukuze usimise.
Bonisa Ukubhala kanye Nokuxhuma kanye nemidiya njengamaqembu amabili
Ukuthayipha ngezwi kuvaliwe. Cindezela lo mugqa ukuze ukuvule.
Ithebhu yokubuka konke yephrojekthi, Ukhiye Wokugunyaza
Eceleni kwe-Access ID. Igcinwe kule foni kuphela; isayina isicelo ngasinye futhi ayithunyelwa neze.

I-Tuya ivumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza kuphela ngokusebenzisa iphrojekthi yakho. E-platform.tuya.com, bhalisa bese udala iphrojekthi yefu ye-Smart Home kulesikhungo sedatha se-akhawunti yakho yohlelo lokusebenza. Ngaphansi kwamadivaysi (Devices), Xhumanisa i-Akhawunti Yohlelo Lokusebenza (Link App Account), skena ikhodi ye-QR nge-Smart Life noma i-Tuya Smart (ithebhu ethi Me, isithonjana sokuskena). Bese ukopisha i-Access ID kanye ne-Access Secret yephrojekthi lapha. Uhlelo lwamahhala ludinga ukuvuselelwa njalo ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kusayithi le-Tuya.
Khohlwa lapho ukuthepha kwami kufika khona
Ukuthepha kubuyela ekufundweni ngokumelene nezinkinobho njengoba kudwetshiwe, futhi ukufunda kuqala kabusha kusukela egameni lakho elilandelayo. Amagama afundiwe nokulungiswa akuthinteki.

Akekho othinta phakathi ncam kwayo yonke inkinobho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, wonke amagama owathayiphayo futhi owashiyayo aqopha lapho umunwe wakho uthinte khona kuhlamvu ngalunye, futhi ukuthinta kwakamuva kufundwa ngokumelene nezinkinobho ezihanjiswe ukuze zifane. Ukushelela okubheke kunkinobho eseduze bese kulungiswa ngendlela oyenza ngayo ngempela. Ukuswayipha kunenguqulo yako yalokhu ngaphansi kokuthayipha kwe-Glide. Kuyicime ukuze umise lokho okufundiwe, noma sebenzisa okuthi Khohlwa ngezansi ukuze uqale kabusha.
Amagama owagcinayo afundisa ikhibhodi ukuthi uphuthelwa kanjani ukhiye ngamunye lapho uthepha
Funda lapho ompompi bami behlala khona

Amagama ezinhlelo zakho zokusebenza ezifakiwe aqedela ngendlela efanayo namagama asohlwini lwamagama. Isibonelo: \"sign\" inikeza i-Signal. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi lutho. Asezingeni eliphansi kunamagama oxhumana nabo, ngoba amagama ajwayelekile afana ne-Files ne-Clock nawo angamagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayilondolozi lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ayidingi mvume.
Qedela amagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe njengoba uthayipha

Uma igama elingekho kusichazamazwi lithayiphiwe, umugqa weziphakamiso ubuza ukuthi ulifake yini. Thepha i-chip ukuze ulondoloze igama, noma u-✕ ukuze ungasaphinde ubuzwe ngalo. Akukho okulondolozwayo ngaphandle uma uthepha. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba i-chip ngemva kwegama ongasaphinde ucabange ngalo iyaphazamisa.
Nikeza ithiphu esikhundleni sokubala ukuthi ulubhala kangaki igama

Uthayipha isifinyezo ngaphandle kophawu lwaso (arent, isnt, youre, oclock…). Uma ucindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi ibuyisela uphawu lwaso, kanti u-\"i\" oyingodwa uba u-\"I\". Ikhibhodi ayiwathinti amagama asengamagama esiNgisi aqotho ngaphandle kophawu lwaso (its, well, ill, shell…). Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza ngisho noma ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalela kucishiwe.

I-Shift ivuleka ngokwayo ekuqaleni kwenkambu yombhalo, nangemva kophawu lokubhala oluqeda umusho (. ! ? ।). Lokhu kwenzeka kuphela ezinkambini ezicela izinhlamvu ezinkulu emishweni, futhi kuphela ngesiNgisi. Ikhibhodi ayikaze ishintshe i-caps lock ngokwayo.
Faka uhlamvu olukhulu ekuqaleni kwesigwebo ngasinye

Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma sivuliwe, ukucindezela ubakaki ovulayo kuthayipha owavalayo ngemva kwekhesa futhi kushiya ikhesa phakathi kwemibili, ngakho uthayipha ngaphakathi kwababili: cindezela ( bese uthola (), ukulungele lokho okungena kuso. Ukucindezela ubakaki ovalayo uma usuwuhlamvu olulandelayo kuwudlula esikhundleni sokuthayipha owesibili, futhi ukucindezela okukodwa kwe-backspace kubakaki abangenalutho kukhipha zombili izingxenye. Obakaki be-CJK bafakiwe, kanjalo nababanzi ngokugcwele. Izimpawu zokucaphuna azifakiwe: uphawu lokucaphuna ku-\"don\'t\" luhlanganyela lowo khiye, futhi ukuwuvula kungaba yiphutha kaningi kunokuba kulunge. Futhi akunjalo ngo-<, okungaphandle kwekhodi kuwuphawu olungaphansi. Amaphasiwedi, amakheli ewebhu namaphedi ezinombolo ashiywa njengoba enjalo.
Cindezela ( [ { bese ikhibhodi ithayipha uhhafu wokuvala, nesikhombisi siphakathi kwawo

Awudingi ukucindezela isikhala ekupheleni kwesigaba: \"hello,\" iba \"hello, \" ngokwayo. Iqembu lezimpawu (\"...\", \"?!\") lihlala ndawonye. Uma uzicindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi ayengezi isikhala sesibili. I-Shift ngokushesha ngemva kwesikhala iyasusa. Ikhibhodi ishiya izinkambu ezihleliwe njengoba zinjalo: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi efoni. Isikhala kulezi zinkambu siyiphutha.
Ikhibhodi yengeza isikhala ngemva kokuba uthayiphe . , ? ! ; noma :

Ikhibhodi ilandelela ukuthi ukhipha kangaki ukulungiswa kwayo. Uma ukhipha ukulungiswa kaningi, ikhibhodi ikhuphula ukuzethemba okudingayo ngaphambi kokuba ilungise igama. Uma ungavamile ukukhipha ukulungiswa, ukuzethemba kubuyela kunani le-slider. Ikhibhodi iphinde ikhumbule konke ukulungiswa okukhiphayo. Ukulungiswa okukhipha kabili akusoze kwasebenza futhi.
Lungisa kancane uma uhlehlisa ukulungiswa njalo

Ikhibhodi ilungisa igama kuphela uma umuntu okhethiwe ongcono kakhulu ethola amaphuzu aphezulu kunomuntu wesibili ngalesi sici. Inani eliphansi lilungisa amaphutha amaningi okuthayipha, kodwa liqagela kabi kaningi. Inani eliphezulu lilungisa kuphela uma igama liqinisekile. Ikhibhodi ihlale isebenzisa ukulungiswa okuvunyelwene ngakho yimithombo emibili.
Ukuthi ikhibhodi kufanele iqiniseke kangakanani ngaphambi kokuba ilungise igama

Uma ucindezela isikhala, ikhibhodi iqhathanisa igama olithayiphile nohlu lwamagama. Uma igama libukeka njengephutha legama elivame kakhulu, ikhibhodi iyashintsha. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ilungise igama olifundisile. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kuhlala kuvaliwe ezinkambini zephasiwedi.

U-Enter uqeda igama ngendlela efanayo nesikhala (space), ngakho ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kungashintsha igama ngaphambi kwalo. Ebhokisini lokusesha noma engxoxweni, u-Enter uphinde uthumele umbhalo, futhi awukwazi ukubona ukulungiswa ngaphambi kokuba kuhambe. Cisha lokhu ukuze uthumele igama lokugcina njengoba ulibhalile. Isikhala nezimpawu zokuloba zisazolungisa amagama.
U-Enter ulungisa igama lokugcina, njengoba isikhala (space) senza

Ngalokhu kuvuliwe, uphawu oluqeda igama lulungisa ngendlela efanayo nesikhala: \"teh!\" iba \"the!\". Izimpawu yilezi . , ! ? ; : kanye ne-Bengali danda (।). I-slash, ubakaki noma uphawu alubalwa. Ngalokhu kuvaliwe, igama eliqedwe uphawu lingena njengoba libhaliwe, okuphephe kakhulu uma ubhala izifinyezo noma amagama uhlu lwamagama olungawazi. I-backspace eyodwa ngemva kophawu ibuyisela igama njengoba ulibhalile.
Isikhathi esigcwele, ukhefana, ! noma ? kulungisa igama lokugcina, njengoba kwenza isikhala

Uma igama olithayiphile lingaziwa, kodwa lihlukana libe amagama amabili ikhibhodi ewaziyo, ikhibhodi ingahlanganisa lawo magama amabili nesikhala phakathi kwawo: \'ofthe\' iba \'of the\'. Uhlamvu oluseduze nebha yesikhala lungaphinde lumele isikhala uqobo, ngakho \'amibtomake\' iba \'ami tomake\'. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenza kuphela uma lingekho igama elilodwa elichaza umbhalo othayiphwe futhi zombili izingxenye zingamagama acacile. Ukucindezela u-Backspace ngemva nje kokuhlukaniswa kubuyisela umbhalo wakho, njenganoma yikuphi okunye ukulungisa.
Hlukanisa amagama amabili athayiphwe ndawonye uma ucindezela isikhala
Lungisa amaphutha okuthayipha ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ucindezela isikhala

Uma \'Bonisa umphumela\' noma \'Chaza izindawo zokuthinta\' kuvuliwe, uhlamvu ngalunye olulindelekile ngokuvamile lugxumela kusayizi walo omusha ekushayweni ngakunye kwekhibhodi. Vula lokhu futhi izindawo zizokhula futhi zinciphe ngokushelelayo, futhi zivele futhi zinyamalale njengoba izinhlamvu zithola noma zilahlekelwa ukuthandwa. Kushintsha kuphela ukudweba. Izindawo zokuthinta ozithayipha kuzo zishintsha ngaso leso sikhathi, njengakuqala. \'Nciphisa ukunyakaza\' kuyakucisha lokhu.
Yehlisa izinhlamvu ezikhulisiwe nemigqa ukuze zibe nosayizi wazo omusha esikhundleni sokugxuma
Umugqa omncane umaka indawo lapho i-autopilot ihlola khona ukucindezela kwakho. Yisebenzise ukulungisa Amandla. Umugqa uyisiza sokulungisa, ngakho-ke uwucime futhi uma usuqedile.
Dweba umngcele oqondile uhlamvu ngalunye olulindelekile olufunayo

Ikhibhodi idweba uhlamvu ngalunye olulindelekile phezu kwebhodi ngosayizi owunikezwe yi-autopilot, ukuze ubone ukuthi Amandla enzeni ngenkathi uthayipha. Okhiye ngokwabo abanyakazi, futhi ubacindezela ezindaweni ezifanayo. Izinhlamvu ezinhlanu kuphela ezidwetshwa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Dweba uhlamvu oluthandwayo ngosayizi wendawo yokuthinta ekhulile

×1.0 idweba indawo ngayinye yokuthinta ngosayizi wayo wangempela. Inani eliphakeme liphindaphinda ukukhula kuphela, ngakho incwadi engazange ifune isikhala esengeziwe ihlala ingusayizi wokhiye wayo futhi umehluko kuphela okhulayo. Lokhu kushintsha ukudweba futhi akukho okunye. Ukucindezela kwakho kuhlala ezindaweni ezifanayo, futhi umugqa ohlala ubonisa umngcele wangempela.
Ukuthi incwadi ethandwayo idwetshwa inkulu kangakanani kunempilo

Ku-1 ikhibhodi ishintsha ukucindezela kuphela emkhawulweni oqondile phakathi kokhiye ababili. Ku-10 uhlamvu olungenzeka luthatha isikhala esiningi phakathi kwalo nohlamvu uhlu lwamagama olungalulindele. Uhlamvu alusoze lwafika kude ngaphezu kobubanzi bokhiye obubodwa, noma yini oyibeka lapha. 5 inani ikhibhodi eyaqala ngalo.
Ukuthi incwadi engase ibe khona ifika kude kangakanani phezu kokhiye oseduze kwayo

Uhlamvu ngalunye lubiza ukudonsa okufanayo, ngaphandle kokusheshisa, ngakho ukubala kuhlala kulula ukulandela. Kukhulise uma izinhlamvu zihamba ngokushesha kakhulu, kunciphise uma ukulungisa okude kuthatha isikhala esiningi. Lesi silungiselelo singu-20 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uswayipha kude kangakanani i-backspace kuhlamvu ngalunye

Ukuswayipha kugqamisa umbhalo osuzosuswa esikhundleni sokususa njengoba uhamba, ukuze ubone ukuthi ufike kude kangakanani. Swayiphela kwesokudla ukuze ubuyisele umbhalo, futhi uphakamise umunwe wakho ukuze ususe okusele kugqanyisiwe. Cisha lokhu ukuze ususe igama ngalinye noma uhlamvu ngesikhathi uswayipha udlula kulo.
Khetha umbhalo njengoba uswayipha, bese uwususa uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho

Amagama alandelayo aphuma ngokushesha kunelokuqala kujika okumisiwe, ngakho leli banga elilodwa lilungisa lonke ukunyakaza. Likhuphule uma amagama enyamalala ngephutha, lehlise uma ukusula umusho kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. Lesi silungiselelo singu-72 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uswayipha kude kangakanani ukhiye we-backspace ukuze ususe igama lokuqala

Cindezela inkinobho yokususa bese uswayiphela kwesobunxele. Isinyathelo ngasinye sisusa igama elilodwa, hhayi uhlamvu olulodwa. Ukucindezela nje, noma ukucindezela ubambe, kusasusa uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi.
Swayiphela eceleni ku-backspace ukuze ususe amagama aphelele
Ibuyela emuva uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ukuze ilungise phakathi kwegama

Amagama asusa umusho ngokudonsa okukodwa. Izinhlamvu zibuyela emuva uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, okuyithuluzi elingcono kakhulu lapho kufanele ulungise phakathi kwegama. Ibanga lesinyathelo esisodwa limiselwe ngezansi, futhi ibanga elihlukile kwelilodwa kwelilodwa.
Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuswayipha kwe-backspace sisusa ini
Amagama okungafanele neze aphakanyiswe noma alungiswe ngokuzenzakalelayo

Ikhibhodi ayinikezi amagama anokhahlo emgqeni weziphakamiso. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi igama elingathathi hlangothi libe igama elinokhahlo. Usengakwazi ukuthayipha noma yiliphi igama ngokwakho. Lesi silungiselelo simisa kuphela iziphakamiso.
Gcina izilimi ezingcolile nezinhlamba zingekho eziphakamisweni

Ukuhwaya okufushane nokusheshayo phezulu ohlwini lwezinhlamvu kubhala uhlamvu olukhulu, ngaphandle kwesidingo sokucindezela u-shift kuqala. Kukhiye onohlamvu lwawo lwe-shifted, njengokhiye wenombolo onophawu ngaphezulu, ukuhwaya kubhala lolo phawu. Ukuhwaya kumele kube kufushane, kuqonde phezulu futhi kusheshe, njengokuhwaya phansi kweseluleko. Ukuhudula okude noma okunensa kuwukuslayida, njengakuqala. Uma amagama akukhiye ebonisa igama kukhiye, ukuhwaya phezulu kusathatha lelo gama. Uma ukuthayipha ngokuslayida kuvuliwe, ukuslayida okusheshayo kwegama elifushane eliya phezulu, njenge-\"de\", kungabhala uhlamvu olukhulu esikhundleni salokho. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuhwaya ngokushesha phezulu kuhlamvu kukuthayipha njengohlamvu olukhulu

Izinkambu ze-imeyili ngokuvamile zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ifihle umugqa weziphakamiso. Lokhu kungafihla lezi ziphakamiso lapho zisiza kakhulu khona. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, iziphakamiso ze-imeyili yoxhumana nabo zisavela ezinkambini ze-imeyili. Ezinye iziphakamiso zihlala zifihliwe lapho. Kuyicime ukuze ulandele inkambu, futhi uqedele amakheli e-imeyili kuphela embhalweni ovamile.
Zibonise ngisho nalapho uhlelo lokusebenza lufihla iziphakamiso
Ama-imeyili oxhumana nabo ezinkambini ze-imeyili futhi

Thayipha isiqalo sekheli le-imeyili loxhumana naye, isibonelo \"john\". Ikhibhodi inikeza ikheli eligcwele (john.doe@gmail.com) emgqeni weziphakamiso. Ikhibhodi ifunda amakheli enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayigcini lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo akukaze kuzishintshe. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga imvume Yoxhumana nabo.
Qedela ikheli le-imeyili loxhumana naye njengoba ulithayipha

Amagama akuzinombolo zakho zocingo agcwaliseka ngendlela efanayo namagama ohlwini lwamagama. Isibonelo: \"was\" inikeza u-Wasi. Amagama nawo ayaxhumana: ngemva kuka-Wasi, ikhibhodi inikeza isibongo. Ikhibhodi ifunda amagama enkumbulweni kuphela. Ayigcini lutho futhi ayithumeli lutho, futhi ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akulokothi kushintshe igama elikwaziyo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga imvume Yoxhumana nabo.
Qedela amagama kusuka koxhumana nabo njengoba uthayipha

Ikhibhodi ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso eziphezulu ngamagama owathayiphe ngaphambi kwazo: amabhangqa akho amagama, amabhangqa ajwayelekile esiNgisi, namagama avela engxoxweni yamanje. Ukuhlela kabusha kusebenza kuphela uma kunobufakazi bangempela, ngakho ukuhleleka okuvamile kuhlala ezimweni ezingajwayelekile. Lokhu akushintshi neze ukuthi yiliphi igama elisetshenziswa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ngemva kokuba uthayiphe igama, ikhibhodi ibheka futhi igama elingaphambi kwalo negama elisha elibonakalayo. Uma okunye ukufundwa okwakunako kufanelana kangcono nomusho (\"by a car\" → \"buy\"), ithiphu elinikezayo. Akukho okushintshayo uze uthephe ithiphu. Kudinga imodeli yomongo.
Nikeza ukulungiswa kwegama elingaphambili, uma igama elilandelayo likhombisa lokho obukusho

Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma sivuliwe, ukucindezela u-Enter emgqeni oqala ngomaka wohlu kuqala umugqa olandelayo ngowalandelayo: - * + kanye • kuyaqhubeka njengoba kunjalo, 1. kanye 1) kuyabalwa, futhi ibhokisi lomsebenzi elinjenge - [x] noma ☐ liyaqhubeka njengebhokisi elingenalutho. Ukuhlehla phambi komaka kuyagcinwa. Ukucindezela u-Enter entweni engenalutho ngemva komaka wayo kuqeda uhlu: umaka uyasuswa futhi akukho mugqa omusha othayiphiwayo. Inombolo kumele ibe yidijithi ezintathu noma ngaphansi, ngakho umugqa ovulwa ngonyaka ushiywa unjalo. Izinkambu kuphela lapho u-Enter enza khona umugqa omusha ezibamba iqhaza; ibhokisi lengxoxo elithumela ku-Enter lithumela njengenjwayelo, futhi u-Shift+Enter lapho wenza umugqa wohlu. Amaphasiwedi, izinkambu ze-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu kanye namaphedi ezinombolo ashiywa enjalo.
Faka ngemva kokuthi \"1. ubisi\" uthayiphe \"2. \" emgqeni olandelayo, kunoma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza
Ngenisa uhlu lwakho lwamagama olimi ngalunye

Ukususa igama emgqeni wokusikisela kulikhohlwa kusichazamazwi sakho somuntu siqu, igumbi lokulinda, izinguquko zakho zokubeka kanye nesichazamazwi se-Android. Ngalokhu kuvuliwe, igama eliphinde libe ohlwini lwamagama olungenisile liyasuswa nasefayeleni lalolo hlu, ngakho linyamalala unomphela; igama elisohlwini olulandiwe, elingakwazi ukuhlelwa, liya ohlwini lwabavinjelwe esikhundleni salokho. Ngalokhu kuvaliwe, izinhlu ezingenisiwe zishiywa njengoba uzingenisile futhi igama liyavinjelwa ngendlela efanayo, ngakho lihlala lifihliwe uze ukhethe ukusikisela futhi.
Ukususwa kwegama kukukhipha ohlwini lwakho lwamagama angenisiwe

Ezinye izinhlu zamagama zipela amagama ngohlamvu olukhulu, njengamabizo esiJalimane namagama ezindawo. Uma uthayipha noma uswayipha elinye lala magama ngezinhlamvu ezincane, ikhibhodi ilibhala ngohlamvu lwalo olukhulu. Igama uhlu olulipela ngezinhlamvu ezincane lihlala njengoba ulithayiphile. I-Backspace ngokushesha ngemva kwegama ibuyisela lokho okuthayiphile. Lokhu kusebenzisa uhlu lwamagama olulande ngolimi. Ohlwini lwesiNgisi olwakhelwe ngaphakathi, ikhibhodi iphethe izinhlamvu ezinkulu zezinsuku, izinyanga, izindawo, amagama nezifinyezo ngokwayo.
Bhala igama ngohlamvu olukhulu olunikezwa uhlu lwamagama alo

Cindezela isikhala kabili ngokushesha ekupheleni kwegama. Isikhathi esigcwele sithatha indawo yesikhala sokuqala ngesikhathi esigcwele, ukuze ukwazi ukuqeda umusho ngaphandle koshintsho kusakhiwo sezimpawu. Ithebhu iyishintsha ngohlamvu lwethebhu, olusiza ngezikhala namafomu. Izikhala ezimbili zishiya zombili izikhala njengoba zinjalo.

Izikhala ezimbili eziseduze kakhulu kunalokhu zibalwa njengesikhala esiphindwe kabili futhi ziba yisikhathi noma ithebhu. Yikhuphule uma uthayipha kancane futhi ungalokothi uthole isikhathi. Yiyehlise uma uthola izikhathi ongazihlosile. Lesi silungiselelo singu-400 ms ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi izikhala ezimbili kufanele zilandelane ngokushesha kangakanani

Amanye amafoni awakuvumeli ukunyakaza okubuyela emuva kohlelo ukuba kuqale phezu kwekhibhodi, ngakho-ke kufanele ukusungule ngaphezu kwekhibhodi. Nalolu setingi luvuliwe, ukuswayipha okuqala emaphethelweni esobunxele noma esokudla kwekhibhodi futhi kungena ngaphakathi kwenza into efanayo. Kuvala iphaneli evulekile, isibonelo iphaneli yezwi, ebuye imise ukurekhoda. Uma kungekho phaneli evulekile, kuvala ikhibhodi. Lolu setingi luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba ukuslayida okuqala emaphethelweni kakhulu bese kungena ngaphakathi kubukeka kufana. Qala ukuslayida kancane ukusuka emaphethelweni.
Ukuswayipha usuka emaphethelweni esobunxele noma esokudla kwekhibhodi kuvala iphaneli noma ikhibhodi
Swayiphela ngaphakathi usuka emaphethelweni ukuze ubuyele emuva
Valiwe ngenkathi ukuthayipha ngeminwe emibili kuvuliwe

Beka iminwe emibili noma ngaphezulu okhiye bese uyiswayipha ngendlela efanayo ndawonye. Esikhundleni sokuthayipha, ukuswayipha kwenza isenzo osikhethele leyo nombolo yeminwe naleyo ndlela. Ngokuzenzakalelayo, iminwe emibili phezulu ikhetha wonke umbhalo, kwesobunxele kuhlehlisa, kwesokudla kuphinda, futhi phansi kunamathisela. Iminwe emithathu nemine iqala ingenalutho. Ukuthayipha okusheshayo akudidaniswa nokuswayipha: wonke umunwe kufanele uhambe ngendlela efanayo ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke noma yini, futhi ukuphakamisa owodwa kuqala kushiya okhiye ukuthi bathayiphe njengokujwayelekile. Umugqa ulandela umunwe ngamunye ngenkathi ukuswayipha kuvuliwe.
Buyisela konke ukuswayipha ngeminwe eminingi kokuzenzakalelayo
Swayipha iminwe emibili, emithathu noma emine ndawonye phezu kwezikhiye ukuze wenze isenzo

Umugqa usaqala kusuka enanini leziphakamiso.
