Lapho igama elingcono kakhulu lishaya kancane elilandelayo

Bamba umunwe wakho unganyakazi isikhathi eside kangaka ekupheleni kokuswayipha futhi amagama ayavela. Isikhathi esifushane siphendula ngokushesha kodwa singavula amagama uma ume kancane ukuze ucabange phakathi negama. Isikhathi eside asiwavuli ngengozi kodwa sikwenza ulinde. Ukunyakaza okuncane akubalwa: umunwe wakho ungaphumula engilazini futhi uzulazule kancane.
Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukugcina umunwe wakho unganyakazi ngaphambi kokuba amagama avele
Njalo uma ume kancane, noma yini ikhibhodi ecabanga ukuthi iyiyo

Uma ikhibhodi iqinisekile ngokuswayipha ayibuzi ngesikhathi esijwayelekile. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, qhubeka ubambe isikhathi esiphindwe kabili bese ibuzayo, ukuze ukwazi ukuhlola noma yikuphi ukuswayipha ngaphambi kokuba uphakamise umunwe. Kuyicime bese ukuswayipha ikhibhodi eqinisekile ngakho akubuzi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubambe isikhathi esingakanani.
Ukuswayipha okuqinisekile kusabuza uma ubambe isikhathi eside kabili
Bamba isikhathi eside ukuze ubuze njalo

Okunye ukuswayipha akunawo impendulo eyodwa efanele. Kusakhiwo esinqunyiwe sesi-Bengali izinhlamvu ক kanye no-খ zabelana ngokhiye owodwa, ngakho igama kanye ne-twin yalo efisayo idwetshwa ngendlela efanayo ncamashi, futhi kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo ukuswayipha okusheshayo kungalingana namagama amabili ngokulinganayo. Uma lokho kwenzeka, gcina umunwe wakho phansi uwubambe unganyakazi isikhashana: amagama aseduze avela ngaphansi komunwe wakho. Shelelela kwelinye bese uphakamisa ukuze ulithayiphe. Phakamisa ngaphandle kokukhetha bese ikhibhodi ithayipha ukuqagela kwayo okungcono kakhulu, njengoba yayihlale yenza, futhi amagama afanayo ahlala kubha yeziphakamiso noma ngabe yikuphi.
Kuphela lapho amagama amabili elingana kahle

Ngemva kokuswayipha ikhibhodi iqhathanisa ukufundwa kwayo okubili okungcono kakhulu. Uma eseduze, inciphisa ukuqiniseka kwayo. Ukusondelana kubuza kuphela uma amagama amabili elingana kahle. Ukusondelana okukhulu, okuzenzakalelayo, kubuza uma igama elingcono kakhulu lishaya elilandelayo kancane. Noma yikuphi ukungabaza kubuza noma nini lapho elinye igama lisondela. Konke ukuma kubuza njalo uma ubambe unyakazi, noma yini ikhibhodi ecabanga ngayo. Amagama afanayo asesikrinini seziphakamiso noma ngabe yikuphi.
Ukuthi ukuswayipha kufanele kusondele kangakanani ngaphambi kokuba kubuze
Bamba umunwe wakho unganyakazi ukuze ukhethe phakathi kwamagama aseduze kakhulu

Ngokuzenzakalelayo igama elintantayo lithatha umbala walo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi, okuwumbala ofanayo ne-popup yokhiye. Khetha umbala lapha futhi izowusebenzisa esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.
Ukuthi igama lintanta kude kangakanani ngaphezu komunwe wakho

Ngenkathi uslayida, igama ikhibhodi elifunda kuze kube manje lintanta ngaphezu komunwe wakho, futhi liyashintsha njengoba uhamba. Cisha lokhu bese igama livela kuphela emgqeni weziphakamiso. Lokhu akushintshi lokho okuthayishwa ukuslayida.

Isandla sakho simboza uhlangothi olulodwa lomunwe wakho kakhulu kunolunye. Hambisa igama kolunye uhlangothi futhi ungalifunda ngaphandle kokuhambisa isandla sakho. Inani elingalungile lilihambisela kwesobunxele. Inani elihle lilihambisela kwesokudla. Eduze komphetho wekhibhodi igama liyema emaphethelweni.
Hambisa igama kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla somunwe wakho
Lona usayizi wombhalo wegama elintantayo kuphela. Umugqa weziphakamiso nokhiye akushintshi.
Usayizi wegama elintantayo ngaphezu komunwe wakho
Ntanta igama ngaphezu komunwe wakho njengoba uslayida

Ngokuzenzakalelayo igama elintantayo lithatha umbala walo wombhalo kusuka kutimu yekhibhodi. Khetha umbala lapha futhi usebenzisa lowo esikhundleni salokho. Setha kabusha umugqa ukuze ulandele itimu futhi.
Okuzenzakalelayo kusebenza njenge-\"%1$s\" manje. Khetha noma yikuphi okunye ongakukhetha ukuze uqale kabusha

Ukuswayipha kutshela ikhibhodi ukuthi yiziphi izinkinobho umunwe wakho owusondele kuzo, ngakho lokho okuncintisana nakho kunquma ukuthi kulungile kangaki. Abantu abaningi babhala ngamagama ayizinkulungwane ezimbalwa, futhi uma ikhibhodi isifunde awakho, lonke isichazamazwi lincintisana kakhulu. \"Amagama ami kuphela\" kuyakususa lokho: ukuthayipha ngokuswayipha kuphendula ngamagama owabhalile, futhi akukho okunye. Ekuhloleni okufunda amagama owabhalayo ngamaphuzu amahlanu ngokunembile, futhi akukwazi ukukhiqiza igama ongakaze ulibhale nhlobo. \"Khetha amagama ami\" akushintshi cishe lutho ngokwalo — kusebenzisa kokubili futhi kubala ukuthi amagama akho ayenele kangaki, okuyilokho \"Okuzenzakalelayo\" okusebenzisayo ukunquma. \"Okuzenzakalelayo\" kuqala \"Egama ngalinye\" futhi kukubuza ngaphambi kokuba kukhuphuke. Noma yini oyikhethayo, ukubuyisela emuva igama eliswayiphiwe kusesha wonke amagama esichazamazwini ngomzila owudwebile, ngakho igama ikhibhodi engalifundanga alisoze laphuma ekufinyeleleni.
Vumela ukuthayipha ngokuswayipha kuncike emagameni ikhibhodi ekufunde kuwe

Uma ukuswayipha kukhipha igama elingalungile, umugqa owudwebile uwona kuphela irekhodi lalokho obukusho — izinhlamvu ezisele embhalweni yisilinganiso sekhibhodi, hhayi indlela yomunwe wakho. Ngakho ikhibhodi igcina imigqa eyishumi nambili yokugcina yomkhakha, futhi ukuthepha emuva kwelinye lalawo magama kungasesha umugqa walo kuzo zonke izinhlu zamagama onazo, ngaphezu kwanoma yimuphi umkhawulo wokuthayipha ngokuswayipha ovame ukusebenza ngawo. Lokho kusesha kuhlale kutholakala: bamba igama emgqeni weziphakamiso bese ukhetha \"Sesha wonke amagama\". Lesi silungiselelo sengeza i-chip eyinikezayo ngaphandle kokubamba, ngezindleko zesikhala esisodwa sesiphakamiso noma nini lapho ufunda igama eliswayiphiwe. Noma iyiphi indlela ofika ngayo kuyo, ukukhipha igama ekusesheni kulungisa umbhalo futhi kufundisa ikhibhodi lowo mugqa, ukuze ukuswayipha okufanayo kufundeke kahle ngokuzayo.
Bonisa inkinobho yokusesha wonke uhlu lwamagama uma uthepha emuva egameni eliswayiphiwe
Nikelela usesho oluphelele ngenkathi uhlola amaphutha

Uma inikwe amandla, noma yikuphi ukunyakaza okuhambisana eduze nokuma okufundiwe esitolo sakho sesitayela sokuswayipha kuzogqugquzelwa ngokuqondile eziphakamisweni zamagama, ngisho noma ukunyakaza kuqale noma kuphele kude nezikhiye ezihlosiwe zegama. Shiya kungasebenzi uma ukhetha ukudekoda okujwayelekile kwezikhiye ngaphandle kokufaka imbewu yeziphakamiso.
Ivumela ukuthinta okungacacile noma okungaqondile ukuthi kuphakamise amagama afundiwe

Funda isitayela sami sokuswayipha sigcina izimo zakho zegama ngalinye oswayipha ngalo, futhi ukuswayipha kufundwa ngokumelene nesiseduze kakhulu kuzo. Swayipha igama ngendlela efanayo futhi isimo sihlala; swayipha ngendlela ehlukile ngokucacile futhi lokho kugcinwa njengesinye isimo, kuze kufike kuleli nani, okusetshenziswe kancane kwenza indawo. Yikhuphule uma uswayipha amagama athile ngezindlela ezimbalwa ezahlukene futhi ikhibhodi iqhubeka ikhohlwa elilodwa lazo. Izimo zihamba kusipele ngaphansi kwesitayela sokuswayipha, ukuze ubone ukuthi amagama akho asebenzisa malini ngempela. Ukuyehlisa kukhipha okungeziwe ekusebenziseni ngokushesha, futhi kususwa kuphela uma lelo gama lifunda isimo esisha ngokulandelayo. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi Funda isitayela sami sokuswayipha kuvuliwe.
Izindlela ezingaki zokuswayipha igama elilodwa ezikhunjulwayo

Kulinganiswa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Ikhibhodi inikeza igama kuphela uma umunwe wakho wehlela eduze kakhulu nohlamvu lokuqala lwalelo gama. Inani eliphezulu livumela ukushelela ukuthi kuqale ngaphandle kokhiye futhi kusathole igama. Inani eliphansi lala ukushelela okuqala endaweni engafanele, okuyinto eqinile kodwa engabangela ukulahlekelwa igama obulifuna. Likhuphule leli nani uma ukushelela kwakho kuqala sekwephuzile noma kuphansi.
Ukuthi ukuqala kokuslayida kungaba kude kangakanani nohlamvu lokuqala

Ngenkathi umunwe wakho ucindezelwe, ikhibhodi iphinda ifunde ukushaya izikhathi eziningi ngomzuzwana, futhi ekuqaleni kokushaya kuncane kakhulu okungatholakala — izinhlamvu ezimbili, amagama amaningi asafaneleka. Njengoba evela, iziphakamiso, igama elingaphezu komunwe wakho namagama akuzinkinobho konke kushintsha izikhathi eziningi ngesikhathi sokuslayida, okunzima ukukufunda futhi kudonsa amehlo akho kude nekhibhodi. Lesi silungiselelo senza igama elivele lisesikrinini ligcine indawo yalo ngaphandle kokuthi elinye igama lingcono ngokusobala, futhi linikeza isikhashana sokuzimela ngaphambi kokuthi noma yini ikwazi ukulithatha indawo. Igama eliyeka ukufanelana nokushaya kwakho lishintshwa ngaso leso sikhathi. Ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho kubhala igama olibonayo, ngakho ukubuka kuqala okuzinzile akusho ukuthayipha okuthile obungakuboni. \"Okulula\" kuyisilungiselelo esizenzakalelayo.
Vimbela igama ukuba lingashintshi ngaphansi komunwe wakho ekunyakazeni okuncane ngakunye

Ngenkathi ushelela, umugqa wesiphakamiso ubonisa wonke amagama afanelana nokushaywa kwakho, futhi amagama ayashintsha njengoba uhamba. Vula lokhu futhi umugqa ubonisa kuphela igama elibukwa ikhibhodi manje. Amanye amagama abuyela emgqeni uma uphakamisa umunwe wakho. Uma isikhethi sokungaqiniseki sivuliwe, sisabanikela phakathi nokushaywa. Lokhu akushintshi lokho okuthayishwa ukushelela.
Ngenkathi uswayipha, bonisa igama lamanje kuphela

Ukuswayipha kubuyela ekufundweni ngokumelene nezinkinobho njengoba kudwetshiwe, izimo odweba ngazo amagama nokufunda okulungisile kuyakhohlakala, futhi ukufunda kuqala kabusha kusukela ekuswayipheni kwakho okulandelayo. Amagama afundiwe awathinteki.

Akekho oswayipha phakathi nendawo yawo wonke okhiye. Isithupha sisika okhiye abakude futhi sihlale phansi kwabaseduze, futhi ikhibhodi yayijwayele ukushaja konke ukuswayipha ngalokho. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, konke ukuswayipha okugcinayo kuqopha lapho umunwe wakho udlule khona ngempela uhlamvu ngalunye, futhi ukuswayipha kwakamuva kufundwa ngokumelene nokhiye abasuswe ukuze bafane. Kugcina ezinye zezimo zakho zegama ngalinye oliswayiphayo futhi ulishiye lunjalo, ngakho igama olidwebe ngaphambili lifundwa ngokumelene nendlela olidweba ngayo kanye nendlela yencwadi. Futhi kukhumbula uma uthatha elinye igama emgqeni, noma ususa igama eliswayiphiwe ngokushesha, ukuze unhlangothi olufanayo lufunde igama lakho kuqala ngokuzayo; iminwe ebhaliwe yalawo magama kuphela egcinwayo, hhayi amagama uqobo. Ukususa igama eliswayiphiwe kuthatha izifundo zalo emuva. Vala lokhu ukuze uqandise lokho okufundiwe, noma sebenzisa i-Forget ngezansi ukuze uqale phansi.
Lapho umunwe wakho ufika khona, indlela obhala ngayo igama ngalinye, nokuthi yikuphi ukufunda okulungisayo

Slayida umunwe wakho usuka kuhlamvu uye kuhlamvu ngaphandle kokuwususa. Ikhibhodi ithayipha igama uma ususa umunwe wakho. Okunye okufundwayo kubonakala emgqeni wesiphakamiso, ngakho ukucindezela okukodwa kulungisa ukuqagela okungalungile. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi kuphela okwamanje.
Swayipha phezu kwezinhlamvu ukuze uthayiphe igama

I-glide itshela ikhibhodi ukuthi yiziphi izinkinobho umunwe wakho owusondele, nangaluphi uhlelo. Amagama amaningi alingana nalokho ngokukhululekile, ngakho ikhibhodi isebenzisa imvamisa yamagama ukuze ikhethe elilodwa lawo. Isichazamazwi esikhulu siphethe amagama amaningi angavamile, futhi igama elingavamile elisimo salo silingana kangcono linganqoba phezu kwegama obulisho. Lesi silungiselelo sikhawulela i-glide kumagama ajwayelekile kakhulu esichazamazwini. Ishintsha ukuthayipha kwe-glide kuphela. Iziphakamiso, ukuqedwa kwamagama nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kusasebenzisa wonke amagama, ngoba izinhlamvu ozithayiphayo zisho okuningi kuneswayipha. Amagama owafundisa ikhibhodi awasoze akhawulelwa. Isichazamazwi esiza nekhibhodi sincane kunayo yonke imikhawulo lapha, ngakho lesi silungiselelo asenzi lutho uze ulande noma ungenise uhlu olukhulu lwamagama.
Nciphisa ukushelela emagameni ajwayelekile kakhulu esichazamazwi sakho

Kukalwa ngobubanzi bokhiye. Gcina lokhu ngaphansi kobubanzi bokhiye owodwa, noma igama elisuka kokhiye owodwa liye kokhiye olandelayo bese libuyela emuva lifundeka njengohlamvu olulodwa olubhalwe kabili. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi inkinobho engenhla ivuliwe.
Ukuthi umunwe ungahamba ibanga elingakanani ekuhlikihleni

Olunye uphawu abantu abalusebenzisela uhlamvu olubhalwe kabili: esikhundleni sombuthano, basikhipha phezu kokhiye. Lokhu kuvaliwe, ngoba ukujika kancane okudwetshwe ngomunwe ongazinzile kubukeka kufana kakhulu, bese ikhibhodi ibhala izinhlamvu kabili ozibhale kanye. Yivule uma lokhu kuyiphawu olwenzayo.

Inani elingamaphesenti ayi-100 lenza uphawu lube luhle njengombuthano. Inani eliphansi lishiya njengokusikisela, okungase kuhlulwe yigama elivame kakhulu. Kusetshenziswa kuphela ngenkathi iswishi engenhla ivuliwe.
Ukuthi ukuhlikihla kubalwa kangakanani njengobufakazi bezinhlamvu ezimbili
Hlikihla emuva naphambili kokhiye ukuze ubhale uhlamvu kabili
Khulisa indawo yokuthinta yezinhlamvu ozithayiphayo ngokulandelayo
Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, izinhlamvu ezinkulu, izimpawu zokuloba kanye nokuhlukanisa
Ukuthayipha ngokuslayida, ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala nokubhala ngesandla

Lawa manani yindlela ikhibhodi efunda ngayo ukuslayida: ukuthi umunwe wakho kufanele usondele kangakanani ezinkinobho ukuze igama liphakanyiswe, nokuthi yini etshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ubhale uhlamvu kabili. Ziza namanani ikhibhodi elinganiswe ngawo. Hambisa elilodwa, slayida imisho embalwa, bese ucindezela ukusetha kabusha kulayini uma kwenzeke okubi kakhulu. Akukho lapha okungalimaza ikhibhodi.
Izinqamuleli, okhiye abashisayo kanye nokhiye wesinqamuleli
Intanta igama elilandelayo phezu kokhiye ongalifinyelela
Izibalo, izimali, amayunithi, izinsuku kanye nokubheka
Umugqa weziphakamiso, ukufunda, amagama kanye namagama ezinhlelo zokusebenza
Izinhlamvu ezinkulu, isikhala esiphindwe kabili, abakaki, izinhlu

Indlela ukulungisa kwakho okwenziwe ngayo, uhlamvu ngohlamvu. Ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kubheka lokhu kusebenza njengokungenzeka kuwe, ngakho ukusebenza okufanayo egameni ongakaze ulihlole kusaqondakala.

Izinhlamvu ezifana no-i, j no-t zidinga uphawu oluhlukile ngemuva komzila oyinhloko. Ngalolu sikhathi ngemuva kokudweba umzila, ukucindezela phezu kwezinhlamvu kuba omunye umzila womlingiswa ofanayo, ichashazi noma isiphambano. Akuthayiphi lowo khiye. Ukucindezela ngemuva kwewindi kuthayipha njengokujwayelekile. 0 kuyicisha lokhu.
Isikhathi sokwengeza ichashazi noma isiphambano ngaphambi kokuba ukucindezela kuthayiphe uhlamvu
Shintsha izinhlamvu, lungisa futhi uphakamise njengoba uthayipha kukhibhodi engokoqobo

Ukhiye ngamunye ubonisa uhlamvu lwawo lokuqala lokucindezela nokubamba ekhoneni, njengo-1 ku-q. Ukuswayipha okufushane, okusheshayo phansi okhiye kuthayipha lolo hlamvu ngaphandle kokubamba. Lokhu kusebenza kunoma yimuphi ukhiye onohlamvu lokucindezela nokubamba, kuzo zonke izingqimba. Ibha yesikhala, i-backspace kanye nokhiye bokushintsha nokulungisa bagcina ukuswayipha kwabo. Ukuswayipha kufanele kube kufushane, kuqonde phansi futhi kusheshe. Ukuhudula okude noma okunensa kuwukushelela, njengakuqala. Uma ukuthayipha kokushelela kuvuliwe, ukushelela okusheshayo kakhulu kwegama elifushane eliya phansi ngqo, njengo-\"ed\", kungathayipha icebo esikhundleni salokho. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuswayipha okusheshayo phansi kukhiye kuthayipha uhlamvu lwayo oluncane lwekhona

Isikhala esithayiphelwe ngephutha phambi kophawu lokubhala siyasuswa lapho uphawu lufika. Uphawu kumele luze ngemuva kwegama, inombolo noma kubakaki abavalayo, ngakho uphawu ekuqaleni komugqa luyashiywa. Isikhala esisodwa emuva kwesikhala sibuyisela isikhala. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo: ezinye izilimi zibeka isikhala phambi kophawu lombuzo noma ikholoni ngenhloso. Ikhibhodi ishiya izinkambu ezihleliwe zodwa: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi efoni.
Uhlamvu olulodwa lophawu ngalunye, ngaphandle kwezikhala phakathi kwazo

Ngekhibhodi engokoqobo, ngokuvamile akukho ikhibhodi esesikrinini, futhi ithuluzi alinawo umkhathi wokudweba. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, isinqumo esivula ithuluzi sibonisa ikhibhodi. Uma uvala ithuluzi, ikhibhodi iyacasha futhi.
Isinqamuleli esivula ithuluzi siphinde sibonise ikhibhodi
I-Ctrl+1 ivula ibhokisi lamathuluzi, i-Ctrl+2 ithuluzi lokuqala, njalonjalo
I-Ctrl + inombolo ivula ithuluzi lebhala lamathuluzi
Indandatho kukhiye owodwa; inkinobho emaphakathi noma u-Enter iyayithayipha
I-Escape ivala kuphela lokho ikhibhodi evulekile. Uma kungekho thuluzi elivulekile, i-Escape iya ngqo kuhlelo lokusebenza, ngakho isayeka ukulayishwa kwekhasi noma iphuma kumodi yokufaka kusihleli.
I-Escape ivala ithuluzi elivuliwe esikhundleni sokuya kuhlelo lokusebenza

Okhiye be-F1 kuya ku-F10 basebenza njenge-Ctrl+1 kuya ku-Ctrl+0: F1 ivula wonke amathuluzi, kanti i-F2 icindezela inkinobho yokuqala kubha yamathuluzi. Ngenkathi lokhu kusebenza, ibha yamathuluzi ikhombisa u-F1, F2 nokunye ngaphansi kwezinkinobho zayo uma ucindezela ukhiye wesinqamuleli. \"Kumodi yokukhetha\" ishiya okhiye be-F kuhlelo lokusebenza uze uvule imodi yokukhetha. \"Njalo\" ibathatha ngaso sonke isikhathi, okungaphazamisa amatheminali nabahleli bekhodi abawasebenzisayo.
I-F1 ivula wonke amathuluzi kanti i-F2 kuya ku-F10 icindezela izinkinobho zebha yamathuluzi

I-Ctrl+Space iya olimini olulandelayo kanti i-Ctrl+Shift+Space iya kulolo olungaphambi kwalo. Gcina i-Ctrl icindezelwe bese ucindezela i-Space futhi ukuze udlule ohlwini esikrinini — ikhibhodi iyashintsha uma i-Ctrl ikhishwa. I-Esc iyakhansela. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenzisa i-Ctrl+Space ngokwazo, isibonelo abahleli bekhodi bayisebenzisa ukubonisa ukuqedwa. Ngenkathi lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ithatha isinqamuleli uma uthayipha kulezo zinhlelo zokusebenza — yicime lapha ukuze uyibuyisele. Uma ukhiye wesinqamuleli ovula amathuluzi nawo usethwe ku-Ctrl+Space, ukushintsha kolimi kuyawina. Ikhibhodi enokhiye wayo wolimi ayidingi lesi silungiselelo: lowo khiye uhlale usebenza.
Bamba u-Ctrl ukuze uphequlule uhlu lolimi, dedela ukuze ushintshe

Kwekhibhodi eyenzelwe i-Mac. I-Command ingukhiye oseduze nebha yesikhala. I-Command+C, Command+V, Command+X kanye ne-Command+A kopisha, namathisela, sika futhi ukhethe konke. I-Command+Z ukuhlehlisa futhi i-Command+Shift+Z ukwenza futhi. I-Command+Left kanye ne-Command+Right ziya ekuqaleni nasekupheleni komugqa. I-Option+Left kanye ne-Option+Right zihambisa igama elilodwa. I-Option+Backspace isusa igama elilodwa, kanti i-Command+Backspace isusa kuze kube sekuqaleni komugqa. Bamba i-Shift ngokuhambisa ukuze ukhethe. I-Ctrl igcina ukuziphatha kwayo okujwayelekile, futhi zonke ezinye izinqamuleli ze-Command ziya kuhlelo lokusebenza. Amanye amadivayisi agcina inani elincane lezinqamuleli ze-Command zesistimu, futhi lezo azifinyeleli kukhibhodi.
I-Command ne-Option ziziphatha ngendlela eziziphatha ngayo ku-Mac
Bonisa u-Ctrl no-Shift okhiye esikhundleni sezimpawu zabo

Kuthuluzi, okhiye bomcibisholo bahambisa ukugqamisa phezu kwe-emoji, iziqeshana noma imiphumela. U-Enter usebenzisa into enokugqamisa. U-Tab uhambisa phakathi kwebhokisi lokusesha, ama-chips esigaba kanye nemiphumela. Ukugqamisa kubonakala kuphela ngemva kokuba ucindezele ukhiye. Akusoze kwavela ngenkathi usebenzisa ikhibhodi ngokuthinta.
Imicibisholo ihambisa okugqanyisiwe ethuluzini, u-Enter ukukhetha, u-Esc uvalela ithuluzi
Noma cindezela ukhiye kukhibhodi exhunyiwe. Ukhiye ono-Ctrl, Alt, Shift noma Meta uyasebenza, kanjalo no-F1 kuya ku-F12 kanye no-Insert ngokwawo.
%1$s isivele ivula amathuluzi. Khetha elinye inkinobho.
Ukhiye owenza okhiye bezinombolo bakhethe iziphakamiso uze uwucindezele futhi
Ukuthi okhiye bahlala isikhathi esingakanani esikrinini ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli
Vula amathuluzi kusuka kukhibhodi yangempela ngaphandle kokuthinta isikrini

Isiphakamiso ngasinye sikhombisa ukhiye osikhethayo, inqobo nje uma ikhibhodi engokomzimba ixhunyiwe. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ku-\"Alt + inombolo\", engadingi ukhiye wesinqamuleli kuqala. Nge-\"Ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli\", izinombolo zivela ngemva kokuba ucindezele ukhiye wesinqamuleli, ngoba yilapho zisebenza khona.
Beka ukhiye ngaphansi kwesiphakamiso ngasinye ngenkathi ikhibhodi engokoqobo ixhunyiwe
Ukhiye owodwa ngaphansi, kodwa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziningi zisebenzisa u-Alt nenombolo kumathebhu azo

Awukwazi ukucindezela umugqa wesiphakamiso ngenkathi uthayipha kukhibhodi engokoqobo. Inkinobho yenombolo ikhetha isiphakamiso esikhundleni salokho. \"Ngemva kokhiye wesinqamuleli\" yisinqumo esiphephile, ngoba akukho okunye okuyisebenzisayo. \"Alt + inombolo\" idinga ukhiye owodwa omncane, kodwa iziphequluli, abahleli nezinhlelo zokusebenza zengxoxo zisebenzisa isilungisi nenombolo ukushintsha amathebhu nezindawo zokusebenza.
Ukukhetha okuphephile. Akukho okunye okusebenzisa ukhiye wesinqamuleli
Thayipha isiphakamiso ngenombolo yaso emgqeni weziphakamiso

Uma ukhetha inkambu yokungena, umphathi wakho wamaphasiwedi angahlinzeka ngamafayela alondoloziwe njengezinto ezincane emgqeni wokuphakamisa, esikhundleni se-popup ehlukile. Umphathi wamaphasiwedi uzidweba ngokwakhe lezo zinto. Ikhibhodi ithola usayizi wazo kuphela, futhi ayikaze ibone igama lomsebenzisi noma iphasiwedi ekuzona. Imodi ye-Incognito iyayicisha le nto ngokwayo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga i-Android 11 noma entsha, kanye nomphathi wamaphasiwedi osethwe njengensiza yakho yokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalela yohlelo.
Bonisa ukungena okugciniwe okuvela kusevisi yakho yokugcwalisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kumugqa wesiphakamiso

Thayipha ikholoni ekuqaleni kwegama ukuze ushintshe umugqa wokusikisela ube ukusesha kwe-emoji. \":cat\" inikeza 🐱, futhi ukucindezela kuthatha indawo yombhalo owuthayiphile. Cindezela inkinobho yokususa phezu kwekholoni ukuze ubuyele eziphakamisweni zamagama ezijwayelekile. Cindezela isikhala ukuze ugcine umbhalo njengoba uwuthayiphile.
Thayipha u-\":\" negama ukuze uthole i-emoji, njenge :smi ye-😄
Khetha ukhiye, bese ukhetha ukuthi ukuswayipha kude nawo kwenzani
Thepha isiqondiso ukuze ukhethe ukuthi ukuswayipha okufushane ngaleyo ndlela kwenzani.
Khetha konke, kopisha, namathisela, sika, hlehlisa futhi wenze futhi phansi nangakwesobunxele ku-A, C, V, X, Z naku-Y
1 kuya ku-0 phezulu nangakwesokudla emgqeni ongaphezulu
Izinombolo, izimpawu noma izinqamuleli zokuhlela ngesikhathi esisodwa

Beka uhlamvu noma isenzo kunoma yiziphi izinkomba eziyisishiyagalombili ezizungeze ukhiye, futhi ukuswayipha okufushane ngaleyo ndlela kude nokhiye kuyakuthayipha noma kukusebenzise. Ukuswayipha kungokhiye, hhayi kusakhiwo, ngakho-ke u-1 owubeka phezulu nangakwesokudla kuka-Q ukhona ku-QWERTY, AZERTY nakuso sonke esinye isakhiwo esino-Q. Lapho isakhiwo sesivele sinokuswayipha kuleyo ndlela, ukuswayipha kwesakhiwo uqobo kuyahlala. Ukhiye ngamunye udweba ukuswayipha kwawo kuncane ebusweni bawo, futhi ukuthayipha okushelelayo kusebenza: ukuswayipha okujikayo, noma okuqhubekela kwelinye uhlamvu, kushelela igama. Ukhiye onokuswayipha uyayeka ukuswayipha phansi ukuze uthole iseluleko sawo kanye nokuslayida ukuze ukhethe. Amakhasi ezinhlamvu kuphela awatholayo.
Ukwayipha kwakho okufushane okusuka okhiye bezinhlamvu, kukho konke ukwakheka
Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kulandela ulimi olutholiwe ngokumelene namagama ajwayelekile futhi
Ukutholwa okucacile kuthatha umkhondo, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kuyakulandela

Ikhibhodi igcina irekhodi, ngohlelo lokusebenza, lokuthi yiziphi izilimi zakho amagama owathayiphayo lapho angawazo. Uma uvula inkambu yombhalo kulolo hlelo lokusebenza, ukutholwa kuqala kulelo rekhodi esikhundleni sokungabi nalutho, ngakho umyalezo omusha kuhlelo lokusebenza lwengxoxo obhala ngalo i-Banglish utshekela ku-Banglish ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe igama, futhi i-imeyili entsha iqala ngesiNgisi. Ukutsheka kubiza cishe igama elilodwa elithayiphiwe lobufakazi kakhulu, ngakho igama lokuqala olithayiphayo empeleni liyadlula futhi umyalezo ngolunye ulimi awulwiwa. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinamagama ambalwa nje omlando zitshekela kancane. Irekhodi lihlala kule divayisi futhi lisulwa kanye nalo lonke idatha efundiwe.
Qala ngolimi ovame ukubhala ngalo kulolu hlelo lokusebenza
Ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela. Ulimi lwekhibhodi yakho luhlala lunqoba

Uma izilimi zakho zisebenzisa ikhibhodi efanayo, amagama asevele enkundleni yombhalo akhombisa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi olubhalayo manje. Ikhibhodi ithambekela eziphakamisweni zayo kanye nokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kulolo limi, futhi ibuyela emuva uma ushintsha. Thayipha i-ami tomake kukhibhodi yesiNgisi futhi izoziphatha njenge-Banglish; thayipha i-how are you futhi izoziphatha njengesiNgisi futhi. Lokhu kusebenza ngenkundla yombhalo ngayinye futhi kudinga izilimi ezine-Also suggest from esethiwe, okuyinto izilimi zesi-romanized ezithola ngokuzenzakalelayo.

I-Gentle ihlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela futhi ayilokothi ivumele ulimi olutholiwe ukuba lunqobe olwekhibhodi. I-Balanced ivumela ulimi olutholiwe ngokucacile ukuba luhole, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kulandela wonke amagama ngaphandle kwawona ajwayelekile kakhulu. I-Aggressive inikela ngokuphelele, ngakho ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kulungisa amaphutha olimini olutholiwe ngisho naphambene namagama ajwayelekile kakhulu olimi lwekhibhodi.

Ukuthinta okusheshayo kubha yesikhala kuphela ngaphambi kokuba ukubuka kuqala kwayo kudwetshwe, ngakho ikhibhodi igcina ulimi ehlale kulo isikhashana ngemva kokuba uphakamise umunwe, ukuze ubonise lapho uya khona. Lokhu isikhathi esihlala ngaso, kubalwa isikhathi lapho ukubuka kuqala bekusuvele kukhona. Shelelisela kokuthi Valiwe ukuze kuhambe ngaso leso sikhathi lapho uphakamisa umunwe. Ukuswayipha kancane okuhlale olimini lwayo isikhathi esingangesigamu sesekhondi sekusuvele kukubonise, ngakho kuhamba ngaso leso sikhathi noma ngabe lokhu kusethwe kanjani.
Ukuthi ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kukhombisa isikhathi esingakanani ulimi esishintshele kulona

Lesi yisikhethi esivuleka uma ubamba ibha yesikhala unezakhiwo ezingaphezu kwezine ezivuliwe, noma ucindezela ubambe ukhiye we-🌐. Uhlu lubonisa izakhiwo zakho kusuka phezulu kuye phansi, futhi ukubamba ibha yesikhala kuyayinyusa futhi kuyayiyehlisa. I-Carousel ibabonisa eceleni, igxile kulowo othayipha kuwo, futhi ukubamba okufanayo kuyayihambisa kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, ngendlela ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala okuhamba ngayo kakade. Zombili zikuvumela ukuthi uthephe isakhiwo, futhi zombili zigcina Amanye amakhibhodi… ekugcineni.
Uhlu ongahudula kulo, noma i-carousel egcina ukuswayipha eceleni

IsiFulentshi sigcina isikhala phambi kophawu lokumemeza, uphawu lombuzo, i-semicolon, i-colon kanye ne-guillemet yokuvala, kanye nesikhala ngemuva kwe-guillemet yokuvula, kanjalo nesiBreton, isi-Occitan, isi-Walloon, isi-Picard, isi-Norman nesi-Franco-Provençal. Ikhibhodi ithayipha leso sikhala kuwe futhi ivimbele yonke eminye imithetho ukuthi ingasithathi. Kuyisikhala esingaphuli, ngakho uphawu alusoze lwasongeka emgqeni olandelayo lodwa. Uphawu kumele lulandele igama, inombolo noma ubakaki wokuvala, ngakho olulodwa ekuqaleni komugqa lushiywa lodwa. I-backspace eyodwa ngemuva nje isusa isikhala futhi. Zonke ezinye izilimi zithayipha njengakuqala. Ikhibhodi ishiya imikhakha ehleliwe yodwa: amaphasiwedi, amakheli e-imeyili, amakheli ewebhu, amaphedi ezinombolo namaphedi ocingo.

Uma ubuyela emuva ulungise igama ngesandla, ikhibhodi iyakhumbula ukuthi uthayipheni nokuthi ukushintshelephi. Lungisa iphutha elifanayo kabili bese ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kukwenzela lokho kulungisa kusukela lapho. Ngemuva kokulungisa okukodwa ikunikeza ukulungisa emgqeni esikhundleni salokho. Ikhibhodi iphinde ifunde iphutha elingemuva kokulungisa ngakunye, njengokushaya u-3 esikhundleni sika-e noma u-b esikhundleni sebha yesikhala, ukuze iphutha elifanayo kwamanye amagama liqondakale. Hlehlisa ukulungisa okufundiwe bese ikhibhodi iyayeka ukukwenza. Igama eliwigama langempela, njenge-form esikhundleni se-from, lishintsha kuphela ngemuva kokulungisa kathathu nalapho amagama akulo evumelana.
Amaphutha owalungisa ngesandla afundisa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo

Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ilungise igama elikufundile kuwe. Lokho kuvikela amagama akho nezinkulumo ezijwayelekile, kodwa futhi kusho ukuthi iphutha elilodwa olenzayo kanye livikelwe phakade. Khulisa lokhu ukuze wenze ikhibhodi ilinde ize ibone igama ngaphezu kwesikhathi esisodwa. Iziphakamiso azithinteki: igama elingaphansi kwalesi sibalo lingase lisaphakanyiswa, alivikelwe nje ekulungisweni. Lesi silungiselelo sisezingeni elilodwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki amathuba owabhala igama ngaphambi kokuba ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kukuyeke
Konke ukulungisa okufundisile kanye nakho konke ukushelela ikhibhodi ekubonile kukhohliwe. Amagama afundiwe nokulungiswa okungakenzeki akuthinteki.

resources.string: Akukho okufundiwe okwamanje. Lungisa iphutha lokuthayipha ngesandla bese umbhangqwana uvela lapha uma umbhalo usuzinzile.
Ukulungisa okufundise ikhibhodi, kanye namaphutha eyibonile

Ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kwakusetshenziselwa ukusebenzisa ukulungisa lapho umkhethiweyo ongcono edlula olandelayo ngefektha emisiwe. Isango elifundiwe likala konke ngesikhathi esisodwa: ukuthi umkhethiweyo uphambili kangakanani, hlobo luni lwephutha oluchaza ukuthayipha okungalungile, igama lide kangakanani, ukuthi amagama akho ayavumelana yini nohlu lwamagama, ukuthi imodeli yomongo icabangani, nokuthi uthayiphe ngokushesha kangakanani. Yakhelwe phezu kwezinkulungwane zemisho ethayiphiwe kanye namagama amasha athayiphiwe ngendlela efanele, ngakho-ke iyazibamba ekubhaleni kabusha amagama nezinkulumo ezijwayelekile kaningi. Isilayidi sokuzethemba sokulungisa okuzenzakalelayo sihambisa ibha yaso ngendlela efanayo. Ukucisha kusebenzisa ifektha emisiwe njengakuqala.
Hlola ukulungiswa ngakunye ngakho konke ikhibhodi ekwaziyo ngakho

Lapho ukubhala ngesandla kukhethiwe, ikhibhodi ifunda ukuswayipha phezu kwezikhi njengokubhala ngesandla. Dweba incwadi noma igama. Ngemuva kwekhefu elifushane ikhibhodi iyakubona lokho bese iyakubhala, futhi inikeza okunye ukufundwa emgqeni wesiphakamiso. Lokhu kudinga imodeli yokubhala ngesandla (Izilungiselelo → Ukubhala ngesandla). Ukucindezela okuvamile kusayithayipha ikhi yayo.
Dweba izinhlamvu phezu kwezinkinobho esikhundleni sokuthayipha ngokuslayida
Dweba incwadi noma igama phezu kwezinkinobho. Lokhu kudinga imodeli yokubhala ngesandla
Slayida umunwe wakho uye ekhiye oyifunayo. Lowo khiye kuphela oshaywayo uma uphakamisa umunwe
Ukuswayipha phezu kokhiye kupela igama elilodwa

Ukuthepha ngakunye kufundwa ngokumelene nalapho kuhlale khona, hhayi kuphela ngokumelene nokhiye okushaywe kuwo, ngakho ukuthepha eduze konqenqema lokhiye kungase kusafundwa njengokhiye olandelayo. Lokhu kubeka ukuthi lokho kufunda kunomusa kangakanani. Ngaphezu kuka-100%, ukuthepha ngaphakathi kokhiye onomakhelwane kusengukushelela okungenzeka, okufanele ukuthayipha okusheshayo noma okumatasa neminwe emikhulu. Ngaphansi kuka-100%, ukhiye owushayile uthenjwa kakhulu, okufanele ukuthayipha ngokucophelela. Kushintsha ukuthi yimaphi amagama umugqa owunikezayo nokuthi yini i-autocorrect ekhethayo. Okuzenzakalelayo ngu-100%.
Kude kangakanani ukhiye onomakhelwane lapho ukuthepha kungahlala khona futhi kusabalwa njengokushelela

Imodeli yolimi encane, elandiwe ngolimi lwakho, ifunda umusho owubhalile kuze kube manje futhi isho ukuthi yimaphi amagama okungenzeka alandelayo. Igcwalisa iziphakamiso zegama elilandelayo, isiza ukuhlela ukulungiswa, futhi isekela isango lokulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo elifundiwe. Isebenza kule divayisi futhi ayidingi nethiwekhi uma isilandiwe. Igama elingalazi, njengegama noma igama olifundise ikhibhodi, lishiyelwa kusichazamazwi sakho njengakuqala. Ukucisha lokhu akufundi fayela lemodeli.
Funda umusho wonke ukuze ubikezele futhi ubeke amagama ngokulandelana

Amagama kuphela angaziwa isichazamazwi abalwayo. Igama elivele likusichazamazwi lifundwa ngesikhathi ulibhala. Ukusetshenziswa kubalwa kuphela uma usudlule futhi walishiya igama, ngakho iphutha lokubhala obuyela emuva ulilungise alibalwa neze. Yehlisa lokhu uma amagama akho kanye nezinkulumo ezijwayelekile kuthatha isikhathi eside ukubambeka. Yibeke ku-1 ukuze ulondoloze igama elisha ngokushesha, okuyilokho okwakwenziwa izinguqulo ezindala. Lesi silungiselelo siba ku-3 ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki izikhathi lapho uthayipha igama elingaqashelwa muntu ngaphambi kokuba lilondolozwe

Njengoba umugqa wezinombolo ucishiwe, umugqa ongaphezulu wezinhlamvu ubonisa inombolo encane ekhoneni ngalinye. Uma zonke izinhlamvu zegama ozibhayo zihlala kulezo zinkinobho, umugqa unikeza inombolo lezo zinombolo ezizipela endaweni yazo yokugcina, eceleni kwamagama, futhi ukucindezela okukodwa kuyayibhala. Igama ngokwalo alikaze lishintshwe ngaphandle kokucindezela. Izinhlamvu ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ziyadingeka, ngakho u-I owodwa noma u-A owodwa uhlala uyigama. Inombolo yezinombolo ezinhlanu noma ngaphezulu ihlelwa ngezihlukanisi uma Ukuhlela izinombolo ezinde kuvuliwe, kusetshenziswa isitayela sayo sokuhlela. Akukho okuhlinzekwayo ngenkathi umugqa wezinombolo uboniswa, njengoba izinombolo ziba sezinkinobho zazo. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Thayipha u-qwe umugqa wezinombolo uvaliwe futhi umugqa uphinde unikeze u-123

Njengoba umugqa wezinombolo uvuliwe, ukuthepha okuhloselwe umugqa wezinhlamvu ophezulu kungahlala kudijithi, futhi i-as3 ivela esikhundleni se-ase. Nalesi silungiselelo sivuliwe, idijithi eyodwa ngaphakathi kwegama ingalungiswa ibe uhlamvu olungaphansi kwayo uma ucindezela isikhala. Ukulungiswa kushintsha kuphela idijithi ibe uhlamvu. Igama eliqala ngedijithi, negama elinezidijithi ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, alishintshi neze. Lesi silungiselelo sisebenza kuphela ngenkathi umugqa wezinombolo uboniswa.
Lungisa idijithi edukile uye encwadini engaphansi kwayo

Ku-3 noma ku-4 amagama kuphela ikhibhodi eqiniseka ngawo avela, okuyindlela i-BlackBerry eyenza ngayo, futhi ibhodi livame ukuhlala lingenalutho. Amanani aphezulu agcwalisa okhiye abaningi, futhi ngemva kuka-9 ikhibhodi ibheka igama lakho konke ukhiye engakwazi, okuyindlela ikhibhodi ye-Octopus eyenza ngayo. Ibhodi alikaze libonise igama elingakwazi ukulingana; ukhiye omncane kakhulu wegama ushiywa ungenalutho.
Mangaki amagama angahlala okhiye ngesikhathi esisodwa

Ikhibhodi ibhala igama elincane ngaphezu kwenkinobho elizoqhubeka negama olithayiphayo. Ngokuthayipha \"hel\", \"hello\" ihlala phezu kuka-l, \"help\" phezu kuka-p. Swayiphela phezulu kuleyo nkinobho, noma uthephe igama uqobo, bese lonke igama liyabhalwa. Ngemuva kwesikhala, ikhibhodi inikeza amagama alandelayo aphelele ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu zawo zokuqala esikhundleni salokho. Umugqa weziphakamiso uyaqhubeka nokusebenza njengakuqala; lokhu kwengeza kuphela kuwo. I-BlackBerry Z10 ithayiphe ngale ndlela, futhi yilokho ikhibhodi ye-Octopus ekukopishe.
Intanta igama elibikezelwe phezu kokhiye ozowucindezela ngokulandelayo

Flick phezulu ukusuka ekhiye ephethe igama bese lonke igama libhalwa. Okubalulekile yisiqondiso, hhayi isivinini: unhlangothi kufanele luye phezulu, futhi luye lapho luqonde kahle. Unhlangothi olutshekile noma olugobile luphathwa njengesiqalo sokuslayida esikhundleni salokho. I-flick ephuthelwayo imane ithayiphe uhlamvu. Ngamagama akhiye avuliwe, ukuslayida okuqala kuqonde phezulu ukusuka ekhiye ephethe eyodwa kunzima ukuqala; lokho ukuhweba.
Ukuthinta okusheshayo phezulu kukhiye kubhala igama lawo

Umugqa nomunwe onganyakazi ufuna izinto ezahlukene ezikhiye, ngakho ukuswayipha kunempendulo yako lapha futhi Okungase kuvele kushiywe ukusho ukuthi igama elithayiphiwe linganikeza ini. Akukho okugcina ibhodi lingenalutho uze uphakamise, okuyilokho okufunwa iningi labathayiphi abaswayiphayo: phakathi nokuswayipha ukuqedela akukwazi ukuthathwa futhi ukulungiswa akukwazi ukwahlulelwa. Okunye ukufunda kukhombisa ezinye izinketho ikhibhodi esazibambile, ngayinye ngaphezu kwesikhiye esiyifinyelelayo, ukuze ukwazi ukuqondisa kwenye. Igama elilandelayo linikeza lokho okungalandela igama olidwebayo, ngaphezu kwesikhiye eliqala ngaso, ukuze likwazi ukuflikwa ngesikhathi ukuswayipha kuphela. Noma yikuphi okukhethayo, ukuphakamisa umunwe wakho kubeka igama elilandelayo ezikhiyeni njengenjwayelo.

Uhlamvu oluncane ekhoneni eliphezulu lokhiye kanye negama elintantayo ziseduze ngokwanele ukuba zifundwe njengento eyodwa. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukhiye obonisa igama ufihla iseluleko sawo sekhona isikhathi eside njengoba igama likhona; okhiye abangenalutho abazokusho bagcina okwabo.
Inkinobho ephethe igama ilahla iseluleko sayo sokucindezela isikhathi eside

Ukuqedela kuqhubeka negama olithayiphayo. Izilungiso ziyalilungisa, futhi zihlala phezu kokhiye lapho igama liyeka khona ukufana nalokho okuthayiphile, ngakho zidwetshwa ngombala ohlukile. Amagama alandelayo avela ngemva kwesikhala, ngaphezu kwezinhlamvu zawo zokuqala, ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe noma yini. Ukucisha zontathu kushiya okhiye bengenalutho, okufana nokucisha sonke isici.

Ivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Igama elintantayo phezu kokhiye lithembisa ukuthi ukucindezela lowo khiye kubhala ingxenye elandelayo yalo, futhi uhlamvu ongalufinyelela kuphela ngokubamba ukhiye luyasiphula leso sithembiso. Ukuyivula lokhu kufinyelela amagama amaningi, ngenani lokuthi okhiye abathile banikeza igama elingeke liqedwe ngokucindezela nje.
Vumela amagama adinga ukucindezelwa isikhathi eside ukuze afinyelele uhlamvu lwawo olulandelayo

Ngenhla kwenkinobho kubeka igama ngalinye esikhaleni esingaphezu kwenkinobho yalo, ingxenye isenkinobheni kanti ingxenye ingaphezulu kwayo, futhi ikhibhodi ihlala inobude obufanayo. Umzila wami unika umugqa ngamunye umzila wawo ukuze kungabikho okugqagqana nanoma yini, futhi ikhibhodi ikhula kancane. Ngaphakathi kwenkinobho kubhala igama phezu kohlamvu, okungagqagqani kodwa kushiya kokubili indawo encane kakhulu.
Ngaphezu kokhiye, emzileni wawo, noma ngaphakathi kokhiye

Isilungiselelo ngasinye siwumumo onjengekhoni ozungeze phezulu, nokuthi umnyakazo kufanele uqonde kangakanani. Okunzima kudinga ukuswayipha okuqonde ngqo, okuyilokho okufunayo uma uswayipha kakhulu futhi uthola ukuthi ukuswayipha kwakho kuthathwa njengokukhetha. Okukhululekile kwamukela cishe noma yini eya phezulu, emabhodini lapho amagama ebaluleke kakhulu kunezwayipho. Okulinganiselayo kuphakathi kwakho kokubili.
Kude kangakanani ukushelela okungase kuthambekele phezulu futhi kusakwazi ukukhetha

Isiphindaphindi sosayizi amacebiso amancane ekhona awusebenzisayo. Amagama amakhulu kulula ukuwafunda kodwa agqagqana nomakhelwane bawo ngokushesha, futhi igama elingasalingani phezu kokhiye walo liyalahlwa esikhundleni sokufushaniswa ngaphezu kokufunda.

Igama elilodwa kukhiye ngamunye yikho okudwetshwe amakhibhodi e-BlackBerry ne-Octopus, futhi yikho konke okulingana kukhiye wosayizi wefoni. Kuthebhulethi izinkinobho zinde ngokwanele ezimbili noma ezintathu, zibekwe kude nokhiye onegama elingase libe yilo eliseduze kakhulu. Ukuswayiphela phezulu kuthatha igama eliseduze; ukuthepha kuthatha igama olithintayo. Mangaki amagama asakhawulela ikhibhodi yonke.
Mangaki amagama angathwalwa ukhiye owodwa, ebekwe ngokulandelana

Thepha ngqo egameni elintantayo ukuze ulibhale. Lokhu kulula ukukuthola kunokuflick, kodwa amagama angamalitshe amancane. Amagama emugqeni ongaphezulu alenga kancane ngaphezu kwekhibhodi, futhi ingxenye kuphela engaphezu kokhiye engathintwa; i-flick isebenza kuwo wonke.
Ivaliwe ngenkathi ukuthayipha ngeminwe emibili kuvuliwe

Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kufanele kuqiniseke cishe ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuba kushintshe igama ngokwalo, ngoba ukwenza iphutha kulokho kubhala kabusha lokho obukubhalile futhi kungenzeka ungakuqapheli. Konke okungaphansi kokuqiniseka kwakulahliwa, ngisho nalapho kungenzeka ukuthi bekulungile. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, lokho kuvela njengethiphu ekuqaleni komugqa weziphakamiso. Thepha ukuze usebenzise ukulungisa, noma uqhubeke uthayipha bese kuyanyamalala. Ukulungisa osuvele ukuhlehlisile kanye akusoze kwanikezwa. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi kuvela kuphela lapho bekungekho lutho olwenzekayo.
Bonisa ithiphu yokulungisa okwakuseduze, esikhundleni sokuyilahla
I-chip ayikakwazi ukubona amakhodi afikayo. Cindezela ukuze uvule isishintshi sesistimu

Ikhibhodi ibheka izaziso ezingenayo ukuze ithole ikhodi yesikhathi esisodwa. Uma ithola eyodwa, i-chip enekhodi negama lohlelo lokusebenza oluyithumele ivela ngaphezu kwezikhiye. Cindezela i-chip ukuze uthayiphe ikhodi. Lokhu kudinga ukufinyelela kwesaziso. Ikhibhodi ifunda izaziso kudivayisi yakho kuphela, igcina ikhodi kwimemori kuphela, futhi ayithumeli lutho ndawo. Vala lokhu futhi ikhibhodi iyayeka ukufunda izaziso ngaso leso sikhathi.
Lapho ikhodi yokuqinisekisa ifika kwisaziso, yiphakamise ngaphezu kwezikhiye. Ukucindezela okukodwa kuyayithayipha

Ibhokisi lekhodi ngokuvamile licela ikhiphedi yezinombolo, noma lizibiza ngokuthi \"OTP\", \"PIN\" noma \"ikhodi yokuqinisekisa\". Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, i-chip ibonakala lapho kuphela hhayi kwenye indawo. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza azinikezi ibhokisi lekhodi, futhi i-chip ayikwazi ukulithola — kushiye lokhu kuvaliwe futhi ikhodi izonikezwa kunoma yimuphi umkhakha ngenkathi isasebenza.
Bonisa i-chip kuphela lapho uhlelo lokusebenza lucela ikhodi, esikhundleni sokuba kuyo yonke imikhakha

Ikhodi esetshenzisiwe ayinasizathu sokuhlala ethunzini. Ngemva kokuba i-chip ithayiphe ikhodi, ikhibhodi iyasusa isaziso evela kuso. Lokhu kusebenzisa ukufinyelela kwesaziso okufanayo. Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zithumela ikhodi yazo futhi ngemva kokususwa; cisha lokhu uma lokho kukukhathaza.
Chitha isaziso sekhodi ngemva kokuba ithiphu isithayiphile

Izinhlelo zokusebenza namawebhusayithi amaningi ahlukanisa ikhodi emgqeni wamabhokisi amancane, uhlamvu olulodwa ngalinye, bese edlulela ebhokisini elilandelayo. Ikhodi ephelele ethunyelwe ngesikhathi esisodwa ingena ebhokisini lokuqala, eligcina uhlamvu olulodwa bese lilahla okunye. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ikhibhodi ithayipha ikhodi uhlamvu ngalunye, ukuze ibhokisi ngalinye lithole elalo. Lokhu kusebenza kumakhodi avela ezazisweni nakumakhodi ananyathiselwe kusuka kubhodi lokunamathisela.
Kuma-fomu anikeza uhlamvu ngalunye lwekhodi ibhokisi lalo
Ukuchofoza okufushane ezikhiyeni, ukuswayipha ngomunwe kanye nama-chords
Swayipha phezu kwezinhlamvu ukuze uthayiphe igama, nokuthi ukuswayipha kufundwa kanjani
Ukuswayipha, ukucindezela nokubamba, kanye nalokho okuboniswa ukhiye
Buyekeza, susa noma engeza amagama afundwe ikhibhodi

Ngemva kwesikhala, umugqa ungaphakamisa amagama amabili noma amathathu ngesikhathi esisodwa, uma imodeli yomongo iqinisekile ngawo wonke. Thepha i-chip ukuze uwathayiphe wonke. Idinga imodeli yomongo.
Nikeza amagama ambalwa alandelayo njenge-chip eyodwa
Slayida kusuka kukhiye wokhefana uye ku-s. Ukucindezela kusathayipha ukhefana

Khetha ukhiye lapha. Ukuswayipha okufushane nokuqondile ukusuka kulowo khiye kuya kokhiye u-s kwengeza u-\'s egameni elingaphambi kwekhesa, ngakho \"developer\" iba \"developer\'s\". Lokhu kusebenza ngemva kokuba uthayiphe igama nangemva kokuba uswayiphe elilodwa, ngokuthayipha okuswayiphelwayo kuvuliwe noma kuvaliwe. Isikhala ngemva kwegama sihamba ngemva kuka-\'s. Ukhiye usathayipha uhlamvu lwawo uma uwucindezela. Ukuswayipha kufanele kube kufushane futhi kuqonde. Indlela ende esuka kulowo khiye ofanayo iye ku-s iwukuswayipha, njengakuqala. Lokhu kusebenza ngesiNgisi kuphela. Ibha yesikhala ayikwazi ukuqala lokhu kuswayipha.
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wokukhomba uye ku-s, lapho isakhiwo sinokukodwa
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wesikhathi uye ku-s. Ukucindezela kusathayipha isikhathi
Swayipha kusuka kukhiye wokumisa amagama uye ku-s ukuze ungeze u-\'s egameni lokugcina

Umuntu ozongenela okhethweni ongcono kakhulu, lowo okhethwa ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, uya phakathi nomugqa. Umuntu ozongenela okhethweni wesibili uya kwesobunxele sakhe. Izikhibhodi eziningi zisebenzisa lesi sakhiwo. Vala lokhu ukuze uhlele abazongenela okhethweni kusuka kwesobunxele kuye kwesokudla.
Bonisa umuntu ozongenela okhethweni ongcono kakhulu endaweni ephakathi
Uphawu olulodwa ngohlamvu, ngokulandelana okufunayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uthole . , ? ! \'

Ikhibhodi yengeza umugqa omfushane wezimpawu zokuloba ezivamile ekupheleni komugqa weziphakamiso ngenkathi amagama ashiwo evela. Isikhathi noma ukhefana kutholakala ngokucindezela kanye, ngaphandle koshintsho kusakhiwo sezimpawu. Ukucindezela kusebenza ngokufanayo nokhiye. Lapho ikhibhodi inikeza isibikezelo se-emoji, i-emoji ithatha ukuphela komugqa esikhundleni salokho.
Izinketho ze-. , ? ! kanye no-\' eceleni kwamagama aphakanyisiwe

Isisindo esifundiwe sihlela ukubala okufanayo okuboniswa isichazamazwi somuntu siqu: ukuthi ikhibhodi icabanga ukuthi ulithayiphe kangaki igama. Ayikwazi ukuphusha igama ngaphansi kwe-oda lohlu lwamagama, futhi 0 ikhohlwa igama. Ukulungiswa kwezinga kugcina ukulungiselelwa okuhlukile phezulu noma phansi kwegama okusebenza phezu kwayo yonke imigqa, ngakho noma yiliphi igama lingahamba nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokushintsha lokho ikhibhodi ekufundile. Isisindo esifundiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ihambisa igama phezulu noma phansi emgqeni, noma ngabe livela kuliphi uhlu
Lokho okuhlelwa ukulawulwa kwezinga lekhadi legama
Ishintsha ukuthi isichazamazwi somuntu siwubona kangaki umusho owubhalile

Amagama amabili owabhalile okugcina ahlala kwesobunxele somugqa weziphakamiso, elisha kakhulu kwesokudla. Thepha elilodwa ukuze ubone ukuthi yini enye ebingaba yiyo: okunye ukufundwa kokuswayipha kwayo, ukulungiswa kwesichazamazwi, kanye nesipelingi ebesinayo ngaphambi kokuba usishintshe kusuka lapha. Khetha elilodwa futhi lelo gama kuphela elishintshayo, lapho limi khona; igama olithayiphayo kanye nesikhombisi kuhlala endaweni. Kushiywa ngaphandle ezinkundleni zephasiwedi naku-incognito, futhi kuqala kungenalutho kuyo yonke inkundla entsha. Kuthatha indawo eziphakamisweni ngenkathi kukhona amagama asanda kubhalwa okufanele aboniswe.
Amagama akho amabili okugcina ekuqaleni komugqa, ukuze ukwazi ukulungisa elilodwa ngemva kokuba usulithayiphile

Amagama okuxoxa afana ne-lol ne-gonna azoba sezingeni eliphezulu kancane ezinhlelweni zokuthumela imiyalezo, futhi aphansi kancane ezinhlelweni ze-imeyili nasezinkundleni ze-imeyili. Lokhu kuhlela kabusha iziphakamiso kuphela. Alikho igama elifihliwe noma elivinjiwe, futhi ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo akushintshi.
Amagama ajwayelekile abaluleke kakhulu ezingxoxweni, kanti abaluleke kancane kuma-imeyili

Izinkambu zokuxoxa nokusesha zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi u-Enter usho ukuthumela, hamba noma sesha. Ngokuvamile awukwazi ukubeka ikhefu lomugqa emlayezo ngaphandle kokuwuthumela. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, cindezela u-shift kuqala, noma ubambe u-shift kukhibhodi engokomzimba, futhi u-Enter uthayipha umugqa omusha wangempela. Ukhiye u-Enter ubonisa uphawu lomugqa omusha ngenkathi u-shift ehlomile, ukuze ubone umphumela ngaphambi kokuba uwucindezele. U-shift owucindezela wena kuphela obalwayo. Ikhibhodi ayinaki u-shift izinhlamvu ezinkulu ezizenzakalelayo ezihlome ekuqaleni komlayezo, ngakho umugqa wokuqala womlayezo usathunyelwa. Ikhibhodi iphinde inganaki ukhiye we-caps lock. Lolu hlelo luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngoba ukuziphatha okujwayelekile ukulandela isenzo sika-Enter sohlelo lokusebenza.
Engeza ikhefu lomugqa kuhlelo lokusebenza lwengxoxo esikhundleni sokuthumela umlayezo

Ukulayida igama bekusho ukuma ukuze uthephe u-Shift kuqala, okuyinto ephazamisa ukubhala. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, dweba ngokusebenzisa ukhiye u-Shift endleleni yakho bese igama liphuma linezinhlamvu ezinkulu; liwele kabili bese lonke igama liba nezinhlamvu ezinkulu. Ukhiye kufanele uwelwe ngempela, futhi ingxenye yawo yendlela iyanakwa uma igama lifundwa, ngakho ukuchezuka akungezi nhlamvu.
Dweba ngokhiye we-Shift phakathi nokuswayipha ukuze uthole uhlamvu olukhulu
Slayida phezu kuka-Shift ukuze wenze izinhlamvu ezinkulu

Igama lonke: ukudlula okukodwa kwenza igama libe nosonhlamvukazi futhi ukudlula kwesibili kwenza konke kube nosonhlamvukazi. Uhlamvu olulodwa: ukudlula ngakunye phezu kuka-Shift kwenza uhlamvu owusuka kulo lube nosonhlamvukazi, ngakho ukushaya kungabhala u-HeLLo noma u-LeanType, futhi ukuqeda ukushaya kukhiye ka-Shift kwenza igama lonke libe nosonhlamvukazi ohambweni olulodwa.
Igama lonke, noma uhlamvu osusanda kusuka kulo

Beka isikhombisi egameni noma ngemva kwalo bese ucindezela u-shift. Igama lishintsha phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezincane, ezinkulu ekuqaleni, nezinhlamvu ezinkulu, kanti isikhombisi sihlala lapho sikhona. Lokhu kusebenza njengaku-SwiftKey. Ngenkathi uthayipha igama, u-shift usasebenza njengohlamvu olulandelayo. Uma isikhombisi singathinti gama, u-shift usebenza njengokujwayelekile.
Uma kungekho okukhethiwe, u-shift ushintsha igama elithintwa yisikhombisi
I-Shift ishintsha usayizi wezinhlamvu zegama elikukhombisi

Uma ukhetha umbhalo bese ucindezela u-shift, ikhibhodi ishintsha usayizi wohlamvu lokukhethiwe. Ayiwuvuli u-shift ohlamvini olulandelayo. Ukucindezela ngakunye kudlula ezinhlamvini ezincane, Usayizi Wesihloko kanye nezinhlamvu EZINKULU. Akukho okushintshayo ezinhlelweni ezingenazo izinhlamvu ezinkulu/ezincane, njengesi-Bengali. Vala lokhu ukuze ugcine u-shift ohlamvini olulandelayo kuphela, ngisho nalapho umbhalo ukhethiwe.

Beka isikhombisi ngaphakathi kwegama, njengaku-\"cur|sor\", bese ucindezela u-shift. Lonke igama lidlula ezinhlamvini ezincane, Usayizi Wegama kanye nezinhlamvu EZINKULU, okufana negama elingaphambi kwesikhombisi. Cishe lokhu ukuze ugcine u-shift uhlamvu olukhulu phakathi nenkulumo.
Uma kungekho okukhethiwe, u-shift ushintsha igama eliphakathi nendawo yesikhombisi
I-Shift ishintsha usayizi wezinhlamvu zegama elizungeze isikhombisi
Ukushintsha umbhalo okhethiwe kuhlanganisa izinhlamvu ezincane, Izinhlamvu Ezinkulu Ekuqaleni namagama aphelele ngezinhlamvu EZINKULU

Ngokuvamile uthayipha ama-acronym, noma amagama anezinhlamvu ezinkulu ukuze ugcizelele, ngenhloso. Izibonelo: ASAP, OFC, NOOO. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo kushiya wonke amagama anezinhlamvu ezinkulu njengoba enjalo. Cisha lokhu ukuze ulungise lawa magama njenganoma yiliphi elinye igama.
Shiya amagama athayiphiwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu njengoba enjalo

Umugqa wesiphakamiso uvame ukugcina indawo eyodwa yegama njengoba ulithayiphile, okuyindlela ogcina ngayo isipelingi isichazamazwi esingasazi. Vula lokhu futhi leyo ndawo inikezwa esinye isiphakamiso esikhundleni salokho, ngakho zontathu zinikeza okuthile okusha. Izindleko wukuthi igama ikhibhodi engaliboni linendlela eyodwa encane yokusinda ekulungisweni, futhi umugqa awusakukhombisi ukuthi yimuphi umuntu oyinto ngqo oyibhalile.

Uma ithuluzi lingaphendula umbhalo owubhalile, umugqa wesiphakamiso unikeza impendulo esikhundleni samagama. Cindezela impendulo ukuze uthayiphe umphumela. Cindezela inkinobho engakwesokudla kwayo ukuze uvule ithuluzi eligcwele elinezinombolo ezifanayo kulo. Ikhibhodi ibona konke okudivayisi yakho. Ilanda kuphela amanani okushintshanisa, futhi kuphela ngemva kokuba uthayiphe inani ngemali ethile.
Phendula izibalo, ukuguqulwa kanye namagama angukhiye wamathuluzi emgqeni weziphakamiso

Thayipha igama eliphelele loxhumana naye, nganoma yiluphi uhlobo, noma igama lokuqala kuphela elinohlamvu olukhulu lapho kungekho omunye oxhumana naye onalelo gama lokuqala. Umugqa ube usukhombisa ishidi elinegama. Thepha igama ukuze uvule uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwefoni nenombolo egcwalisiwe. Thepha inkinobho yomlayezo ukuze uvule uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwemiyalezo. Ikhibhodi ayikaze yenze ucingo uqobo, futhi igama olithayiphile lihlala embhalweni. Igama ngalinye linikezwa kanye enkundleni ngayinye yombhalo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga ukufinyelela koxhumana nabo futhi sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Thayipha igama loxhumana naye bese umugqa unikeza ukushaya noma ukuthumela umyalezo kulowo muntu
Shayela noma uthumele umyalezo koxhumana naye
\"150 usd\", \"150$\" noma \"150 dollars\" inikeza inani ku-%1$s
\"ngoLwesihlanu oluzayo\" inikeza usuku oluwela kulo, nekhalenda elivulwe lapho

Njengoba uthayipha igama, uhlu lwamagama lubikezela izinhlamvu ezilandelayo. Ikhibhodi yenza indawo yokuthinta yokhiye ngamunye ibe nkulu kulezo zinhlamvu. Ukucindezela okufika ngaphakathi nje kokhiye olandelayo kusakunikeza uhlamvu obulufuna, kodwa eduze komphetho owabiwe kuphela. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ishintshe ukucindezela phakathi nendawo yokhiye. Lokhu kusebenza kusendlalelo sezinhlamvu kuphela, futhi kudinga ukuthi Iziphakamiso zivuliwe.
Hambisa ukucindezela emaphethelweni okhiye uye encwadini okungenzeka ukuthi ubuyifuna

Inkinobho esekupheleni kwesiketi ivula ithuluzi elinezinombolo zakho ezigcwalisiwe. Uma lokhu kucishiwe, inkinobho iphinde isuse umbhalo owuphendulwe isiketi, ngoba ithuluzi liyabhala umphumela walo esikhundleni sawo. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, umbhalo wakho uyahlala. Kunoma yikuphi, uma ithuluzi lingabhali lutho, inkinobho yokubuyela emuva yokuqala ngemuva kokuba uvale ithuluzi ibuyisela umbhalo osusiwe.
Inkinobho yezilungiselelo esesithombeni ishiya okubhalile, okufana no-150 usd noma ikhalkhuletha, embhalweni
Gcina umbhalo lapho ithiphu ivula ithuluzi layo
\"define serendipity\" inikeza isichazamazwi, \"who is Tesla\" inikeza i-Wikipedia
Landela ulimi oluthayiphwayo: I-South Asian ye-Bangla, isi-Hindi nezilimi eziseceleni kwazo, izinkulungwane kuyo yonke indawo
Amadijithi amathathu, bese kuba amabili: 12,34,567 kanye no-1,00,000

Inombolo enamadijithi amahlanu noma ngaphezulu, uma ithayiphiwe yodwa, inikezwa ngezihlukanisi. Izinombolo eziqala ngoziro ziyashiywa njengoba zinjalo, kanjalo nanoma yini ehlanganiswe nohlamvu, umugqa noma i-slash, ngoba lezo yizinombolo zocingo, izinsuku namakhodi kunokuba kube amanani.
Thayipha u-1234567 bese umugqa uwunikeza uqoqiwe. Ukucindezela okukodwa kuthayipha inombolo eqoqiwe
Mangaki amakhophi alandelanayo ngaphambi kokuba i-chip ibonakale

Thayipha igama, umusho noma umugqa bese uwuthayipha futhi, ngesikhala, ukhefana noma umugqa omusha phakathi, noma ungalutho phakathi, njenge-\"hahaha\". Uma usufinyelele inani elibekiwe, i-chip ikhombisa umbhalo onenani elikhuphukayo njengoba uqhubeka nokuthayipha. Thepha i-chip bese ithuluzi lokuphinda umbhalo livuleka kulowo mbhalo, nesihlukanisi esifanayo nenani elikhulu elilungele. Umbhalo owuthayiphile uhlala uze ucindezele okuthi Faka lapho, futhi izilungiselelo zethuluzi zisho ukuthi ngabe okuthi Faka kuthatha indawo yalawa makhophi noma kuyawengeza. Umbhalo ngamunye unikezwa kanye enkundleni ngayinye yombhalo. Uhlamvu olulodwa olweluliwe noma i-emoji ephindwe kabili ayibalwa, futhi i-chip ayiveli ezinkundleni zamaphasiwedi.
Thayipha into efanayo izikhathi ezimbalwa zilandelana bese umugqa unikeza ithuluzi lokuphinda umbhalo

I-Android System Intelligence ingafunda ingxoxo esesikrinini futhi inikeze izimpendulo ezimfushane, njengokuthi \"Ngisendleleni!\". Izimpendulo zivela njengamachips eceleni kweziphakamiso zamagama, kufika kwezintathu ngesikhathi. Uhlelo luzidweba, hhayi ikhibhodi. Ziza ngomzila ofanayo namachips omphathi wephasiwedi, kodwa ziyabalwa futhi zishintshe ngokuhlukile kuzo. Ungaba nokungena ngemvume okulondoloziwe emgqeni weziphakamiso ngaphandle kokuthi uhlelo lufunde imiyalezo yakho, noma okuphambene nalokho. Imodi ye-Incognito icisha lokhu ngokwayo. Lesi silungiselelo sidinga i-Android 11 noma entsha, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithile kuphela ezinikeza izimpendulo.
Vumela isistimu inikeze izimpendulo kumlayezo owuphendulayo

Ithuluzi ngalinye linamagama angukhiye ambalwa. Thayipha igama elilodwa elingukhiye uwedwa bese umugqa wesiphakamiso unikeza ukuvula lelo thuluzi futhi ususe igama olithayiphile. Izilungiselelo zethuluzi ngalinye zibala amagama alo angukhiye, lapho ungawashintsha khona noma uwasuse.
Thayipha \"wiki\" bese umugqa unikeza ithuba lokuvula i-Wikipedia
Ithuluzi u-%1$s licishiwe, ngakho lezi zinkomba azinayo inkinobho yokulivula
Ithuluzi %1$s licishiwe, ngakho ama-chip alo awabonakali
Amathuluzi %1$s kanye %2$s avaliwe, ngakho ama-chip awo awabonakali
\"will it rain\" ikhombisa isibikezelo sezulu emgqeni. Idinga indawo yesimo sezulu

Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ikhibhodi ithayipha isikhala ngemva kwegama elishelelayo, ukuze igama elilandelayo lingahlangani nalo. Ungashelela igama elilandelayo, noma ulithayiphe okhiye. Thayipha . , ? ! ; : noma ubakaki ovalayo ngokulandelayo, bese ikhibhodi isusa isikhala kuqala. Ukucindezela ibha yesikhala kubalwa njengesikhala esivele sikhona. I-Backspace isusa igama elishelelayo nesikhala salo ndawonye. Ikhibhodi ayengezi sikhala kuphasiwedi, ikheli le-imeyili, ikheli lewebhu, iphedi yezinombolo noma iphedi yefoni.
Engeza isikhala lapho uphakamisa umunwe wakho ekupheleni kokuslayida

Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma ucindezela isiphakamiso, ikhibhodi ithayipha igama nesikhala ngemva kwalo, ukuze igama elilandelayo liqale lihlanzekile. Sivala ukuze uthayiphe igama ngaphandle kwesikhala. Lokhu kusiza ezilimini noma ezinkundleni lapho isikhala ngemva kwegama ngokuvamile singalungile. Uma ubuyela egameni futhi uliqhuba, ikhibhodi ayikaze yengeze isikhala sesibili.
Engeza isikhala uma ukhetha igama emgqeni weziphakamiso

Lesi silungiselelo sishintsha ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kusebenze njenge-touchpad. Isikhombisi sihamba kwesobunxele nakwesokudla, futhi ukuswayiphela phezulu noma phansi kuhambisa isikhombisi phakathi kwemigqa. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ezenzweni zokuswayipha ezisethwe kokuthi \"Isikhombisi\" ngenhla.
Ukuhlephula kwesikhombisi nakho kuhamba phezulu naphansi

Ngemva kwebanga elifushane ngesivinini esijwayelekile sesikhombisi, uhlamvu ngalunye ludinga ukunyakaza okuncane. Isivinini siyanda size sifinyelele esivinini esiphezulu, futhi sihlala kuleso sivinini ngenkathi uqhubeka ohlangothini olufanayo. Uma ubuyela emuva, isivinini siqala futhi ngesivinini esijwayelekile, ukuze ukwazi ukulungisa ukudlula kude ngokunembile. Ngethouchpad yesikhombisi se-2-D, ukunyakaza phezulu naphansi nakho kwandisa isivinini ngendlela efanayo. Ukuswayipha okufushane kuhambisa uhlamvu olulodwa ngesikhathi, njengakuqala. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Lapho ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kuhamba kude, isikhombisi sihamba ngokushesha

Ukuswayipha kwebha yesikhala kuvame ukuhambisa isikhombisi ngokucindezela okhiye bomcibisholo wesobunxele nowesokudla, ngendlela ikhibhodi yehadiwe eyenza ngayo. Amanye amabhokisi okusesha afunda ukhiye womcibisholo njengesinyathelo ngokusebenzisa iziphakamiso zawo, futhi abanye abaphathi befayela babuyisela isikhombisi ekuqaleni kwegama ngemva kokukodwa. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, ukuswayipha kubeka isikhombisi ngokuqondile esikhundleni salokho, futhi akukho hlelo lokusebenza olubona ukucindezela ukhiye. Uhlelo lokusebenza kufanele lutshele ikhibhodi lapho isikhombisi salo sikhona ukuze lokhu kusebenze; uma kungenjalo, okhiye bomcibisholo basetshenziswa njengangaphambili. Ngetouchpad yesikhombisi engu-2-D ivuliwe, phezulu naphansi enkundleni yomugqa owodwa, njengebhokisi lokusesha, beka isikhombisi ekuqaleni noma ekupheleni kombhalo esikhundleni sokucindezela imicibisholo ephezulu naphansi. Enkundleni enemigqa eminingana ahlala engokhiye bomcibisholo, ngakho isikhombisi silandela ukusonga komugqa wohlelo lokusebenza. Imodi yokukhetha kanye nokushintsha okubanjwe njalo kusebenzisa okhiye bomcibisholo, okuyindlela abelula ngayo ukukhetha. Lolu hlelo luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Beka isikhombisi esikhundleni sokucindezela okhiye bomcibisholo

Ibha yesikhala imfushane kunomugqa omude wombhalo. Nalesi sethingi sivuliwe, ukuswayipha kwekhesa kuyaqhubeka ngokwako, cishe izinhlamvu eziyisishiyagalombili ngomzuzwana: ngokushesha lapho umunwe wakho udlula noma yimuphi umkhawulo webha yesikhala, nangemva kwekhefu elifushane lapho ubambe umunwe wakho unganyakazi kude nalapho ukuswayipha kwaqala khona. Hambisa umunwe wakho futhi, noma uwuphakamise, ukuze ume. Ukuswayipha okufushane nokulungiswa okuhle eduze kwalapho uqale khona akuthinteki. Lesi sethingi sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuswayipha kwekhesa okubanjwe kunganyakazi, noma okudlule ekupheleni kwebha yesikhala, kuyaqhubeka

Isikhulisi sikhombisa umugqa wombhalo ozungeze isikhombisi. Siya ngaphezu kwesikhombisi lapho uhlelo lokusebenza lutshela ikhibhodi ukuthi isikhombisi sikuphi. Uma uhlelo lokusebenza lungenzi njalo, siya ngaphezu kwekhibhodi. Ithuluzi le-trackpad linesilungiselelo esihlukile salokhu.
Bonisa umbhalo okusikhombisi, ube mkhulu, ngenkathi ukuhwaya kwebha yesikhala kuhambisa isikhombisi

Ibanga elincane lihambisa isikhombisi ngokushesha, ngakho ibha yesikhala emfushane isengawela umugqa omude. Elikhulu lizinzile uma amaslayidi akho ethambekele ekudluleleni. Lesi silungiselelo singu-16 dp ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuthi uslayida kude kangakanani kubha yesikhala ukuze uhambise uhlamvu olulodwa
Inani eliyindlela ephindwe kayingaki kunesivinini sekasari esijwayelekile lapho ikasari lifika ekupheleni kokuswayipha okude. Lesi silungiselelo singu-4× ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Indlela okusheshayo ngayo ukuhambisa kwesilayidi sesikhalazo eside i-cursor esivinini sayo esikhulu

Uma isikhala sokuhambisa isikhombisi siqala ukuhamba, ikhibhodi yonke iba yiphedi yayo yokuthinta. Okhiye bayafiphala, futhi ukubathinta ngomunye umunwe akuthayiphi lutho uze uphakamise. Uma ukuhambisa okuqhubekayo kuvuliwe, isikhombisi siyaqhubeka lapho umunwe wakho ufika ohlangothini lwekhibhodi esikhundleni sokuphela kwesikhala. Umunwe wakho ungahlala ushiya isikhala ngesikhathi sokuswayipha; lesi silungiselelo sivimbela abanye okhiye ukuthi bangasabeli ngenkathi kwenzeka lokho. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuswayipha kwesikhombisi kungasebenzisa ikhibhodi yonke, kanti ezinye izinkinobho ziyama

Gcina umunwe wakho phansi. Swayipha igama, swayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala, bese uswayipha igama elilandelayo. Ukunyakaza ngakunye kubhala igama nesikhala, ngakho ukunyakaza okukodwa kunikeza umusho ogcwele. Uma lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe, ukuswayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala kwenza igama elilodwa.
Swayipha phezu kwebha yesikhala ukuze uqhubeke negama elilandelayo

Thayipha izinhlamvu ozifunayo kubha yesikhala ngokucindezela isikhathi eside, nesikhala phakathi kwenhlamu ngayinye. Isibonelo: 🙂 ❤️ 👍. Ikhibhodi bese ibabonisa ku-popup uma ucindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala. Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ugcine ukucindezela isikhathi eside okujwayelekile, okuvula isikhethi solimi noma okuphinda izikhala.
Okhiye bokucindezela isikhathi eside kubha yesikhala

Ngezakhiwo ezine noma ngaphansi, ukubamba ibha yesikhala kukhombisa ukubuka kuqala okuseceleni ngaphezulu kwayo, futhi ukuhudula kudlula ezakhiweni zakho. Ngaphezu kwezine, ukubamba kuvula isikhethi esikhundleni salokho, njengohlu noma i-carousel. Cisha lokhu ukuze ugcine ukubuka kuqala okuseceleni kungakhathaleki ukuthi zingaki izakhiwo ezivuliwe. Ikhombisa ezinhlanu ngesikhathi futhi islayida njengoba uhudula, ngakho zonke izakhiwo zisatholakala. Ukucindezela isikhathi eside ukhiye we-🌐 kusavula isikhethi. Uma ukuhwaya okusheshayo kungasethwanga ku-Ulimi, ukubamba kuvula isikhethi nganoma yibuphi ubude.
Bamba inkinobho yesikhala (spacebar) ukuze uvule isikhi ngesikhathi kukhona izakhiwo ezingaphezu kwezine

Cindezela uphinde ubambe ibha yesikhala ngemuva kokulibaziseka kokubamba, bese uswayipha. Lokhu kunika ibha yesikhala isenzo sesibili nesihlukile sokuswayipha. Isibonelo: ukuswayipha ngokushesha kushintsha ulimi, nokucindezela nokubamba ngokuswayipha kuhambisa isikhombi. Ungaphinda usethe kokubili ukuba kwenze isenzo esifanayo.
Cindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala, bese uswayipha

Slayida kwesobunxele noma kwesokudla kubha yesikhala ngaphandle kokuphumula. \"Ulimi\" luhamba ngezindlela zakho zokufaka, ngokubuka kuqala okubukhoma ngaphezu kwebha yesikhala. Phakamisa umunwe wakho ukuze ushintshe. Cindezela ubambe ibha yesikhala ukuze ubonise isikhethi ngaphambi kokuslayida. \"Isikhombisi\" sihambisa isikhombisi sombhalo uhlamvu olulodwa ngesinyathelo ngasinye. Ukucindezela ngaphandle kokunyakaza kuhlale kuthayipha isikhala.

Swayiphela phansi ngqo kubha yesikhala (spacebar) ukuze uvale ikhibhodi. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngakho ukuswayipha phansi ngephutha akusoze kwavala ikhibhodi. Uma i-touchpad yekhesa ye-2-D ivuliwe, ukuswayipha phansi kuhambisa ikhesa esikhundleni salokho. I-touchpad inokubaluleka kokuqala.
Ukuswayipha phansi kubha yesikhala kuvala ikhibhodi
Vula uhlu lwezinhlelo zokusebenza zekhibhodi ze-Android, ukuze ushintshele kuhlelo lokusebenza lwekhibhodi ehlukile. Kusilungiselelo sokucindezela nokubamba, ukubamba kuphela kuyakuvula.

Swayiphela phezulu kusuka kubha yesikhala, nganoma yisiphi isivinini, bese ikhiphedi yezinombolo ivuleka, ngendlela i-SwiftKey eyenza ngayo. Ukuswayipha kufanele kuqale kancane phezulu, ngakho ukuthepha okuslayida kancane kusathayipha isikhala. Ukuswayipha eceleni kugcina izenzo ezibekwe ngenhla. Uma ukuswayiphela phezulu kwephedi yokuthinta kuvuliwe futhi, iphedi yokuthinta iyawina. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuswayipha phezulu kusuka kubha yesikhala kuvula iphedi yezinombolo
Swayiphela phezulu ukuze uthole iphedi yezinombolo

Swayipha phezulu usuka kubha yesikhala, bese ubamba umunwe wakho phansi uwuhambise: isikhombisi silandela kwesobunxele, kwesokudla, phezulu naphansi, njenge-touchpad yesikhombisi se-2-D, uze uphakamise umunwe. Ukuswayipha kumele kuqale kancane phezulu, ngakho ukuthepha okushelelayo kancane kusabhalela isikhala. Ukuswayipha eceleni kugcina izenzo ezibekwe ngenhla, ngakho ukuswayipha okusheshayo kusengashintsha ulimi futhi akudingeki ubambe ibha yesikhala kuqala. Uma i-Keep moving while held kanye ne-Whole keyboard as touchpad zombili zivuliwe, isikhombisi siyaqhubeka lapho umunwe wakho ufika kunoma yimuphi umphetho wekhibhodi: izinhlangothi zikuhambisa emgqeni, phezulu naphansi zikuhambisa phakathi kwemigqa. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuhlephula phezulu kusuka kubha yesikhala kuhambisa isikhombisi kuzo zonke izinkomba

Ulimi lubonisa igama lolimi lwamanje. Isakhiwo sibonisa igama lesakhiwo samanje. Zombili zibonisa \"Ulimi (Isakhiwo)\". Uma ulimi olulodwa lunokwedlula isakhiwo esisodwa, ikhibhodi yengeza igama lesakhiwo, ukuze ubone umehluko.

Ikhibhodi idweba u-◀ no-▶ omncane ohlangothini ngalunye lwegama lolimi kubha yesikhala. Ayisikiselo nje, futhi ukuswayipha kusebenza ngaphandle kwawo. Ahlala efihliwe ngenkathi imodi eyodwa yokufaka ivuliwe.

Ibha yesikhala ikhombisa ukuthi ubatayiphe ngokushesha kangakanani amagama akho ambalwa okugcina, eduze nelebuli yayo. Inombolo iyashintsha njalo uma igama lingena, futhi amagama atayipiwe, akhethiwe, ashushudiziwe namagama ayisithupha abalwa wonke. Ngemuva kwekhefu lemizuzwana emi-5, ibha yesikhala ikhombisa ilebuli yayo futhi kuphela. Ikhibhodi ayigcini mlando wale nombolo. Isebenza uma izibalo (Statistics) zivaliwe kanye nakwimodi yokungaziwa (incognito).
Bonisa amagama akho ngomzuzu ngenkathi uthayipha
Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze ugcine ilebula yebha yesikhala evamile. Thayipha u-%1$s ukuze ubeke leyo lebula embhalweni wakho. Isibonelo: ~ %1$s ~

Kwesinye isikhathi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kushintsha igama, ususe ushintsho bese uthayipha igama lakho futhi, bese ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo kushintsha futhi. Lesi silungiselelo siqeda lowo mjikelezo. Njalo uma uhlehlisa ukulungiswa noma ukususa, ikhibhodi ibala ukwenqaba okukodwa kwalelo gama kuleyo ndawo. Uma ukubala kufinyelela kule nombolo, igama olithayiphayo lapho lihlala njengoba ulihayiphile, futhi ikhibhodi ayinikezi ukulungiswa emgqeni futhi. Leyo ndawo eyodwa kuphela kuleyo nsimu yombhalo ethintekayo. Iphutha elifanayo noma kuphi okunye lisalungiswa, futhi ukubala kuphelile uma ushiya insimu. Akusoze kwacisha lokhu.
Yiyeke igama uma usulihlehlisile noma usulisusile ukulungiswa kwalo izikhathi eziningi kangaka

Mangaki ama-emoji aphakanyisiwe angalandela amagama emgqeni, kusuka kwelilodwa kuye kwamane. Okune kuyinto ezenzakalelayo. Ngenkathi i-emoji ithatha indawo, indawo iphethe eyodwa, noma ngabe lokhu kuthini. Iziphakamiso ze-emoji zivulwa futhi zicishwe ngaphansi kwe-Emoji.

Ama-emoji aphakanyisiwe ngokuvamile avela ngemva kwamagama, afika kwamane, ngaphezu kwenani leziphakamiso. Ngalolu hlelo luvuliwe, i-emoji engcono kakhulu ithatha indawo yokugcina kanti amagama athola elilodwa elincane, ngakho umugqa awusoze wabonisa okungaphezu kwenani leziphakamiso. Iziphakamiso ze-emoji zivulwa futhi zicishwe ngaphansi kwe-Emoji. Lolu hlelo lucishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Hlela iziphakamiso ezengeziwe emakholomu, elilodwa kunsiza ngayinye yokuphakamisa

Ngokuvamile amagama abelana ngomugqa phakathi kwawo: amagama amabili awuhlukanisa phakathi, futhi i-emoji, umugqa wezimpawu zokuloba noma ithuluzi lishaya amagama eceleni ukuze kwenziwe indawo. Ngalolu hlelo oluvuliwe, umugqa uhlale usikwa ube inani leziphakamiso, isikhala ngasinye sibe nobubanzi obufanayo, futhi isikhala esingenalutho esizokhonjiswa sihlala singenalutho. Igama elihle kakhulu ligcina isikhala elihlale linaso. Noma yini engeyona igama ithatha isikhala sayo: i-emoji ephakanyisiwe noma izimpawu zokuloba isikhala sokugcina, ithuluzi lokuqala. Lolu hlelo luvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Izikhala ezinobubanzi obufanayo, futhi igama elihle kakhulu alikaze linyakaze

Uma umugqa upheqa futhi ikhibhodi ithola amagama amaningi kunalawo angalingana, umkhonto ekupheleni kwawo kwesokudla uvula wonke kugridi. Cisha lokhu ukuze ubuyisele leso sikhala emagameni. Ukuswayiphela phansi emugqeni kusavula igridi efanayo. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Umkhonto ekupheleni komugqa ovula wonke amagama atholiwe

Okokuqala, igama elide liyancipha ukuze lingene endaweni yalo. Uma lisemide kakhulu, ikhibhodi isusa ezinye izinhlamvu bese ibonisa amachashazi (…) esikhundleni sazo. Phakathi kugcina isiqalo nesiphetho segama, isibonelo \"Punct…tion\". Amakhibhodi amaningi enza lokhu. Ekugcineni kugcina isiqalo kuphela, isibonelo \"Punctuat…\". Lesi silungiselelo asinawo umphumela ngenkathi Ukuskrola iziphakamiso kuvuliwe, ngoba igama ngalinye ligcina usayizi walo ogcwele.
Lapho ungasika khona igama elingalingani esikhaleni salo
Ngemuva kwamagama, ama-emoji ahambisana negama olibhalayo
Okokugcina, igama ngesitayela sombhalo esihle, ongakhetha ngendlela elibukeka ngayo

Umugqa ubonisa amagama ambalwa kuphela. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, swayiphela phansi kuwo ngenkathi unamagama bese igridi yeziphakamiso ezingafika ku-24 imboza okhiye, okuhle kakhulu kuqala. Thepha okukodwa ukuze ukusebenzise, noma swayipha umugqa futhi noma thepha okuthi Buyela kokhiye ukuze uvale igridi. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, ukuswayipha phansi phezu kweziphakamiso kuvula igridi esikhundleni sokufihla ikhibhodi; phezu komugqa ongenalutho kusayifihla uma leso silungiselelo sivuliwe. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Swayiphela phansi eziphakamisweni ukuze ubone wonke amagama ikhibhodi ewahlukanisile
Swayiphela phansi ukuze uthole iziphakamiso ezengeziwe

Ngokuvamile umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ngokulinganayo futhi unciphise amagama amade ukuze alingane nesikhala sawo. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, wonke amagama agcina usayizi wawo wemvelo futhi umugqa upheqa eceleni esikhundleni salokho. Amagama amafushane asagcwalisa umugqa njengakuqala, ngakho akukho okushintshayo kuze kube yilapho igama lidlula umkhawulo. Yivule uma ufuna iziphakamiso ezinhlanu noma eziyisithupha ocingweni oluncane. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Bonisa igama ngalinye ngosayizi ogcwele bese upheqa umugqa eceleni uma lingalingani

Umugqa uhlukanisa ububanzi bawo ngokulinganayo phakathi kweziphakamiso, ngakho-ke okuningi kwazo kusho ukuthi ngasinye sincane futhi amagama amade ancishiswa kakhulu ukuze alingane. Okuthathu kufanele ifoni. Ithebhulethi noma isikrini se-landscape sinendawo eyengeziwe. Lesi silungiselelo singu-3 ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Mangaki amagama umugqa wesiphakamiso owakhombisayo ngesikhathi esisodwa

Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, swayiphela phezulu emgqeni ngenkathi unamagama futhi iziphakamiso ezengeziwe ezingafika ku-12 zivuleka ngenhla nje kwawo. Gcina umunwe wakho phansi bese uwuslayida egameni olifunayo: phakamisa lapho ukuze ulisebenzise, noma phakamisa noma yikuphi ngaphandle kwamagama ukuze uwavale ngaphandle kokukhetha. Lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Swayiphela phezulu eziphakamisweni, bese uslayida egameni bese uphakamisa ukuze ulisebenzise
Swayiphela phezulu ukuze uthole iziphakamiso ezengeziwe

Isiphakamiso ngasinye sihlala kuphilisi eyindilinga ngombala we-accent wetimu, nephilisi legama elihle kakhulu elijule kakhulu, ngakho izikhala zihlukaniswa ngombala esikhundleni sokuhlukaniswa okuncane. Ngetimu ye-Material You umbala ulandela isithombe sangemuva sakho. Lesi silungiselelo sicishiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Beka igama ngalinye epilini yombala ogqamile wetimu

Ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, njenge-Instagram ne-Google Keep, zitshela ikhibhodi ukuthi ifihle umugqa weziphakamiso ezinkambini zombhalo ezijwayelekile. Lesi silungiselelo sivuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, futhi ikhibhodi ibonisa umugqa noma kunjalo, njengoba kwenza izikhibhodi eziningi. Sivala ukuze ulandele uhlelo lokusebenza futhi ufihle umugqa. Ukulungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo, ukuthayipha ngokuslayida kanye nokubhala ngesi-Bengali (Avro) kusebenza nganoma iyiphi indlela, ngoba akusancikile emugqeni. Izinkambu zephasiwedi namaphedi ezinombolo azikaze zibonise iziphakamiso.
Bonisa umugqa weziphakamiso ngisho nalapho uhlelo lokusebenza lucela ukuthi ufihlwe

Ngokuvamile ibha engaphezulu ikhombisa ibha yamathuluzi, futhi ishintshela eziphakamisweni kuphela uma kukhona amagama angaba khona. Ngalolu lungiselelo oluvuliwe, ibha engaphezulu ikhombisa umugqa weziphakamiso uma ungasebenzi, ngakho izibikezelo zegama elilandelayo zihlala zibonakala. Umcibisholo ongakwesobunxele uvula ibha yamathuluzi uma udinga ithuluzi.
Gcina umugqa weziphakamiso ubonakala ngaphambi kokuba uthayiphe

Ikhibhodi ikhombisa iziphakamiso ezintathu ngenhla kwezinkinobho ngenkathi uthayipha: ukuqedela amagama, ukulungisa amaphutha, nokubikezela igama elilandelayo. Ikhibhodi ifunda izibikezelo ekuthayipheni kwakho. Cindezela isiphakamiso ukuze usithayiphe nesikhala ngemva kwaso.

Thayipha isiqalo segama, bese uswayipha okunye ngaphandle kwesikhala. Isibonelo, thayipha u-T O bese uswayipha u-G E T H E R ukuze uthole i-together. Uma lesi silungiselelo sivaliwe, izinhlamvu ezithayipiwe ziyigama lazo kanti ukuswayipha kuthayipha igama elilandelayo. Ukuthayipha ngeminwe emibili kusebenza ngale ndlela njalo.
Izinhlamvu ezithayipiwe nokuswayipha ngemva kwazo kwenza izwi elilodwa

Ukhiye ungaba nezinhlamvu zokuflick futhi ungabi nalutho phakathi: shiya ilebula yawo ingenalutho kumhleli wesakhiwo, noma ungenise isakhiwo sekhibhodi esingalindelekile esinezikhiye ezinjalo. Ukuswayipha kuphela okuthayiphayo. Uma icishiwe, okuyisimo esizenzakalelayo, ukuthepha kokhiye onjalo akwenzi lutho. Uma ivuliwe, ukuthepha kuveza i-popup yokuflick yokhiye okwesikhashana ukuze ubone ukuthi ukuswayipha ngakunye kuthayipha ini, ngisho noma i-popup ye-Flick icishiwe.
Ukhiye onabalingiswa abaphenwayo futhi ongenasikhungo ubonisa bona okwesikhashana uma uthintiwe
Thepha ukhiye wokuswayipha kuphela ukuze ubone ukuswayipha kwawo

Lokhu ukunyakaza komunwe okushintsha ukucindezela kube ukuslayida. Kuyisiphindaphindi sokuthinta kwesistimu. Inani eliphansi liqala ukuslayida ngokushesha futhi lizwela kakhulu, kodwa ukucindezela okunganyakazi kungaqala ukuslayida. Inani eliphezulu lidinga ukuswayipha okucabangisisiwe.
Kude kangakanani okufanele uhambe ngaphambi kokuba ukuslayida kuqale. Inani eliphansi lizwela kakhulu
Khetha ukhiye, bese ukhetha ukuthi wenzani

Ngaphandle kwebhokisi, u-?123 no-L ushintshela olimini lwakho olulandelayo. Bamba u-?123 isikhashana futhi ukhiye ngamunye onochodi uwukhombisa ebusweni bawo.
